From `musirr wa mustakbir`, Jahannam was made. Now, these are all finished. And this surface of the earth, it was made just like a stage. A stage is that where the actors who come from the green room, they play their parts. Those who come out from behind this curtain, whether they are those who come from the heavens, or those who come from the `shak wa mutar`, or those who come from the `musirr wa mustakbir` from this Jahannam, everyone comes and plays their part. The `shaqi al-qalb` (hard-hearted ones), they only know how to wield swords and shoot guns. They only know how to fight and kill. And those who are in doubt, you can explain to them a million times, do whatever you want, but they will not leave their doubt. The state of the `nadim wa mustagfir` is that if you say a little, they will bow their head. So these who are playing their parts, all three types of people are coming, where? To this `masrah-i shuhud` (stage of witnessing), on this earth. These three are all coming. So `Qudrat` made this arrangement, that the `jirmani `alam` was made entirely from `nadamah`. The parts below it, the `ummhat`, how were they made? From `shak wa mutar`. How were the `shak wa mutar` made? I will explain that a little. The way `shak wa mutar` were made was that `Qudrat`... when all these heavens were spinning, the spheres were spinning, for example, `falak-i muhit` spun, `falak-i buruj` also started to spin. `Falak-i buruj` spun, Saturn spun, Saturn spun, Jupiter spun, Jupiter spun, Mars spun, below Mars, the Sun spun, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, all these spun. Now, the very last sphere was that of the Moon. When the Moon's sphere spun, it is obvious that the atmosphere below it became hot. As soon as the Moon's sphere spun, the atmosphere below it became hot. And as soon as the atmosphere became hot, heat has two properties. What are they? `yubusat` (dryness) and `hararat` (heat). Meaning, heat and dryness. These two things were created in it. Now see, the blend of male and female is here too. `hararat` and `yubusat` are male qualities, and `rutubat` (moisture) and `burudat` (coldness) are the qualities of the female. Anyway, this was a side point. But now, this `hararat` and `yubusat` started to move. For example, this is a rod. If you apply fire to it at the bottom, then what will happen here? This will become hot. So the heat, while spreading, will reach here. But the hot part that is here, that part will not be here. This is a common matter. So the hot part, as much as it is here, will not be here. In the same way, from the friction of the Moon, the part above was hotter than the part below. So as far as the heat reached, that was called the sphere of ether (`kurrah-i asir`), the sphere of fire. And where it started to lose heat, a time will come when there is no heat in that rod. So in the same way, where the heat ended, what came there? Coldness (`burudat`) came. And `burudat` and `yubusat` are the properties of air. So the sphere of air started to form from there. `Burudat` and `yubusat`, these two qualities... these qualities, `burudat` and `yubusat`, these two... cold and these two things... the sphere of air started to form and it... while going, these two qualities, cold and dryness, they both started going, and a layer was formed. And the layer ended where the heat ended. `yubusat` ended. When dryness ended, it was necessary for its place to be filled, and moisture (`moisture`) came. `Rutubat` (moisture) and `burudat` (coldness) are the properties of water. The sphere of water began to form. And the sphere of water, while forming, came down. And this is `burudat` and `rutubat`. Now coldness ended, but moisture remained. With moisture, heat came again. And `hararat` (heat) and `rutubat` (moisture) are the properties of earth. The sphere of earth began to form. So in this way, these spheres were formed. The upper sphere is the sphere of ether (`kurrah-i asir`), which is called the sphere of fire. And below it is the sphere of air. Below that is the sphere of water, which is also called `zamharir`. `kurrah-i zamharir`. And below `zamharir`, the sphere that was formed, what is it called? Sphere of earth (`kurrah-i khak`). So these four spheres were formed in this way, and below these four spheres, as I was telling you, Jahannam was formed. And Jahannam was made from whom? From the `musirr wa mustakbir`. From the `musirr wa mustakbir`, Jahannam was made. And Jahannam has various names: `saqim`, `duzakh`... but they are not different things, but the entire... the entire Jahannam is referred to by various names. But how people go into Jahannam, what the atmosphere is like there, where they are kept, how their... how they are moved from one zone to another, insha'Allah, the details will come. There are many details. But for now, the way I have to explain, since I have to explain the formation of the world, for this reason, I am explaining this much and leaving it, that you... your thirst should not remain, that you should understand how the spheres were formed. The sphere... there... first, how were the spheres formed? Below the spheres, how were the elements (`kurre`) formed? And below the elements, this Jahannam, how was it formed? This entire physical world, from what was it made? From the `musirr wa mustakbir`, `shak wa mutar`, and `nadim wa mustagfir`. When this entire world was formed, the Lord of the worlds, what did it do? It is surrounding this very world with this very world. It is controlling this world with this world itself. It is creating the cause and effect (`dar-i asbab`) from among its own people. Those who govern are also here, those whose... who feel are also here. Meaning, those who perceive and those who make others perceive are also here. They are all from among them. So the instruments that are effective, who are those instruments? The spheres (`aflak`). From `falak-i muhit` down to `falak-i buruj`, down to Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, all these are the effective planets. And what do they affect? They affect the `ummhat`, and they affect the `mawlid-i salasah` here on the surface of this earth. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` (mineral, plant, and animal). `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are not some separate thing. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are the three children of whom? Of the heavens and the earth. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are called `mawlid-i salasah`. These three are the children of the mother and father. The fathers are these spheres, the mothers are these `ummhat`. From the union of these `ummhat` and fathers, who were born? These `mawlid-i salasah`: `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan`. In `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` too, if you take `madhan`, in it there will be `shak wa mutar`, there will be `musirr wa mustakbir`, and in it there will also be `nadim wa mustagfir`. ...this entire formation, you did it, or... `Qudrat` did it, or you... gave support (`ta'id`)? It was supported. But the self did it. Support was indeed there. It was supported by all the `quwa-i dawwarah` from `aql-i awwal`. That support is there because the formation of the world is happening. So support was indeed there. But the most important work it did with its support was the creation of man. And which... I will tell you in detail. For now, you just see how the world is being formed. See the place (`makan`), the dweller (`makin`) will come later. Now the `makan` is coming. And the `makan` is not yet fully decorated. Now I am telling you in its raw state, how the order was created and how it was established. But keep this in mind, in what way this has happened. And in what way these `alat-i majburah` (constrained instruments), in what way they... on the `ummhat`, in what way they affect these `mawlid-i salasah`. Meaning, these planets all affect us. Why do they? Because they were made to have an effect. And who are all these? They are the `nadimin`. They were made from the `nadimin`. `Qudrat`, from whomever it wants to take work, it is taking work from them. It is taking its own work from the `ummhat`. But this entire world is made from whom? From the falling group. On whom the punishment came. On all of them. As the Quran has said, you have to enter this world. So who had to enter? The one who did `takhaluf` (opposition), who disobeyed there. All the disobedient ones have to come. Now, one thing to understand... let me explain a little point to you. That we are being commanded, "Look, you have disobeyed, you will have to enter this world." Now you... in this world, you see that the Lord of the Two Worlds also came, the Seal of the Messengers, and with Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa, may peace and blessings be upon him, Amir al-Mu'minin also came, and all the Ahl al-Bayt came, the Imams came, the prophets, 124,000 came. So you will say, "In this prison?" So `Qudrat` does not want that. `Qudrat` does not want that those who are pure and holy servants, who have repented, how can it send them to this world? How can it send them to this world, to this prison? And it is obvious that if you think, "We are stuck here, so they should be stuck too," this cannot happen. This also cannot happen. So now, if all these prophets and all these Imams came here, this is a very big point to understand. So you... these all... all the prophets and messengers, whom the entire Islamic world, `na'uzubillah`, `na'uzubillah`, says are `bashar` (humans), are our Rasul, are `insan` (men), are at the pinnacle of humanity. With such words, the blood boils. Hey, when the Quran is saying, *innama ana basharun mithlukum* (I am only a man like you), is there any rhetoric greater than the Quran? So `Qudrat` says, "Say, O Prophet, 'I am a man like you.'" I am a man. What was the need to say "like you"? So it means there is a point. The point is that they came here, you are seeing them. They came because they had to guide you. But the one who comes to guide is not called a prisoner. If a jailer is in a prison, he is not called a prisoner. A jailer, if he comes into your dungeon, or sits with the prisoner, or eats, even then he is not called a prisoner. And what happened here? The entire Islamic world is calling the Prophet an `insan`, is considering him a prisoner. `na'uzubillah`, `na'uzubillah`, they consider him a prisoner. And we do not consider him a prisoner. Do you understand our difference? A jailer, if he goes to a prison, he is a jailer. Wherever he is, he will remain a jailer. He does not become a prisoner. Just as in a hunting ground, a `shikar-gah`, when a hunter goes, then first the hunter has to wear a khaki dress. There are also some requisites for hunting. He knows how to shoot a gun, but along with that, the hunt... first he wears a khaki dress. Why, sir, did he wear a khaki dress? Because the atmosphere there, the grass there, he adopts its color. So that the animals become familiar with him, familiar with that atmosphere. And he can hunt with ease, the hunter. So first he will wear such a dress that he will make the prey familiar and then kill it. So in the same way, they, to hunt our fallen souls (`nufus-i habita`), these prophets came. So if they are coming wearing this dress, adopting the form of a man, then by God, do not call them human. They are coming, we are seeing them as human, but in reality, we are not seeing them. That's why Allah Ta'ala said, *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun* (And you see them looking at you, but they do not see). O Prophet... look at the rhetoric of the Quran! *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun*. *wa tarahum*, you see them that they are looking at you, but they do not see... `yubsirun` also means to see. *wa lakin la yubsirun*, and they do not see you, O Prophet, with the eye of the heart. *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun*. Hey, this is seeing with this fatty eye. This is only seeing with the external eye. If they saw with the eye of the heart, they would see you, O Prophet, as something else. So what did they do? Who was the Prophet? A great... at the pinnacle of humanity. They saw the Prophet as a human, and they attributed all the qualities of a human to the Prophet. It's not like that. He is... how can he be human at the pinnacle of humanity? When is he human at all? He is not a human like us. He became `bashar` so that we could be familiar. So how did he adopt that form, and how did he come? It is a detailed story, and when that time comes, you will hear it, how the prophets come, how the `awliya'` come, how their successions are established, how the `da'wah` is spread. All these details will come. For now, what I am telling you is that you must believe that there is a difference between the prisoner and the jailer. There is a great difference between us and them. And this difference... if you do not consider this `farq-i maratib` (difference of ranks), it is `zindiqi` (heresy). So it is necessary to understand this difference of ranks. These are the `awliya'-Allah` (friends of God), and there is a great difference between them and us. A difference like that of the earth and the sky. That's why what did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him, do? Once, it is a well-known incident, a famous incident, a very grand incident. That he was sitting, the court was assembled, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him's. You... there, a man came and sat down. And upon sitting, he began to say to the Imam... he had come for the first time, he had heard a lot about the Imam, and after hearing from his friends, he came and sat in your court. And after sitting, he said, "I am seeing, there are two eyes, the nose is the same, the mouth is the same. He is a human just like us. What's the difference? He is a human just like me. And they say there is such a great difference between the Imam and us, I don't understand it. He looks like a human just like us." Now, he was thinking this, and everything was being revealed to the Imam. He was understanding everything, he was reading his... his mind. Now, when `thought-reading` is happening, that a person can generate such powers, and he was the Imam. He is the master of the universe. He was sitting. He read his thoughts. After reading, he said, "This person, come here for a moment." He came immediately. He thought, "I have been called in the court, I cannot refuse." He came. Near the Imam. The Imam said, "Sir, my back is itching, please scratch it for me." You said, "I am itching, scratch it." And you were wearing a silk (`reshmi`) shawl. He removed the shawl a little and you said, "My... I am itching, please... scratch my back." Since our hand doesn't reach there, it's a known fact. And he came, and after removing your shawl, he raised his hand to scratch, and he saw that the entire back was covered with boils and sores. And pus and matter were oozing from it. Now he was very scared. He said that "what I was thinking, this is even worse than that. I was considering him a human, but this... the state is that he is called an Imam, and look at the Imam's condition, that this is the state of his back." Now, when this was the state, he... he couldn't do anything in front of all the people. He went and sat down. After scratching, he went and sat down. He said, "What a mess I've gotten into." Anyway, he sat quietly. After that, after a little while, the Imam saw him and said, "My back is itching again, please scratch it." Now he came, and what does he see? The back is completely clear. Completely clear. He was surprised. "Just now I saw that there were all boils and sores, and now it is completely clear here. What's the matter?" And he went and sat down. A little while passed, and the Imam said, "Scratch it again." A third time, you got him up. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him. He came. As soon as he raised his hand to scratch, he couldn't find the back. Now the back is not there. And his hand is going through the shawl. *`ala an kama kan* (back to as it was). *kulla yawmin huwa fi sha'n* (every day He is in [a new] matter). "In whose hand is the divine, that servant am I." So what will you understand of the Imam's powers and the Imam's matters? Insha'Allah, the details will come aplenty, insha'Allah. We will understand the `imamat`, we will understand the Imam too. For now, what I was saying was that `lillah-fillah` (for the sake of Allah), we will have to differentiate between the jailer and the prisoner. And if you keep this difference in mind, insha'Allah, you will be able to understand the upcoming topic easily. For now, I have told you this, that the physical world, how was it made? How was the `jirmani `alam` (corporeal world) formed, and after that, how were the `ummhat` formed, and from the `shak wa... `musirr wa mustakbir`, how was the formation of Jahannam done? Some details of Jahannam are many, and they will come later, insha'Allah.

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 11 -->

Yesterday, I explained to you everything regarding the celestial spheres, how our celestial spheres were prepared, and how the *hayula-i thaniyah*, which is called *hayula* (matter) and *surat* (form), was created by the *'Aql-i Mudabbir* (Governing Intellect).

The fact of the matter is that our knowledge, and we, are so entangled and engrossed in our knowledge and worldly affairs that we never turn towards this religious inclination and never even tried to go towards this philosophy, and never even pondered upon it. And although astrology, astronomy, and all these things are in their own place, but *din* (religion), and the philosophy of the *Shari'ah*, are in their own respective positions. It has a great magnificence, and we must recognize this magnificence.

I am reminded of something, and I have said it in some gatherings and have narrated it, that one of our elders has written a strange incident: that a very great—many different scholars gathered. There was an astrologer, an astronomer, some physician, and some doctor, and of various such fields of knowledge—there was a philosopher, there was a logician. All of them gathered and began to say, "It's true that we are experts in our fields of knowledge, and let's form a good society. And let's have a guild. How nice it will be, and we will live together, and with our cooperation, we will continue to share our thoughts with one another, so it will be very good."

So it was approved, and they said it's a very good thing, but it is so that the beginning of everything happens with some happiness and from this, from festivity. It is better that we begin our gathering, the one we start, with a trip on the river.

So they decided to take a trip on the river, and they took a boat and boarded the boat, and they began to say to the boatman, "Take us for a trip." And the boatman started to take them for the trip.

When they sat down, what happens is that everything—*al-ina'u yatrashshahu bima fihi* (the vessel spills what is in it)—whatever is in the cup, spills over. Now, these were scholars, and they wanted to—they were also proud of their knowledge, and they began to display their knowledge. And when they tried to assert their dominance, on whom did they do it? On the poor boatman. They started saying to the boatman, "Look, do you know a bit of chemistry?" They said such things, that this is organic, this is inorganic, and this and that happens. The astrologer began his own discourse on the celestial spheres. They talked about astronomy, so every person began to ask him according to their own fields of knowledge. So the one who was without knowledge, or if there was anyone ignorant there, who was it? It was that poor boatman. That boatman was giving an answer to everyone, and he was saying this: "Brother, I don't know this. I don't know this." That poor fellow [thought], "You are a humble person, I row the oars. Brother, they ask all these questions, and I cannot answer them." And it happened like this, and afterwards, he sat down completely silent and began to say, "I will not give any answer, and I absolutely will not..." He thought, "They are talking nonsense, saying such things; I don't know these things."

The situation arose that after just a short while, winds began to blow. Now, when the winds began to blow, it was a precursor to a storm. A storm began to arrive. When the storm started to arrive, then...

A boat was going, and it had many learned people. Even the boatman did not understand what they were saying. But now a storm is approaching, and they are getting an idea of the storm. And, and there is this apprehension that it might overturn. Someone asked, "What will happen?" He said, "Everyone stand up." Everyone stood up and said in a panic, "What will happen?" "What will happen?" "The boat will overturn." "We will all be in the river." So, they were asked, "Do you all know how to swim?" "Do you know how to swim?" "We don't know." He said, "Then what's the use? If you don't even know how to swim, then of what use is this knowledge (*'ilm*) of yours? What is this philosophy (*falsafah*) of use? What is this astrology, this astronomy of use? If you cannot even save your own life, then of what use are these arts and sciences (*'ulum*)?" It is the same way, that the sciences that are useful in our life, which are undoubtedly beneficial, they are certainly beneficial and are sciences that give us a lot of benefit. So, these sciences that give benefit, their benefit is only up to our life. They are not the sciences that will be of benefit in the valley of death and after death. So, that knowledge (*'ilm*) is far better which will be useful to us. So, this... the sun and the moon and going to the moon, and science making this much progress, this is all in its own place. No doubt, science has made great progress, but one claim of science is wrong. One claim is very wrong. Everything else about science is correct, and science itself is a great knowledge (*'ilm*) that we have. But one of its claims is very wrong. And what is that wrong claim? That we have harnessed nature. We have pierced the chest of nature (*fitrat*). We have captured nature (*fitrat*). This claim that it makes is wrong. This is its grand claim, and it is extremely wrong, and it can never be true. Because you are subservient to nature (*fitrat*). Hey, just deal with sleep first. Treat sleep. Stop old age from coming. Can you do it? Hey, you cannot turn white hair, the white hair that there is, you cannot make it black. You can dye it, but you cannot make it black, you cannot change it. So today, whatever is in its place, you are in that very place. You are not anything more than that. This much has certainly happened, that you have greatly benefited yourselves. For your own sake, you have created many beneficial things. You have become very fast. You have traveled with great speed. You made a computer, you made mathematical sciences, you have made countless things in the world. No doubt, you did all this for your own benefit. But what? As scholars say, "He who arrested the rays of the sun... He who arrested the rays of the sun... He who arrested the rays of the sun... in his own... in his own world of... his own life's... dark night, he could not bring about dawn." "He who arrested the rays of the sun, could not turn the dark night of life into dawn." The one who sought the pathways of the stars, the one who sought the pathways of the stars, could not travel in the world of his own thoughts.

The revolving star had to travel through the pathways of the stars, had to travel in the world of its own thoughts. So it became evident that all this exists, but the *falsafah* (philosophy) which is the philosophy of the Prophet, which is the philosophy of the *Ahl al-Bayt*, which is the scheme of *‘aql* and *tadbir* (intellect and planning), and which is the power that is working behind all these things, and how this work is to be done—to know this is *‘ilm ladunni*. This is the knowledge of *ma kana lahu ‘ilmun* (of which he had no knowledge) which the Quran speaks of. This is the essence of Islam. Islam was not for the purpose of just telling you about acts of worship and then urging you to be bound by them. This was not it. Or to have you read the Quran with *tafsil* (detail). Reading the Quran with *tafsil* is certainly necessary, but the purpose of reading it in such a manner was not just a superficial reading. You were commanded to dive deep into it, you were to see its effects. You had all these commands. So it became clear that these are just external, outward matters. No one went into the inner dimension, into its depth. And it is evident that those who did go into the *batin*, and whom Allah Ta'ala, through His grace, has connected to these things, then we should acquire more and more information, be more and more involved, create more and more *taqwa* (piety), our worship should be greater, our *i'tiqad* (conviction) should become stronger and stronger. This is what should happen. Because, after knowing these sciences, if you do not implement their effect, then you have done nothing. Its effect must also manifest. Knowing the sciences does not mean that you become negligent in your acts of worship, as is commonplace. What is it among the general Muslims? That if you have acquired a lot of information, then you are called *Ahl-e-Falsafah* (people of philosophy), and you are expected to abandon all *namaz*, fasting, and so on, and just sit comfortably. Sit in a corner like a sufi. The problem with sufism is that it often involves the abandonment of worship. They frequently abandon worship and become lost in their own thoughts. That is not the case for us. We are meant to do even more. In any case, what I meant to say was that you should listen to these things not just for pleasure, but listen to them and, according to their importance, give them due respect. And their respect is this: that after acquiring it, you also act upon it. Your conviction should be firm, you should move forward in your worship, your morals should be rectified, your dealings should be corrected. This should be your objective. In any case, yesterday I stated before you that the *hayula* (prime matter) which was before that *'arif* (gnostic), that flame which was composed of the *muta‘ayyin* (determinate), *musallam* (sound), *mustaqirr* (stable), *nadir* (rare/base), and *musaffaq* (refined), and from which a *musaffaq* was made—which is called *hayula* and *surat* (form). And I told you its technical meaning, that it refers to the *namiyah* (vegetative) and *hissiyah* (sentient) faculties. So that *hayula* and *surat* which was before him, which is a collection in its entirety, he sorted it and gave to each what was worthy of it. Now, how did Allah Ta'ala sort it? It is evident that those who were base, who were regretful, who were *nadir*, He gave them the highest place. Those who were *saqit* (fallen) and *mutahayyir* (bewildered), He placed them in the middle. Doubt is in the middle. And those who were *musallam* and *mustaqirr*, He cast them underfoot. He made them their footstool. Now, I had started the explanation of these three levels before you, but then I stopped.

I want to explain that first of all, Allah Ta'ala, the All-Wise Dispenser of affairs (*Hakim*), gave motion (*gardish*) to the *Falak-e-Muheet* (the Encompassing Sphere). This... and I had previously told you while explaining this motion (*gardish*) that Nature (*Qudrat*) had stopped this *Hayula* (Prima Materia), this *Hayula-e-Thaniyah* (Secondary Prima Materia), which is called *Hayula-e-Surat* (Prima Materia of Form) - it had stopped and supported this *Hayula* with four powers (*quwwat*). Which powers are they? *Taleh* (Ascendant), *Gharib* (Descendant), *Ashir* (Tenth House), and *Rabih* (Fourth House). There are four powers: *Taleh*, *Gharib*, *Ashir*, and *Rabih*. These are the four powers. What are *Taleh* and *Gharib*? *Taleh* is the place of rising (*tulu'*), meaning the highest point. And *Gharib* is the place of setting (*ghuroob*). So... the *Mashriq* (East) and the *Maghrib* (West), there, at that location, the inclinations came. Now, from what will the direction be determined? From the *Khana-e-Ka'bah*. The *Khana-e-Ka'bah Muqaddas* is that point, the center point (*nuqta-e-markaz*). The entire circle (*daira*) will be drawn from there. Now, this... what is the significance of the *Khana-e-Ka'bah Muqaddas*? What is it? All of that will come, *insha'Allah*, at its proper time. For now, you have to understand that *Mashriq* (East) and *Maghrib* (West), these two locations, at these two states, the powers were working. I told you that Nature (*Qudrat*) took some people who were about to fall and held them there. Whether they are in companionship, or whether they are... engaged... or whether they are helping assistants. It could be anyone. It can be anyone, but those powers were working under them. And where? At *Taleh* and *Gharib*. When they were at *Taleh* and *Gharib*... that is, in the *Mashriq* (East) and *Maghrib* (West), then where were *Ashir* and *Rabih* working? In the middle of the sky. In the middle of the sky, in the center of the heavens, these were at the *Ashir*. And *Center of the Earth*, in the very middle and center of the earth, the power that was working, its name is *Rabih*. With these four powers, Allah Ta'ala had stopped this entire *Hayula*. And after stopping it, He gave it motion (*gardish*). And the motion (*gardish*) was such that, just as when you give motion to an onion, its layers are separate, in the same way, they started to separate here. So, Nature (*Qudrat*) had already... those who were at the level of regret, their station was already high. The name always comes at the top. The form always comes at the top. So it is obvious that for them, who had come to the top, from them, He made nine *aflak* (celestial spheres). How many *aflak*? Nine *aflak*. The very first *falak* (sphere) that was made, which is in the most *basit* (simple/uncompounded) realm, meaning it is completely smooth and polished, there is no *naqsh* (design/imprint) in it, no patterns, no stars in it, it is completely *basit*. It is transparent. So this *basit* *falak* that was made, which I call *Muheet* (Encompassing), which we call *Falak-e-Atlas* (The Primum Mobile). The *Falak-e-Atlas* or the *Muheet*, their meaning is one and the same. And that *falak* was encompassing the entire realm. This upper part, which we call a *falak*, and that *falak* was encompassing everything, and there was nothing in it. After that, it was rotating in an eastern (*sharqi*) manner. The second one was rotating in its opposite direction. The lower part that was rotating in the opposite direction, that is called the *Falak-e-Burooj* (Sphere of the Zodiacal Signs). What is the *Falak-e-Burooj*? The *Burooj* are the twelve zodiacal signs (*burj*), and the twelve *burj* are inside it. Now, did Allah Miyan create these *burj* beforehand and tell man that these are the *burj*? No, it's not like that. Rather, man, in this world, here from this place...

All these heavens, because they are transparent, we can see the stars, we can see Zuhal (Saturn), we can see Marikh (Mars), we can see Zuhra (Venus). Although Marikh is on its sixth heaven, Shams (the Sun) is on the fourth heaven, Zuhra is on its third heaven, Zuhal is on the seventh heaven. But we can see all of them. These are all planets, *sayyaray* (wanderers), that are seen to be revolving. But the stars that we see, which are fixed, which are called *Sawaabita* (the fixed stars), all of them are on the eighth *falak* (celestial sphere). They are on the eighth *falak*. The other *falak* that... from the upper glass and the lower glass appears to the eyes... which we call *Falak al-Buruj* (the Sphere of the Constellations). These stars that were there, who observed them? This... the one who was an expert in the science of astronomy (*'Ilm al-Falakiyat*) and the one who derived it, was our Prophet whose name was Idris. And his name is also Yunan. His name is... uh... uh... [unclear]... Iglag is also his name, Yunan is also his name, and Idris is also his name. He was our Prophet, and he was the first to derive this knowledge, and he observed. From here, of that heaven. And he spent 30 years of his precious life in mastering this astronomy. And what was the result of that? He saw that at one time, six constellations (*buruj*) are visible in the sky, and at the other time, meaning after six months, the other six constellations are visible. So apparently, there are then twelve constellations (*buruj*) in our sky. How did these constellations emerge? And what character did they adopt? In reality, all these stars that were there were forming different shapes. He designated these shapes, that these are the specific shapes. Just like our children also make things out of clouds and see them, that, 'Oh, this has formed a lion,' 'that has formed.' This is a changing cloud, it is not going to remain. But these fixed stars (*sawaabit*), these stars that were there, they were fixed in their place. The shape that they had formed, was formed; it was formed for eternity. So what shape was formed? A shape of a lion was formed, a shape of a bull (*Saur*) was formed, a shape of a fish was formed, and Sunbulah (Virgo), a Hubb-e-bil shape was formed. Mizan (Libra), the shape of a scale was formed. Like this, twelve shapes were formed, and today the entire world agrees on this, that the sky is divided into these twelve sections. There are twelve sections, and it is according to those very sections that all our... whatever is derived here, the horoscope (*za'icha*) that is looked at, things of the world that happen, the predictions (*peshingoiyan*) that are made, they are all according to those very sections. Anyway. Now there was another matter. The point to be told was, how did the twelve constellations (*buruj*) come to be? These twelve *buruj* came from the fixed stars. And where are all those stars? They are on the eighth *falak*. The *falak* below the eighth *falak*... the next one, what was that *falak* called? Zuhal (Saturn). It was the *falak* of Zuhal. In it, there is only one *sayyara* (planet), and it is revolving in its place. There is only one *sayyara* in that *falak*, and its name is Zuhal. Below Zuhal came Mushtari (Jupiter). After Mushtari came Marikh (Mars). Below Marikh came Shams (the Sun). Below Shams came Zuhra (Venus), 'Utarid (Mercury), and Qamar (the Moon). These were the complete seven stars. Zuhal, Mushtari, Marikh, Shams, Zuhra, 'Utarid, Qamar. These seven *sayyaray* are revolving. These seven became the *aflak* (celestial spheres). These seven *aflak*, and above them, which one? Is the eighth *falak*, *Falak al-Buruj*. And above *Falak al-Buruj* is *Falak al-Muhit* (the All-Encompassing Sphere).

...these nine `falak` (spheres) are there, and in the same regard, the... also that Allah Ta'ala has kept for humans, here the matter of birth has also been set for nine months, which is somewhat similar to this. And the matter of the seventh month is in this regard, that its life will continue. If it is the eighth month for the human fetus, then its death occurs. So what is the reason for this death occurring? That same discussion... your... your topic will remain the same, and from that, I am... beginning. What I wanted to say was that the Lord of the worlds, all these `sayyare` (planets) that He created, and all the `thawabit` (fixed stars) that He created, or the `buruj` (constellations) He created, all of these are influential upon this world. Not just on humans, but on `nabatat` (plants), on `haywanat` (animals), on the earth, on all of its workings that exist from Allah Ta'ala in this universe, these are things that have an influence on everything. These `sayyare` (planets), they... do have an influence. Iqbal says: "These stars are something, they appear as something else. These stars are something, they appear as something else. These tricksters openly deceive." "These tricksters openly deceive." So one should not go by their external glitter and shine. They undoubtedly have an influence on us, and how they have an influence, and in what way Allah has... what things... there are matters [to discuss]. What I wanted to say was that Allah Ta'ala placed Saturn (`Zuhal`), Jupiter (`Mushtari`), Mars (`Mirrikh`), the Sun (`Shams`), Venus (`Zuhra`), Mercury (`'Atarad`), and the Moon (`Qamar`)—all of them—He... seated each one in its own `falak` (sphere). They are revolving in their own respective `falak`. And the eighth `falak` became the `falak-e-buruj` (the sphere of the constellations). And after that is the `falak-e-muhit` (the encompassing sphere). This, which Allah Ta'ala had created, the stars, He had created them for this reason: so that there may be change (`tabdili`) in the universe, so that there may be creation (`takhliq`) in the universe, so that the universe may proceed on its... appointed term (`mi'ad`), and so that from here... the paths that lead from materiality (`maddiyat`) to spirituality (`ruhaniyat`) may be paved. This is why Allah Ta'ala appointed the planets. First of all, the `mudabbir-e-hakim` (the wise governor/arranger), the `'arsh` (throne) of the `mudabbir-e-hakim`, entrusted the `tadbir` (arrangement/governance) to `Zuhal` (Saturn). Look, the `sayyare` (planets) are in their places. As soon as those planets began to revolve, with the revolution of the `falak-e-muhit` (the encompassing sphere), `zamana` (time) was created. The clocks started ticking, `zamana` (time) was created. And the creation of time, for you, for us, is a very good thing, that we... live in time, and it is obvious that we should know the time, whether it is day or night, what time it is now, and so on. But what is this in reality? It is a punishment (`saza`). It is the greatest punishment. Being in `zamana` (time) and `makan` (space)... this is the greatest punishment. `Makan` (space) is what? That from which one takes support is called `makan`. And the `waqt` (time) that passes over us is called `zamana`. So you live in the prison of `zaman-o-makan` (time and space). And as you keep exiting the prison of `zaman-o-makan`, `waqt` (time)... will keep diminishing. And Einstein has also proven it... the theory of relativity has come to you. And you know that when a person travels at the speed of light, the sensation of time ends there. And it stops. So if we, while living here in the world, can feel this, then how can we not believe in `ilahiyat` (the divine sciences), that over there, it does not exist at all. There is no trace of time. In that `'alam-e-ruhani` (spiritual realm), there is no time, no language, no space, nothing, nor what. The One who is timeless (`be-zaman`) and spaceless (`be-makan`), He who created it innumerably, that Being is `al-aan kama kaan` (He is now as He was). He has the status of `kulla yawmin huwa fi sha'n` (Every day He is in a [new] state of glory). And He is...

Here, our dwelling place is also there, in its fields, it is well established. So anyway, the Lord of the worlds, that is, the *Aashir-e-Mudabbir-e-Aa'zam* [The Tenth, The Great Governor], first of all, thought of a plan for Zuhal [Saturn]. On top of its head is the very first star, it is a planet, for that planet, he devised a plan that you should become the ruler and act upon this world. He gave this plan to Zuhal. And to what extent did he give the plan? I told you that ever since the seven *mutalaqeen* [associates] have come into the world, that plan has entered their homes. I had told you, how were the seven *mutalaqeen* created? They were *aab-o-aatish-o-baad-o-khaak* [water, fire, wind, and earth]. And when were the *musir-o-mustakbir* [the rebellious and the arrogant] created? They were placed under the feet, that place which we call Jinn, which we call Saqrah, which is called Jahannum [hell], which is called Saqar, which is called Aqim. All these are names related to Jahannum. This *dozakh* [hell], the real *dozakh* is not somewhere here or there. It is present beneath our feet. And what is its dimension? How much heat is there? How many people live there? What is the capacity? How many valleys are there? How many gorges are there? How many mountains have come? And for how long will one have to stay there? What is the duration? And how many *mala'ikah* [angels] are appointed there? How are they punished there? This is all known. It is all a known matter. Nothing is hidden. Allah Ta'ala says: *'alayha tis'ata 'ashar* (Over it are nineteen). On this, on this *dozakh*, We have appointed nineteen. There are nineteen *mala'ikah* who are appointed over this *dozakh*. Now, look, *nauzubillah, nauzubillah* [we seek refuge in God], *dozakh* is a bad thing, so the *mala'ikah* must also be bad. The *mala'ikah* are just as good. Do not think that the *mala'ikah* have also become bad. This is a task; whoever is entrusted with a task will be the one to carry it out. So, this Jahannum that was created, all of them were spent, were used up. Who? The *musir-o-mustakbir*. All the *musir-o-mustakbir* that existed, Allah Ta'ala put them all underfoot, and this Jahannum that was formed is entirely in their possession. And I had told you that from the seven *mutalaqeen*, the *ummahat* [mothers, i.e., the elements] were created, which are called *aab-o-aatish-o-baad-o-khaak*. First of all, let me tell you, and then repeat it, that when the *falak-e-qamar* [sphere of the moon] rotated—look, the *falak-e-zamin* [sphere of the earth] rotated, below it the *falak-e-buruj* [sphere of the constellations] rotated. The *falak-e-buruj* rotated, and below it Zuhal, Mushtari, Mirrikh, Shams, Zohra, Utaarid, Qamar [Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon] rotated. And when the *falak* of Qamar [the moon] began to rotate, this *falak*, the path on which the moon is moving, when it began to rotate, the atmosphere beneath it began to get hot. It is obvious that friction creates heat, *haraarat* [heat] is produced. So this *haraarat* that was there, along with the *haraarat*, another quality was created. What is that thing? *Yubusat* [dryness]. *Haraarat* and *yubusat*, these two qualities. Whose qualities are they? This is the quality of fire. So that sphere of fire, a layer of fire was created. Now you will see flames there, you will see embers, but there are no flames or embers. Just as you describe the quality of something, that it is hot but it appears cool to the eye, but what is its quality? It is hot. So in exactly the same way, the state of this entire atmosphere was that of the *kurrah-e-asir* [sphere of ether], of the sphere of fire. *Asir*, it was called *asir*, and it became the sphere of fire. Now, this sphere of fire, up to where was it formed? How far did this layer extend? As far as the *haraarat* and *yubusat* continued. Where the *haraarat* came and ended... I heated this, this corner will not get that hot. A time will come when it will be completely cool. That part which was completely cool, from there the sphere was seen to begin.

...began to be created. And that *ḥarārat* (heat) was eliminated. The *yubūsat* (dryness) remained. With *yubūsat*, for a void (*khalā*) to always exist is impossible (*maḥāl*). Something or other has to come. So, for the necessary replacement, what is needed? With *ruṭūbat* (moisture)... what thing came? *Ruṭūbat* came. So, *ruṭūbat* and *burūdat* (coldness)... these both... with *yubūsat*... with *yubūsat*, *burūdat* came. And these two qualities are of what? Of air (*hawā*). A sphere of air began to be created. So, the sphere of air continued to descend. And it... where did it reach? It reached as far as the *dukhān* (smoke). And there, what happened? The *yubūsat* was eliminated. When *yubūsat* is eliminated, what will take its place? *Ruṭūbat* came. *Ruṭūbat* and *burūdat* are the qualities of what? Of water (*pānī*). A sphere of water began to be created. Now, if you look, there isn't a single drop of water there. It’s a vast body of water. Not even a drop of water, but its qualities (*ṣifāt*) are of water. A sphere of water was created from that. Now that sphere, descending, where did it come to? To the point where... that *ruṭūbat* was eliminated. And *yubūsat* was eliminated, and *ruṭūbat* remained. With that *ruṭūbat*, *ḥarārat* combined, and that became a sphere of fire (*āg*). A sphere of fire was formed. So, in this way, spheres were formed. And after the spheres were formed, how many were left? Seven.

The one at the end... where *yubūsat* was eliminated, and it was said to have combined with *ḥarārat*. *ḥarārat* was not there. You said that a sequence started: *ḥarārat*, then *yubūsat*... *yubūsat* with *ruṭūbat*, yes... *ruṭūbat* was eliminated... yes. So where did this *ḥarārat* come from again?

It was there from the start. From the beginning, there were two... what were they? Over there... like *burūdat*... with *burūdat*, *yubūsat* remained. Yes. After that, it came further down, and *yubūsat* was eliminated. *Burūdat*... then... further on... *ḥarārat* and *ruṭūbat*...

No, *ḥarārat* and *yubūsat*. Two qualities must remain. Two qualities must always be present. These four elements (*ʻanāṣir*) are everlasting. And this... where did this come from, you are asking? The simple answer to that is this: that they had created *ṭūl* (length), *ʻarḍ* (breadth), and *ʻumq* (depth). And I had told you that with *ṭūl* came *ḥarārat* and *yubūsat*, with *ʻarḍ* came *burūdat* and *ruṭūbat*, and with *ʻumq* two other qualities were created. So the fundamental things that were created there cannot be separated. They were born there; they are inherent. Now, what happened here? Their manifestation began. For us to say that the spheres were rubbing and being created... The reality is that these things were already created; they are enduring and not things that perish. So this was the situation, and then *Saqar* remained. And how was *Saqar* made? It was made from those who showed *istigbār* (arrogance) and *takabbur* (pride). So Allah Ta'ala made them with *Saqar*, which is a house that is a tremendous manifestation of divine power, where there is the most severe arrangement and a powerful system of torment. That *Dozat* (Hell)... that *Dozat*... it has gates, for coming and going, it has stations, it has names, it has a place, it has a location, it has everything. For now, I will... because when its mention comes up, I will explain it in detail.

The one which is called *Jahannam*. The way it is... is that its lower part is its throne, and its canopy (*chhat*) is its upper part. The roof is the upper part. The way we cook milk, when we boil it, it boils over, so we add some water or something so that it settles down. But how has *Qudrat* (Divine Power) cooked it? Its method is also... It is below, the banner is above it. This kind of net has been made. The banner is above, and the milk is below, and from below there are paths for coming. Paths for going and coming. And those... are very painful paths. And this is mentioned in the Qur'an. And it is spread out in such a way... if we were to describe its state, you would find it to be a very terrifying thing. This kind of *jahannam* has been made. And the *jahannam* that is made, it is apparent that it is for those who are spiritually filthy. As are the spirits, so are the angels. So it is apparent, as are the inhabitants, so is their home. Their home is also made like that. And all these things, the parts that are made of fire, Allah Ta'ala has... arranged for *jahannam*. For what is it made? It is apparent that it is made of metal, brass, lead, and frankincense. All these kinds of things, those that fan the flames and those that cause burning. All these things, from these... and the way they are made, whether... when the exegesis comes, then it will be known that *jahannam* is made of all these things. And the inhabitants of *jahannam* are also of this same type, and their home is also of this same type. Understood? So, the human is such that he cannot get out of his shell, because he is a prisoner of his own thoughts and his own environment. That as are his thoughts, his environment has also been made by Allah Ta'ala in such a way that you will stay in the environment you deserve. So, I was explaining that *falak-e-qamar* (the sphere of the moon)... above the *falak-e-qamar* are the seven planets and then *Zuhal* (Saturn). *Zuhal* was the first to be given the *tadbir* (governance)... that you, first of all, establish your rule over this realm and so that the *takhliq* (creation) is completed here. *Ma'dan* (minerals), *nabat* (plants), and *haywan* (animals) come into existence in their places, and this realm, in terms of all these things... becomes complete. So for completing it, first of all, Allah Ta'ala chose *Zuhal*. Above it are the planets. And *Zuhal* was given the *tadbir* for how many years? For one thousand years. For one thousand years, *Zuhal* will perform the *tadbir*. Now, please pay a little attention to this matter of *tadbir*. That Allah Ta'ala, the *tadbir* He has assigned to these planets is such that first of all, He gave the *tadbir* to *Zuhal*, that for one thousand years, you... perform its *tadbir*, you be its king, of this realm. Of this entire realm. Meaning, whether it is the *'alam-e-ajram* (realm of celestial bodies) or the *'alam-e-mahw* (realm of erasure) or *sughra* (the lesser). He was given the order and the responsibility to rule over all of them. To whom? To *Zuhal*. For one thousand years. When the second thousand years began, then in the second thousand years, what will happen? The kingship will be of *Zuhal*, but *Zuhal* will not do it alone, it will not perform the *tadbir* of the realm alone, but its companionship will be there, it will provide assistance. Who? *Mushtari* (Jupiter). And after that *Zuhra* (Venus), *'Atarid* (Mercury), *Shams* (Sun), and similarly the *katib* and *na-katib* will come. And for one thousand years each, they will perform its vizierate, they will work under it. In this way, it has been said that 7000 years will pass in this manner. So when 7000 years are completed, then we will say that the *dawr* (cycle) of *Zuhal* has ended. Now, you understand this point, right? And in the same way, when these 7000 years are completed, then whose kingship will it be?

that is, it will establish Sri, and that daur, in the first thousand years, will become Sri. In the second thousand years, it will become. In the second thousand years, it will be a very difficult daur, it will go into the daur of the Prophet. In the third thousand years, that very one who is the wali will [unclear], and after the wali, the Sant will come. After the Sant, the now eighth seven-thousand-year daur will be completed. Whose daur will be completed? The Hukm. After the Hukm, the wali's daur will also be seven thousand years. After the Hukm, the Sant's daur will be seven thousand years. After the Sant, there will be a daur, there will be daras, there will be sabak. These seven times seven thousand years, how much is that? Seven sevens are forty-nine. A forty-nine-thousand-year period exists. And the reality is that it is a section of one thousand years or two thousand years. They calculate it in money. And just as within our day we have to do it again, we try, that is, one has to do eighty-four [unclear]. In the same way, there are matters here as well. And these forty-nine thousand years, in becoming so, became fifty-one thousand years. So a fifty-one-thousand-year period is called a major period. And the name of that entire period is what? It is called the name of Zohar. Whose beginning he had initiated. Although in the factory of Zohar and in the government of Zohar, and in the government of Zohar, the Zohri land, the Zohri thing, that used to run. When the Zohri, Zohri government used to run, but from the other side, the second government, when it is counted, it will be counted a lot. Zohar's government will be counted for fifty-one thousand years. You think, for fifty-one thousand years. And when fifty-one thousand years are complete, then Mushtari's government will start somewhere or the other. And periods of this kind are in the crores, innumerable, which we cannot even calculate. It's impossible. We cannot even calculate how many have passed already. Whose calculation is impossible. That has passed upon the world. And now, which sayyara is ruling at this time, that is a known matter. That is a known matter. Anyway, before telling that, I will tell you a matter concerning Imam al-Baqir, alayhi as-salatu was-salam. Someone came to Imam al-Baqir, alayhi as-salatu was-salam, and said, "O Maula, I had a request to make. I wanted to ask you one thing, you give the answer." He said, "You can ask everything." He said, and that person said, "O Maula, I want to know this thing: what is the age of the world? What is the age of the world, I want to know." The Imam said, because the Imam was asked, the Imam said, "Look, what the age of the world will be, it is not possible to say this. It is possible to say what the age of the world has been so far. How long man will remain, I am not going to tell you that, but how long he has been, I can tell you that. What has happened to the world until now, I can tell you that. Now, the calculation that was told to you, you should remember this calculation. And if you remember this calculation, then you will be worthy of listening to these lessons of realities. So that is what I want to explain to you. Look. What happens is that, just as Allah Ta'ala has placed day and night here. From the rotation of night and day, what happens? From the rotation of day and night, what happens? A week is formed. When seven days pass, one week is formed. When four weeks pass, it is a month. And when twelve months pass, it is a year, and when a hundred years pass, it is a qaran, it is a sadi. And when centuries pass then... so anyway, the meaning is that these are four measures that are present before you, and you count them; it's not that you don't count them, you do count. So when you count, in the same way, you have these four measures...

...we also have day and night. And the greatest thing is that with Allah Ta'ala also, there are night and day. Within the Deen as well, there are day and night. But, just as you would say that, "Brother, we generally, approximately, have a 12-hour day and a 12-hour night." No, it is not so. With Allah Ta'ala, it is different. You may have this. But if you look and go to other parts of the world, there the night will become so short, or the day will become so small. Sometimes, when you are in such countries... so you will have to understand that with nature [God's power] also, the duration of the *deenī* (religious) day and the duration of the *deenī* night are separate.

The duration of the *deenī* day is fifty thousand years. For this reason, it came in the Qur'an-e-Majeed: *khamsīna alfa sanah* (fifty thousand years). Fifty thousand years. Now, it is as if various personages are all sitting separately. And the circles are of fifty thousand years. So what is this? Which fifty thousand years is this? They cannot solve it. Somewhere Allah Ta'ala is saying that We... *fī sittati ayyāmin* (in six days), We created the world in six days. He is saying this. Somewhere He is saying that We have created its duration as fifty thousand years. Somewhere it is said, and the noble Nabī has stated, that the duration of this world is seven thousand years. So, will you accept the word of the Nabī, or will you accept the word of fifty thousand, or will you accept the word of six days? And you, by God, know that all these are true. All these are true. If they say six days, that too is correct. If the Paygambar says seven thousand, that too is correct. If they say fifty thousand, that too is correct. The day is of fifty thousand years; you had counted the duration of the day as fifty thousand of... the Hereafter. That duration of the day, the duration of the *deenī* day, is of fifty thousand.

Okay, now, the seven thousand years that the noble Nabī mentioned, that is the duration of the *daur-e-fitr* (period of veiling); it is the duration of the night. So, with God, the duration of the night is, how much? Seven thousand years. The *deenī* night is of seven thousand years, and the *deenī* day is of fifty thousand years. Now you tell me, the matter that remains is that the world was created for humans in six days. Allah Ta'ala says in the Qur'an-e-Majeed: *fī sittati ayyāmin* (in six days), He says it was created in six days. So the six... the six days in which it was created, it was created through six personalities. Who are they? Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, `Isa, and our Nabī Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa, sallallahu `alayhi wa sallam. These six Anbiyā' (Prophets), the period in which they came, is the *daur-e-fitr*. And this *daur-e-fitr*, how many years is it? Seven thousand years.

Now have you understood? The *daur-e-fitr* and the *daur-e-kašf* (period of unveiling). The *daur-e-kašf* of fifty thousand years was found, and seven thousand years came here. And this is, more or less, more or less... The day is of fifty thousand years, and the night is of how many thousand years? The night is of seven thousand years. So how many years was it? The world, both combined? It was fifty-seven thousand years. It was fifty-seven thousand years. But our Du'at, `alayhim al-salātu wa al-salām, even within this, they extracted a subtlety. And they explained that the time of twilight, of Maghrib (sunset), that is in this, is of three thousand years. And where do those three thousand years come from? From forty-seven thousand years.

When it ends, then after 45,000 years, the 3,000 years that remain out of 50,000 years, those 3,000 years are the time of *ṭawlānī wa maghribī*. And all of this combined became one *dīn* (day), and *dīn*, meaning the setting of the sun, is the name for the completion of the day. The sun set, now your night has begun. So when the night begins, how many years is that night? It is 60,000 years. Now, this night of 60,000 years and what happened in this night, and where is our Prophet Muhammad, where is the 60,000 mentioned—all these details about the *anbiyā'* (prophets) will come before you later, it will be written for you, and you will be able to read it. For now, what I have to tell you is from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, who was explaining the measure of the world. So he says that until you understand the scale, until you understand its principles, you will not be able to understand the details I present. So I was telling you that the duration of a *dīnī din* (religious day) is 45,000 years, and the duration of a *dīnī rāt* (religious night) is 60,000 years. And what is *qasr* called? What is the era of *suknī* called? What is *qayālah wa maghribī* called? That is 3,000 years. And when does that come? After 45,000 years have passed. Then what we call *jawṭash*... a *dīnī din* is called *jawṭash* and a *dīnī rāt* is called *jawshik*. So this is when it comes. So the entire day became how many years? It became 57,000 years. And if you take seven such days of 57,000 years, seven days pass, and that becomes a week, a *jaw*. And if you want to know its count, its duration, a *jaw* is 400,000 years long. I am telling you the correct figure. It is 400,000 years long, one *dawr*. And 400,000 such *dawr*s make one *kawr*. And 400,000 such *kawr*s make one *mawr*. Now calculate it. The duration of one *dawr* is 400,000 years. And when 400,000 such *dawr*s pass, that is one *kawr*. Meaning, in one *kawr*, there are 400,000 *dawr*s. And 400,000 such *kawr*s make one *mawr*. And one *mawr* of Adam has already passed upon this world. This world of ours, one *mawr* of Adam has finished upon it. Now, you can multiply and see how many billions, how many trillions of years there will be. One *mawr* of Adam—you cannot imagine it. You cannot count it. The number will not fit in your calculations. A *dawr* is 400,000 years, and 400,000 such *dawr*s make one *kawr*, and 400,000 *kawr*s make one *mawr*. And one *mawr* of Adam has passed upon it. And 399 *kawr*s have passed after that. 399 *kawr*s have passed. And we are in the last period of the final *dawr* of the first *kawr* of the 400th *kawr*. Are you following? Meaning... *Alhamdulillah*, a voice came asking to repeat it. *Alhamdulillah*, I had thought that you all were understanding and sitting attentively, so there was no need to repeat it. But since the matter of the duration of the world has been mentioned, it is necessary to repeat it. Yes...

...Shakhs and night... Allah. Listen now to the example of the day and the night. The night is 7,000 years long, which in our terminology is called a *Shakhs*. And a day is 50,000 years, which is called a *Kalf*. And within that same *Kalf* are *Fajr* and *Maghrib*, which is called *Maghrib*. And one day is 50,000 years, and from seven such days, one *Daur* is made, which our people call a *Daur*. And the duration of one *Daur* is 400,000 years. And one *Daur* is 400,000 years. And from 400,000 such *Daur*, one *Kaun* is made. And from 400,000 such *Kaun*, one *Maur* is made. Such 400,000 *Daur*. Look, in each *Daur* there are 400,000 years. And from 400,000 such *Daur*, one *Kaun* is made, and from 400,000 such *Kaun*, one *Maur* is made. And one *Maur-e-A'zam* (Great Maur) has already passed. And its mention is in the Quran under the chapter of Thamud. *Wa thamuda fa ma abqa* (And Thamud, He spared not). Allah Ta'ala states that this word 'Thamud' that has come, and the mention of *Daur* is also present somewhere. So in this way, *wa 'l-tur wa kitabin mastur* (By the Mount, and by a Book inscribed), this is the mention of *Kaun*. So, the mention of all things, you will find a reference for it in the Quran-e-Majeed and in Hadith. Understand this. So what we come to know is that one *Daur-e-A'zam*, that one *Maur-e-A'zam* has already passed. We are in the [unclear] of the second *Maur*. And we have the calculation for the second *Maur*. Of the second *Maur* as well, 399 *Daur* have passed. And we are sitting at the end of the first *Shakhs*, of the first *Daur*, of the 400th *Daur*. For it to [unclear]... to be completed, only a little time remains, a little time. Meaning approximately two books are done. Now, meaning, there are some moments, a few moments are left. The reality is that when Sayyidna Sulayman, alayhissalam... when he came here... our [view] is that he, at 1,000 years... 1,000 years had passed for the Prophet, alayhissalatu wassalam, at the 1,000th of the 1,000, you... are to arrive in the world. What happened at that time? The era of *Qiyamah* began. And the reality was that even the people of the earlier era were thinking, by then *Qiyamah* would have arrived. And it was as if it was a moving *qiyamah*. So *Qiyamah* was inevitable; in our view, that happened. But what happened was that, because here the duration is fixed that of the *Maur* and the *Kaun*... the son's son of the *Maur's* son's son, so its fractions were running. So due to those fractions, [unclear] have happened. From Sayyidna Sulayman until now, that was the era of the people of the *Daur-e-A'zam*. From the era of the people of the *Daur-e-A'zam* until now, approximately 400 years have passed. These 400 years that have passed, they have passed in [unclear]... meaning they have passed in correction. And the reality was that what people were saying in that era, we too are now sitting with [unclear], and our elders also state the same thing: it has come. It has come. It is not that it will come, they are saying now that it has come, they are saying it now. And they are saying that all the signs of *Qiyamah* have become visible. In this, the [era] of the Imam has begun, may Allah Ta'ala bring him, bring him. So you should understand that, I also [read] those same books... they come here and the appearance of the Imam-e-Zaman, alayhissalam, that will be a separate story, and how the advent of Imam Mahdi will be, and the tribulation of the Dajjal... all that, Insha'Allah, will come. So, anyway, what I had to tell you was that in the eras of all of these, this chain that is running, so according to each *daur*, the [period] of 7,000 years...

A cycle of 4,700,000 years, the *daur*, is what every prophet calls a *dunya*. And this 51,000-year *daur* is whose? It is the *daur* of Zuhal. The *daur* of Zuhal is 51,000 years long. And this is called the *daur-e-kabir*. This 4,700,000-year *daur* is called the *daur-e-saghir*. This *daur-e-saghir* is the *daur-e-kabir*. When we look at this, the *daur-e-saghir* that is running in our *dunya*, and the divisions of time within it—year, lunar and solar calendars—and your ten eras of a thousand years each, which are running, they are all, all of them, running according to this one system, this very system. So, in this *daur* that is running, countless *dunyas* have already passed. These are all prepared and ready, and they are revolving. And their 51,000-year cycles are ongoing. Now, currently, if you want to know, which *daur* are we in? It is one in which one man equals one vote. We are in the *daur* of Zuhal. The *daur* of Zuhal is running and it is about to end. Absolutely. It is such that just as a lamp, when it is about to go out, flickers... it is going out... it is going out... And as soon as it goes out, the *daur* of Mushtari will begin. When the *daur* of Mushtari begins, over here *Qayamat* will happen, the *amr* of *sutur* will end, and the *daur* of *kashf* will begin. All things will happen at once. Night will become day... night will end, morning will begin. And the effect of Zuhal will end, and the effect of Mushtari will begin. And all things will be established in their own place. So I was telling you that... So... I intended to explain the effects of Zuhal and so on, but the topic will become lengthy and difficult. Insha'Allah, I will try to be brief, explaining how the effects of Zuhal fell upon the world, how the effects of Mushtari fell upon this *dunya*, how the effects of Mirrikh fell, how the effects of Shams fell, and how the effects of Zohra, Utarid, and Qamar fell upon the world. But you should remember that Allah Ta'ala has made these heavenly bodies *asbab*. This world is a *dar al-a'mal*. There is a *dar al-jaza*. Nothing happens without a *sabab*. And the means for creating that *sabab* has been made through these heavenly bodies. These heavenly bodies create different conditions, due to which we see changes in the world. The changing of the atmosphere here, the changing of the seasons, the changing of dispositions, the coming of whirlwinds, the coming of storms, and the seasonal winds that blow—all these things that are happening, ostensibly they are from the heavenly bodies, but all these *asbab*... all... these are the two aspects of a flower. Just as there is a main switch... where has Allah Ta'ala placed the main switch? In the hands of the Imam-e-Waqt. It is in the hands of the Imam-e-Waqt. In whose possession is the body? That person is not a corpse. That thing is in his hands. Which Imam? The one who is in the Tabut, *kal-maslub* (like the crucified). That Imam. You do not consider anyone to be the Imam here.

...however great a scholar they may be, a learned person they may be, they cannot be the Imam. The Imam is the one who holds the register of Imam al-Zaman. It has one entry point and one exit point. It can neither enter nor can it come. Whatever has happened, has happened. The pen has dried. The ink of the pen has dried up. So where has this happened? So, the entire pivot of this destiny is placed in just one entity. In whom has it been placed? In the Imam. So the Imam, who is in the circle of glory, in this world, where is it that he opens a switch? Where is it that he turns something on and off? It is in the Khanah Ka'bah. The Holy Khanah Ka'bah is such that it is not just for all the world, but for all the worlds. *Hudal-lil-'alamin*. *Inna awwala baytin wudi'a lin-nasi lalladhi bi-bakkata mubarakan wa-hudal-lil-'alamin* (Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Bakkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds).

The very first house that was made… we have a doorkeeper. That is our doorkeeper. It's very good. That is our doorkeeper. We are its doorkeepers. This is just the external matter. If you want to be a doorkeeper, then be the doorkeeper of those who are, in reality, the symbol of the Holy Ka'bah, who are its Imam. This is why, as the Quran Majeed says, the Imam has been mentioned. There, Allah Ta'ala has stated, *wa kulla shay'in ahsaynahu fi imamin mubin* (and all things We have accounted for in a clear Imam/register). We have… all things… Look at the words of the Quran. We have encompassed all things in an Imam. We have encompassed all the universes in an *Imam Mubin*. Meaning, that being who is the Imam has encompassed all the universes.

A human being is one who contains the essence of mountains and plants and minerals and this and that… A human is called the macrocosm. So if this is the condition of a human, then the "complete man" who has been addressed as the "believing man," who is supernatural, who is supreme, what would be the state of that Imam? That he has encompassed all the universes. To understand one Imam, you will have to study the entire universe. It is not a trivial matter. If you want to understand one Imam, then I will give you a test. You think that by knowing two or three things, you can say anything. What is the highest thing and what is the lowest thing? With one Imam, the lowest thing, from that point... when you have information, then you will have information. Those who have it, have it. Those who don't, won't. The lowest thing is the *hijab-e-juz'i*. After that comes the *hijab-e-kulli*. After that comes *natiq-e-kulli*. And above *natiq-e-kulli* is *natiq-e-juz'i*. Above *natiq-e-juz'i* is *natiq-e-khas*. Above *natiq-e-khas* is the *surat-e-Imam*. Above *surat-e-Imam* is the *haykal-e-Imam*. And above *haykal-e-Imam* is the *haykal-e-imaniyyah*, and above that comes the *haykal-e-ka'iniyyah*. And above both of them is... the... *natiq-e-kulli*. Above *natiq-e-kulli* is the Imam whose...

What is it? The family of *da'wah*, the family of repentance, and above the family of repentance is the *nazar* (gaze) of the Imam. You should separate it. Each one's definition is different. Its religious character is different, its information is different. What is the *nazar* of the Imam? And below the *nazar* of the Imam is the family of *da'wah*, what is that? Below the family of *da'wah* is the level of reward, what is that? What are the *sawabit* (fixed principles)? What is the *saabit* (established)? And below that, what are the lineages of the *da'is*? And below that, what are the *Imami* and *Qa'imi*? And below that, you will see that... the *zaat* (essence) of the Imam comes. And that is what is called the *hissiyat* (sensory faculty) of the Imam. And that *hissiyat* of the Imam is below the *zaat* of the Imam. Which thing? The essence of the heart, after that the essence of... the vein of the heart, below that is the vein of the liver, below the vein of the liver is the reproductive essence, and below the reproductive essence is the essence of... the reproductive essence. This is what... I am telling you the broad, general levels. By God, reflect on this. One *zaat* of the Imam has encompassed these seven things. So in one place in the ninth *para* (section of the Quran), Allah Ta'ala says, *"Wa kulla shai'in ahsainahu fi imamim mubeen"* (And everything We have enumerated in a clear Imam/register). We have encompassed seven things in the Imam-e-Mubeen, We have surrounded them. And right there He says, twisting it, they say, *"Wa la ratbin wa la yabisin illa fi kitabin mubeen"* (And no moist or dry thing but is (recorded) in a clear Book). There is no arrangement of anything, but it is present in this *kitab-e-mubeen* (clear book). The Quran-e-Majeed is dominant over all things. The Quran is the book of Allah, it is the final book, it is the constitution of life, and it is the very last constitution. It has encompassed all things. By seeing it. So for every single thing, just as everything is present in the Quran, in the same way, the Imam is in the position of *"kulla shai'in ahsainahu fi imamim mubeen"* (everything We have enumerated in a clear Imam/register), for he has encompassed all things and holds them within himself. We just have to... know, we have to understand how he has encompassed them and how all these things are connected. So, *insha'Allah* (God willing), many things will come before you. For now, you should understand that the *akhlaq* (ethics) which I... this is from *Zahr al-Ma'ani*, *Qutb al-Sharee'ah*, and this *Kanz al-Walad* and *Saqib al-Shabab*—how they, in their respective eras, were present and how they undertook teaching, and how they taught, it will all come before you.

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 12 -->

I told you yesterday that we had explained how the physical world (`'ālam-i jismānī`) was formed from the secondary matter (`hayūlā-i thāniyah`), and how the heavens (`aflāk`) were made. The first was the encompassing sphere (`falak-i muḥīṭ`), and below the encompassing sphere was the sphere of the zodiac (`falak-i burūj`), and below the sphere of the zodiac are Saturn (`Zuḥal`), Jupiter (`Mushtarī`), Mars (`Mirrīkh`), the Sun (`Shams`), Venus (`Zuhrah`), Mercury (`'Aṭārad`), and the Moon (`Qamar`). With these seven planets (`sayyārāt`), seven heavens (`aflāk`) were made. So in total, nine spheres (`falak`) were made. And after the nine spheres, I had told you that the `ummahāt` (mothers) were made: water, fire, wind, and earth (`āb-o-ātish-o-bād-o-khāk`). And after the `ummahāt`, `Ṣakhrah` was made, and it is the solid part of the earth. And then the `jawf` (abyss) was made. And what was this `jawf` made for? It was made as a prison (`qaid-khānah`). A very large prison was made. Although, when someone is put on "remand," it is a small prison where prisoners are brought from the court and held for a short time. And there is also a large prison. So there is a small prison and a large prison. This is the large prison where prisoners are kept and where they are given their punishment. But there is also a small prison, and *Insha'Allah* (God willing), its mention will come up shortly.

So, the point was to tell you that whether it be the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir` (doubter and perplexed), the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir` (insistent and arrogant), or the `nādim-o-mustaghfir` (repentant and seeking forgiveness), all of them were expended, and all of them were completely used up in this. Meaning, the penal world (`jurmānī 'ālam`) that was created, a whole shining, glittering world, all of it... the repentant ones (`nādimīn`) were completely finished within it, the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir` were finished in the `ummahāt`, and the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir` were all finished in this.

But now, it was upon Allah Ta'ala that... the first are the first... `al-sābiqūn al-sābiqūn, ūlā'ika hum al-muqarrabūn` (The forerunners, the forerunners, those are the ones brought near). Those who are first are first, those who are forerunners are forerunners, and they are the ones who attain nearness. So, those who took the initiative, meaning those who were inclined towards the `da'wat ilā Allah` (call towards God), or those who were quick to be in doubt, or those who were quick to insist, for their intentions to be manifested here, to make them manifest, was obligatory upon the divine power. That they should be manifested in that same order. And the Lord is an `'ādil-i ḥakīm` (Just, Wise); with Him there is no injustice, `na'ūdhubillāh` (we seek refuge in Allah). He is Just, and He is one who does justice. Injustice is defined as `waḍ' al-shay' fī ghayr maḥallih` (placing a thing in other than its proper place). And justice is defined as placing a thing in its correct place. Now, if you came first, you are first. If you came later, then later. To perform this justice is obligatory upon Him, the Lord of the Worlds. And He is doing it.

For Him to do this—to create all the believers first and not create the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`, not create the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`—that cannot be. It cannot happen like that. The `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir` must also be created, and the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir` must also be created, and the `nādim-o-mustaghfir` must also be created. For all of them to come into the manifest world, to come into this world, is necessary for all. And just as they took initiative there, they must be brought here in the same way; it was necessary upon the divine power. That is why Allah Ta'ala did what? He made these moving celestial bodies (`kawākib-i sayyārāt`) and the fixed celestial bodies (`kawākib-i thābitah`) in the zodiac (`burūj`), and the moving celestial bodies (`kawākib-i sayyārāt`) in the spheres (`aflāk`), creating the spheres and making them float. And they, by casting their effects, pull from the minerals (`ma'dan`), create plants (`nabāt`), and create animals (`ḥaywān`), and from the animal, a reflection comes forth as a human being in this world.

So there are three kingdoms: mineral (`ma'dan`), vegetable (`nabāt`), and animal (`ḥaywān`). Minerals, vegetables, and animals. And one type of animal is what is called human. All of these should be created, and after being created, they should be given intellect (`'aql`), and by using intellect, what should they do? They should arrange to be free from this world. See, intellect (`'aql`), as I said, is a thing that cannot work alone. Although it is a substance (`jawhar`). As it has been said, what does it know of good and evil (`khayr-o-bad`)? Iqbal says that the intellect has no knowledge of good and evil. So, the reality is that the greatest work to be taken from this intellect is that the intellect which is being sent from Allah Ta'ala, its teachings should be accepted, then that would be a matter of intellect. So, through the teaching of both, we can attain freedom from here.

In any case, the divine power had made this arrangement, and for all of us, it had done justice—for the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`, `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`, and `nādim-o-mustaghfir`, it did this for all. And first of all, it gave the planets (`sayyārāt`) all the senses, natures, and the ability to cast effects from above to below, making them into instruments, making them into complete instruments, it manifested them.

Now, these instruments have apparently come as compelled instruments, but now... it would be premature... but let me state that you should not see these planets (`sayyārāt`) merely as planets. These are huge platforms, and they are useful for many things. The moon is a platform for many things, the sun is for many things, Jupiter is, Venus is, Mercury is... these are various functions that they are performing in this world. In any case, all those things will come before you. In any case, they are performing these duties. But now, in the universe, when Allah Ta'ala first created this physical world, and this world of water and clay (`āb-o-gil`), this large universe stood before us, at that time, how were the `mawalīd-i thalāthah` (the three kingdoms) created? This will be the first topic that we have to explain.

`Mawalīd-i thalāthah`, meaning mineral (`ma'dan`), vegetable (`nabāt`), and animal (`ḥaywān`)—these are the children of the heavens and the earth. How did they come into this world? How did man come?
