How did animal come? How did plant come? How were minerals formed? It is necessary to know this, and I am presenting its detailed explanation before you.

First of all, what happened was that the Lord of the Worlds... what is meant by the Lord? The `'āshir-i mudabbir-i ḥakīm` (the tenth, the wise planner), who is the final individual of the `lubb-i nidā` (the essence of the call). The final individual of the `lubb-i nidā`, what did he do? In his thought, the very first thing that came to his mind was that he was thinking, "How am I to work in this world?" If we think even a little about a house, or a shop, or about our profession, we just keep thinking. But this one was thinking about the universe! So you can understand what the state of his thought must have been. He was just like us! He was just like us, but between you and me and him, there is a difference of heaven and earth. And what did he do then? The very first thought he had was that those who are falling from there, who have to be manifested as human beings, in what kind of cage should I bring them? In what kind of bondage should I bring them, such that they can also live, face death, they may also be afflicted with illnesses for punishment, there should be flexibility in them, and in them there should be... there should be air, there should be earth, there should be water, there should be fire, they should have a fiery nature, they should have taste (`zawq`), conscience (`wijdān`), intellect (`'aql`), consciousness (`shu'ūr`), they should have instinct (`jibillat`), and they should have feelings (`iḥsāsāt`), a network of veins, heat—how should I create them, replete with everything? This power was contemplating to create one human being. But countless blueprints were emerging, countless thoughts were coming to him about it. But the power was getting tired and was saying, "I am thinking about man, but in terms of action, I will create him last."

"In terms of action, I will create him at the very end, because I have to do a lot of work on this. I have to do a lot of work on it." Who was thinking this? The `'āshir-i mudabbir-i ḥakīm`. Although from the First Intellect down to the lower circles, all the intellects were watching him and giving him support. Meaning, their watching, their hand upon his head... You say, "Your shadow is enough." "Just place your hand on our head, that's enough." So what is that? It is an encouragement (`ḍhāras`). So that encouragement and those supports, those emanations, those divine things, he was continuously receiving them, but he was the one working alone, he was the only one. He alone was taking all the initiatives, he was taking them alone. That is why when Allah... the `mudabbir` had created man in this universe, you see the Quran mentions it: `fatabāraka Allāhu aḥsan al-khāliqīn` (So blessed is Allah, the best of creators). Blessed is that Allah who is the best of the creators. Why `khāliqīn` (creators)? Why did He say `khāliqīn`? He said it for this reason, that there are many there who can create. To bring into physical form and create, many can do this. Above him also there are many intellects. So the word that has come there is `khāliqīn` (creators), not `khāliq` (creator). Among the creators, the best of creators. Because he created it, for this reason he is called blessed.

In any case, now that Lord of the Worlds' first thought was man, but in terms of action, what happened? The creation of man happened at the very end. Now he contemplated that if I am to bring man, then it is obvious that in his mind this thing came, that minerals should come first, and after minerals there should be another stage, which should be of plants, and after plants there should be a stage which we call animals, and after animals there should be a stage, a branch of it, of animals, which we call man. If I bring them in this order, it will be correct. This is what he thought.

Minerals should be those that are inanimate, that neither have growth nor the power to grow, nor sensation, nor the power to feel. It should be such an inanimate thing, but a thing that is useful to humans. And if it comes out of its inanimateness and into growth, then it is called growing (`nāmiyah`), and it should be something that sprouts, but not something that walks. A thing should be made that sprouts. And after that, another stage should come, that which walks and moves, but does not have speech, in the apparent sense of speaking, it should not have that, but it should be a mere animal. It should exist. And after that, another stage of it should be made, and that should be man, he should come in an upright stature, such a stature he should have, that just as our stature is there... In the world of eternity, it is in an erect state, a standing condition. Such should be the condition of these humans. But, you should consider that if we were to be told now to create a human, and there is no human form before you, you see what our condition would be in creating it.

Sometimes we would make a giant, sometimes we would make him very small, like the Lilliputians they would become very small, or they would become very big like jinn, and it would become a land of giants. Our condition would be very strange. So similarly, God, this stature of man that we see today, how must that stature have come upon his high mind, and how must he have thought? Because the First Cause did not create this. The First Cause created us as spirits, created us in the essence of a soul. And this one is binding us in the essence of a body, in a cage. He is putting us into physicality, and in cages... he is imprisoning us in cages. What kind of cage should it be? What kind of condition should it be? That it can see some things, smell some things, hear some things, and hands and feet can feel, can sense. Intellect and wisdom should also shine in the brain, feet should also start working. To contain all these functions within one body and create it, this was the work of the Lord of the Worlds. It was his decree, and he was doing it. It was the perfection of the Lord of the Worlds that he created such a flexible, such a perfectly statured man, which came into his mind, the mind of the `'āshir-i mudabbir-i ḥakīm`.

So, it is apparent that this man who came to his mind, and he created him at the very end, but he created minerals first. So, since the first stage for him, in terms of creation, was mineral, after that plant, after that animal, so in this regard, what did he do? The order that he gave within the celestial bodies was also of this same kind. The first thing I told you was that see, Saturn (`Zuḥal`) and Mars (`Mirrīkh`) are in the station of the feet. The sun is in the station of the heart, and the moon is in the station of the brain. This was an inverted impression of man; it is an inverted impression so that because of it, the stamp will come out straight and humans will be born here. So this was also a wisdom that was working for Allah Ta'ala. But what did he do? Saturn (`Zuḥal`), and Jupiter (`Mushtarī`), and Mars (`Mirrīkh`)—these planets, he said that now you will rule over the universe as governors. For one thousand years each, for one thousand years you will rule alone, and in the second thousand years, you will have assistance, you will have the help of the other planets. But, you, Saturn (`Zuḥal`), had the command that in your time, only minerals will be formed. Plants and animals cannot come. And Jupiter (`Mushtarī`) had the command that in your time, only plants will come. Minerals, of course, you can also bring, but with minerals, plants will also come. And Mars (`Mirrīkh`) had the command that in your time, animals will also come.

And after that, all the planets that were there, they had the command that in your time, mineral, plant, all will come. And all the planets had the command that yes, yes, our ultimate goal is, our ultimate purpose is to create man, and we want all the planets to work on this, to work on it, and to create the leaven (`khamīrah`) of man. To ferment (`takhmīr`), just as before making bread you ferment it, you make a leaven, so that kind of fermentation should happen in every era. So now see, first of all, Saturn (`Zuḥal`) reigned, and Saturn was given a reign of one thousand years. For one thousand years, Saturn was given the reign, and in those one thousand years, what did Saturn do? He started to make it rain upon this universe. The first thing he did was this.

What is the universe like? There are no houses, no inhabitants, no trees, no animals, no minerals, no plants, there is nothing. Neither the sun is shining, nor the moon is shining, nor are there stars, nothing. It is a desolate, silent world. In that world, it is raining. And by whose command is it raining? Saturn's. Saturn is making it rain, and it is raining incessantly. Why? Because its nature was of a certain kind, because it is an inauspicious (`naḥs`) star. So it was compelled by its nature, and it made it rain. And you will say, why did Allah Ta'ala do it like this? The Lord of the Worlds wanted something. Something was in his plan that the matter should be like this. What happens is that such disarray is necessary to create something. If you want to take stock of a shop and set it up properly, you first take everything out and make a pile of the goods. Why do you make a pile, sir? You say, "I am making a pile to arrange it." So, in exactly the same way, if such things are happening, you should not look at it with wonder.

In any case, Saturn first worked on the minerals, and in his time, he thought that I should create the minerals. So in the minerals, the stony minerals, for example, the bad types of... `selu`... there are various types of stones that we find. These types of stones. And bad types of metals, for example, iron. This type of mineral, those minerals started to form in its time. See, I am telling you, it is possible that your mind may not have gone to it, but you must keep this thought in your mind, that the power that is pulling the ether, it is not just pulling from below. It is not taking from the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`, but it is also taking from the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`, and it is also taking from the `nādim-o-mustaghfir`. From the `nādim-o-mustaghfir`, meaning the storage of the believers, it is taking from that as well. And from the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`, who are the `ummahāt`, it is taking from that as well. And from the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`'s storage, it is taking from that as well.

So what does that mean? That in minerals, there are good minerals as well, which can be from the repentant ones. There can be intermediate types of minerals as well, which can be related to the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`. Minerals can be bad as well, which can be related to the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`. Since this star is somewhat related to the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`, it chose the minerals according to its nature, and in its time, such minerals were gathered. Meaning, what is meant by "minerals forming"? It means gathering their parts and putting them in one place. That which the eternal distributor of fate gave to each, whatever he saw fit. Whoever was capable of whatever, was kept in that capacity. So, those parts in the solid hollow of the earth which were capable of whatever, those parts were gathered and put in one place, and mines were formed—of what? Of iron, and of bad types of stones. In this way, the minerals were formed in the time of Saturn.

The first thing I told you was that it rained tremendously. The second thing is that he did this with the minerals. Plants and animals were not his work; he remained silent on this. Besides minerals, he did not touch plants and animals. Now remains the fourth thing, and that is man. He was entrusted with the task concerning man that the leavens of all should be gathered in one place. So, since this is an inauspicious (`naḥs`) star, according to its nature—as the spirit, so the angels—so according to its nature, what did it do? It started to gather the parts of such people, started to make leavens. See, it didn't create man. It didn't create man, but rather, I am saying leaven (`khamīr`). Just as you make and keep dough, you leaven it, in the same way, it did the fermentation (`takhmīr`). And it brought such parts close that were in accordance with its nature. And who were they? The people of wretchedness and rejection (`ahl al-shaqāwa wa al-nakad`). The wretched ones, who create much corruption on the earth, and who reject, who don't accept anything, "we will never do this." So such rejecting and wretched, hard-hearted people, such people's... Now in hard-heartedness, `illā mā shā' Allāh` (except what Allah wills), it is possible that they may be from the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`, it is possible they may be from the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`. Whoever they may be from, he gathered the parts of such hard-hearted people and put them in one place, and those places remained safe within the world.

The earth... just as a gardener of a garden, when he plants a garden, he makes various flowerbeds. If you ask him, "Sir, what are you going to do?" he will say, "Sir, here I am going to plant vegetables, here I will plant a flowering shrub, here I will plant such-and-such." But you see, neither flowers nor vegetables nor anything has been planted yet, but he says, "I am adding manure, sir, and in a few days, in this season, everything will be ready." So just as a gardener of a garden cultivates and prepares his garden, in exactly the same way, this creator of the universe was doing, and this irrigation was happening.

So when Saturn began its preparations, a thousand years were spent, and it put the minerals... some in their place... the minerals that were compatible with its nature, those minerals, as I said, some of a stony kind, some of an iron kind of minerals, were formed in its time. And the people of wretchedness and the people of rejection, just as the name is taken of the Sudanese people... you will say, where did Sudan suddenly come from? But what can be done? When our elders have named it, we have no objection in naming it. What will happen is that since Africa is such a place, and this whole belt is such that slavery came from here, where capturing humans, treating a human like an animal, that came from here. So this, it is apparent that some of their calculations were so bad, they themselves were of such a kind that they would be captured like animals. They would be captured like beasts. So the leavens of such people were also made in its time. This work happened in the time of Saturn, and a thousand years were completed, and as soon as they were completed, Jupiter (`Mushtarī`) came to its assistance, came to its aid.

Now, the minister is who? Jupiter. The king is who? Saturn. Just as even today the king's power is less and the minister's power is more, there too the minister's power was more. Now what did Jupiter do? According to its nature, the first thing it did was, "Brother, how much extravagance is going on? The treasury needs to be filled." It imposed income tax and sales tax. So immediately, this is exactly what Jupiter did. It stopped the tremendous rains that were happening in the time of Saturn. The rains stopped, and in its time, many ditches formed in the earth, and mountains were formed. It is possible that the Himalayas were also formed at this very time. So in any case, many mountains were prepared in its time, many mountains were formed. And... this kind of things... and the atmosphere became very clear. The heavy rains that were happening, it stopped those rains too, and the rains became moderate.

This was a celestial body, Jupiter's, which Allah Ta'ala had bound, that in your time, plants will also grow. Which minerals did he pay attention to? Jupiter did. But under whose rule? Under Saturn's rule. The rule is Saturn's, but the assistance is his, the ministry is his. So he had the full authority of his ministry, and he did it. And what did he do? In the minerals, the things that were compatible with it, those things of its nature, it started to gather those minerals in one place. And what did its nature want? It was a very noble star, a very good star. It took the things of its nature, which would be useful for men and women, and that was silver and gold. Silver and gold started to be gathered in its time, and they started to come together in one place. In the hollow of this earth. And the minerals were being prepared. In whose time? Jupiter's.

After the minerals, this kind of... and there will be other minerals too, but I am just giving you an example, as it has been said. Just understand this kind of minerals, that are good but not very good. Just okay. Such minerals it made. And after the minerals, when it turned its attention to the plants, then in the plants, `khazrā`... you understand well, vegetables. Vegetables and the like, which are lawful (`halāl`) things, which you eat, this kind of things started to grow in its time. They started to grow. In whose time? Jupiter's time. And to create animals was not in its hands; it remained silent. And to make the leaven of humans was certainly imposed on it, and it started to make leavens. And whose leavens did it make? The leavens of the religious people were made in its time.

Now who came among the religious? Whether they be among Muslims, whether they be among infidels, whether they be among idolaters, or in any religion, but those who are very religious, who are very observant of their religion, the leavens of such people started to be made in its time. It was not necessary that religious people should only be among the believers, and not among the infidels or the polytheists, it's not like that. Whoever of whatever nation they may be. But their pious people, their righteous people, good people, who are not going to create corruption in the world, and who have the fear of Allah, who believe in God, such people, who are not atheists, who do not deny God, the leavens of such people started to be gathered in its time—of the chaste people, of the people of virtue, of the people who have shame and modesty, and who have great fear of Allah. He gathered their parts, and the chaste people started to gather in one place in the time of Jupiter.

After Jupiter, Mars (`Mirrīkh`) came. In the third thousand years, Mars became the helper of whom? Of Saturn. Now what is it? A minister like that, a king like that. The king like that, the minister sir like this. What kind of king? Saturn. And what kind of minister sir is Mars? Don't even ask. Even more... bitter gourd on a neem branch. Now this was a calamity. Now when both of them met, the king said it should be this bad, he said if it becomes even worse, what's the harm? Make it even worse. Now when both of them started to rule, the universe faced a very bad situation. First of all, what did it do? It said that all these mountains and things that have formed, they should all break and be shattered into pieces.

Now in its time, some such things started to happen that they were shattering into pieces. Now whether you consider them earthquakes or whatever you consider, rains... some such rains started to happen, earthquakes started to happen, something started to happen by which the mountains were shattering, breaking, a strange commotion was happening in this universe. There were no eyes to see, there were no humans, nor animals. In its time, it brought these things into the state of the atmosphere. Now after that, it turned its attention to the minerals. Since its nature is inauspicious (`naḥs`), bad, it first turned its attention to which mineral? Coal. Coal, and all the bad metals, copper, brass, bronze, the lower-grade metals, the mines of those metals, in its time, were gathered and the mines were formed. The mines were all prepared. In the crust of this earth. The parts were gathered and came together.

And in the plants that it created, they were in accordance with its nature, meaning its own nature was like that and Saturn's nature was also like that. Now the bad nature of both... so the first trees that it grew, they were `thohar` (Euphorbia). `Senh`, which is called cactus. Cactus, which is the worst, its root is planted in hell, that is the branch of those trees. So that tree of hell, which is called cactus, which we... consider very beautiful, because there is pleasure even in evil. Well, what can be done about it? In any case, those trees which were bad, and `sunbul` (hyacinth), which are poisonous, and `senh`, and this kind of trees, they started to grow in its time. They were created. In whose time? In the time of Mars (`Mirrīkh`).

Now, since this is the third one, and it is necessary for it to turn its attention to the animals, because it was mandated from the `ashir` that animals should come in its time. So, since its nature is bad, and the king is also bad, which animals did it create first? It created the `hasharāt al-arḍ` (insects/creeping things of the earth). `Hasharāt al-arḍ`, meaning scorpions, snakes, rats, which crawl on their bellies. Such animals were created in its time. Now you will say, how were they created? You haven't explained that. So I am leaving this just as the author of the book has left it, for this reason, so that when the creation of humans comes, you will understand that they too were created in the same way as humans were created. That explanation will come. In any case, since humans were created from wombs, you should understand that these too were created from some wombs, and they were created first. It is not difficult for us, that problem which always goes on, whether the chicken came first or the egg. It is not a difficult problem. It is easy.

And these were the first to be... the crawling animals, and the bad animals, that came in its time. And the reality was that not just this, but also `sibā'`, meaning predatory beasts, those with claws and fangs, those animals also came into being in its time. Lion, cheetah, and bear, this kind of animals which are very ferocious, which oppress humans and are very bad animals, those wicked animals also came in its time. Whose? Mars'. Mars and Saturn, because both of them were bad. So they did this kind of things in the universe.

Now, I told you that mineral happened, plant happened, and after that animal happened. Now after animal is man. And in man, the leavens of which humans... man is not being created yet. To make a leaven, to sift and keep, to make plots, to separate, this was the work of the planets. And in its time, in the time of Mars, the leaven of which humans was to be made? What did it do? It saw that those in the world who are murderers, executioners, who wield swords, throw spears, shoot arrows, take life, and who feel happy after taking a life, such people... you will say, my God, Allah knows... but it's apparent that Allah knew. When we were falling, we had already made our intentions. Our intentions were imprinted. In fact, in our record room, our entire record was noted and had gone. So all those things... such people who are executioners, who are corrupt, who are wretched, who are hard-hearted, and who are very violent, and this kind of humans, the leavens of these corrupt people, in its time, in the time of Mars, started to form. They were made.

After Mars, came the Sun (`Shams`). The Sun has been granted sovereignty forever. Usually... I mean, the sovereignty is still Saturn's, and in Saturn's plan, now they are assisting, and they are helping one star at a time, but the eternal, permanent sovereignty, who has it? The sun has it. Because the sun, among all the planets, is the most... world-illuminating sun. So what can be said? It is the king. It has the kingship forever. So when it came to assist with Saturn, first of all, what did it do? The harshness and badness of Saturn's nature, and the things that Saturn and Mars had done, it tried to end those things. And it created such an atmosphere, which was a moderate atmosphere, a good atmosphere. And with its heat and its warmth, the desolation that had befallen the earth, the mist that had gathered, the fog, it cleared all that haze and with great beauty, it washed and cleaned the face of the earth's condition. Who? The sun.

And it turned its attention first to the minerals. In its time, the minerals that were formed were rubies, emeralds, and not just this, but all the nine gems, and good... jewels. Rubies and emeralds and this kind of... all these jewels came into being in its time, except for the diamond. The diamond did not come. The diamond, although it is a very precious metal, the most precious metal, but its coming into existence happened in the time of Mars.

Now, why did this happen like this? Why the diamond... because look, emerald is eaten in medicines, ruby is eaten in medicines. Just try eating a diamond. You tell me what will happen. Death will occur, that's all. So it is known that it's not just this about the diamond, but its properties are also... it's very beautiful, extremely good, very lovely, the most lovely, very good, everything is there, but it is very bad. So, why does it happen like this? That... *Insha'Allah*, its detailed explanation will come. In any case, the point was that the people in the world, the great ones among the polytheists and the infidels, who perform great services to humanity, who establish great governments, like Indira Gandhi, like Nehru, like Gandhi, the bones of such people, when they are cleared in this world, when they are finished, then those bones, with the divine power, become these diamonds and these jewels. The divine power takes them to a high place. Meaning, it doesn't throw them away because they are infidels or polytheists. Rather, from them, these diamonds are formed. Because they are very precious, and they are very beautiful, because the reward for their services must be given to them. Just as from the bones of our `du'at`, `hujjat`s, and `abwāb`, rubies and emeralds and such things are formed, or pearls and corals, `lu'lu' wa marjān`, are formed, from them this kind of things are formed.

Well, so the point was that since it is the king, the minerals that are useful to kings, meaning jewels, of which kings are fond... who recognizes a jewel? Either the king does or the jeweler does. `Shāh dānad yā ba-dānad jawharī` (The king knows, or the jeweler knows). The jeweler does, or the king does. Only two do. So that is why this is a kingly thing, a royal thing. And it is obvious that in royal treasuries there are jewels. So since it was the king itself, it turned its attention to the jewels, and such... such jewels were formed in its time. And it also created pearls and corals from the seas. Who? The sun.

And the second thing the sun turned its attention to was the plants. First, the minerals were made. After the minerals, the plants. In the plants, it saw, which plant should I create? So, since it itself is the king, and a royal thing needed to be created, all the fruits—grapes, apples, pomegranates, and figs—all these kinds of fruits, in its time, such trees started to grow and flourish. In whose time? The sun's time. And fruit-bearing trees started to come. In the time of the sun. Now when it created the plants, after the plants, its attention turned to the animals. In the animals, it... according to its own will, which was in accordance with its nature, it brought such animals into this universe which were permitted, lawful (`halāl`), and were very useful to humans: the camel, the cow, and the goat. Which we have the command to slaughter and we eat them too. Camels, cows, and goats, which were created, came at this very time. Who's? The sun's time. They came in the sun's time.

And now the leavens have to be made. Since it is the king itself, many kingdoms have existed in the world, many dictatorships have existed. Monarchy has been very prevalent. So such people whose dynasties continued, and who ruled as kings, or who lived in the world as dictators, the leavens of such people started to gather in one place—of kings. Nadir also came, and within that, also came... like the great kings, and Charles also came, and others came, the leavens of all of them started to gather in one place. It gathered the leavens of the kings in one place. Who? The sun.

After the sun, now after the fourth star, which was the fifth star? Venus (`Zuhrah`), Mercury (`'Aṭārad`), and the Moon (`Qamar`). Venus (`Zuhrah`)... came. In its... which? In the fifth thousand years, it is assisting whom? Saturn. The kingdom is Saturn's, the assistance is whose? Venus's. The star Venus is a very beautiful star, and it is considered a very lovely star among all the planets. And it is a very beautiful star, and its temperament is also very delicate. It is called a very delicate-tempered planet. When it came to its ministry, it started its work according to its nature. First of all, in the minerals, it started to create the shiny minerals. Meaning, mica, platinum, this kind of shiny metals, in its time, they started to be made. In the time of Venus. In the time of Venus, many shiny metals came, and as I have mentioned mica before you, or platinum, this kind of metals came in its time.

And after the minerals, when it turned its attention to the plants, since its nature wanted a certain kind of temperament, according to that temperament, all the flowers were created in its time. Wherever the flowers were, every kind of flower was in its time. In the time of Venus. And with the flowers, it then turned its attention to the fact that animals also have to be made. So all the birds, all the birds were in its time. Because the divine power has given color to most birds, has given them form, and it was in accordance with its nature, and for this reason, all the birds that were created, all flew in its time, were made, flew, were created and flew. In whose time? In the time of Venus.

Venus, as its nature wanted, it now turned its attention to humans, because the leavens have to be made. So, according to its nature, it saw that now... which... its nature wanted... although Saturn has the presidency, and this is its ministry, but according to its nature, it... all the women who were to come into the world, all their leavens, all the women's leavens, were made in the time of Venus. And all the Arabs' leavens were also made at this time. Now you will say, what is this connection with the Arabs? You could have connected anyone, we would have accepted it, but this connection with the Arabs will not sit well with us. But what can be done? You don't leave Kuwait, or the Arabs don't leave. So, in any case... all the Arabs who were there, all those Arabs' leavens... it is surprising, but what can be done, what happened, happened. The pen has dried after writing what was written. The plan of the planner of the universe, that plan is this. I mean, there must be some relationship with women, there must be some such matter. Now, to open up and explain these relationships is a bit difficult. In any case, there were some connections that were established with the Arabs, of the women, so the leavens of all the Arabs, they... where were they made? In this time of Venus, these leavens were made, of all the women and all the Arabs, the leavens... Venus.

And another thing happened, that in the time of Venus, as I told you that at some time the atmosphere is a certain way, at some time it rains, at some time the rains stop, at some time mountains are formed, at some time they are shattered. This was such a good time for it that in its time, many springs gushed forth. On the earth, many springs gushed forth, and a very good, moderate atmosphere was established, and such an atmosphere was established that one would just want to take a holiday and go on a holiday. Go for a walk. And it created this kind of atmosphere, according to its nature.

Now after Venus, which star was it? This was the last star, I mean the sixth star, from our perspective, and that sixth star, in the sixth thousand years, came to assist whom? Saturn. And in the sixth thousand years, what did it do? This star is called... Mercury (`'Aṭārad`) is called the `munshi-i falak` (scribe of the heavens). `Munshi-i falak` it is called. And as soon as Mercury came to its place, it, according to its nature, first turned its attention to the minerals. And in the minerals, it touched the intermediate type of minerals. The intermediate type of... the chemicals, which are very useful to humans, such things, it... many chemicals were formed in its time. Minerals. After the minerals, its attention was towards the plants. In the plants, such plants were made which were neither very good nor... a moderate kind of plants, for example, neem. Neem is very useful. For example, crotons, or some such trees which are of an intermediate kind, which are useful to humans, but they don't bear much fruit and the like. So the intermediate kind of trees, such trees and plants grew in its time.

And when it turned its attention to the animals, it turned its attention to the intermediate kind of animals. And in its time, donkeys came, mules came, such animals which were of an intermediate kind, were created in its time. They were created. And they were all from wombs. And it is obvious that the plants were in their place, the minerals were there. So these, all the planets, you are seeing that they are all doing their work. Now what was all this? This was a prelude of six thousand years, that the advent of man is near. Now man is to be created. The fermentation of the whole world is complete. And... yes. Now it remained that man's fermentation also had to be done by Mercury. So what kind of humans' fermentation should it do? Since it was the `munshi-i falak` (scribe of the heavens), all the scribes who exist, those who do scribal work, the writers, the accountants, and the viziers who become ministers, such people, who are great accountants, accountants, their leavens started to be made in its time, in the time of Mercury. In the time of Mercury, because this is an intermediate star. The reality is that this intermediate star, according to some of its properties, according to its shell, according to its seed, this is a star of the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`. Just as Saturn and Mars are stars of the `muṣirr-o-mustakbir`, similarly this Mercury is a star of the `shāk-o-mutaḥayyir`. And Jupiter and Venus and the Moon, these are the stars of the `nādimīn`.

You will say, the burden on the stars of the `nādimīn` has been increased. This is because the `nādimīn` are `nādimīn`. The `nādimīn` are more. For us today, as we see, we think, "Oh, we are a handful, what are we? We are of no account." But don't look at this handful. We are countless, whose number cannot be calculated. Just count the heavens. Just look at the state of the heavens. Who are all these? Who are these sitting in all the heavens? It is us. It is us, but the divine power, as the opportunity arises, it is bringing them into the manifest world in that way, and we are being born here in the form of man, in the state of man.

So, as I told you, there is Saturn (`Zuḥal`), there is Jupiter (`Mushtarī`), there is Mars (`Mirrīkh`), there is the Sun (`Shams`), there is Venus (`Zuhrah`), there is Mercury (`'Aṭārad`), there is the Moon (`Qamar`). In their time, these minerals were made, these plants were made, these animals were made. I told you that in the beginning, Saturn had only made minerals. It had not made plants and animals. The second star, meaning Jupiter, it had also grown plants. And Mars had also created animals. This was the order of the creation of this world. And the leavens were made, as I said, that in the time of each one, the fermentation happened here.

The second thing is that what the `du'at` say is that these are the very planets that are going to affect us, and they have been given different qualities. Among them are the `farqadayn`, the `nayyirayn`, and among them are the `kawkabayn`. These are their various... `sa'dayn`, `naḥsayn`. This is how they have been named. So what happens is that among them, those who are called the `naḥsayn`, the two inauspicious stars, who are very inauspicious, who have an effect. But in reality, what is it? The stars being inauspicious is not the point; that is a separate thing. If you have the receiving power... if you have the receptivity to accept the inauspicious thing, then it is obvious that it will be inauspicious for you. It will be inauspicious. The rain is going to fall anyway, but if you have taken an umbrella, then you are protected. If you have taken the support of supplications (`du'ā`), if you have taken the support of amulets (`ta'wīz`) and your elders, if you pray the morning prayer and then recite the supplications (`adiyyah`), then it will be a support for you. You will neither recite this nor that. You will either rely on an amulet or you will say, "O Allah," say "Bismillah," and you will think that with that everything will be done. Just as Allah Ta'ala has commanded us to protect ourselves with our prayers and with... if we do that protection, then these things will not affect us.

So, in any case, the inauspicious will be inauspicious, the auspicious will be auspicious. It will have its effect. Now the sun and the moon, these are the two `farā'id` and they are called the `nayyirayn`. These are the `nayyirayn`, the shining stars. And similarly, in these celestial bodies, there are two `sa'dayn`, two good stars, that have a very good effect, just as Saturn and Mars have a bad effect, similarly... who are the two good `sa'dayn`? Jupiter and Venus. Jupiter and Venus, these are called the `sa'dayn`. So, the `nayyirayn` happened, the `naḥsayn` happened, the `sa'dayn` happened.

So, these are called so according to their effects, that these are the `nayyirayn`, these are the `sa'dayn`, and these are the `naḥsayn`. And those effects, they cast upon us. One more thing I was reminding you of, that you... the discussion of the moon is a bit detailed, because for this reason I... because the creation of man happened in the time of the moon, and the moon's seventh thousand years, which had come in assistance of whom? Saturn. In its time, the creation of man happened, and its explanation is a bit detailed, it will come in a new way, and I will begin its explanation.

For now, I had to tell you that in the durations of the world, I had told you that I had mentioned two types of scales to you. One scale I had mentioned was that according to the revolution of the planets, there is what is called a minor cycle (`dawr-i ṣaghīr`) and a major cycle (`dawr-i kabīr`). The minor cycle is of seven thousand years, the major cycle is of fifty-one thousand years. First, the minor cycle, what is it? The cycle of each celestial body is seven thousand years, in this way, from Saturn to the moon, that is comprised of seven thousand years. And if you complete seven such cycles, then one major cycle (`dawr-i kabīr`) is formed, and that is attributed to the very first star. It will be called the cycle of Saturn.

When the cycle of Saturn ends, the cycle of Jupiter will begin. When Jupiter's cycle ends, then Mars' will come. When Mars' ends, then the sun's will come. In this way, a cycle will continue in this world and will happen. One thing is that these planets affect this world. The second ones that affect, more so, along with the planets, with full force they affect, are the zodiac constellations (`burūj`). The zodiac (`burūj`) is there, which are the twelve sections, which I call Aries, Virgo, Libra, Taurus, Leo, Pisces... these that have been told to us, which you also often see in the newspapers and you know. That it is a fish, a scorpion, Cancer the crab, and this. Now you will think that the name of a constellation has been given as crab, so it has become lawful. It is unlawful.

And this kind of all the constellations that are there, you should consider that these constellations, all of them, in their place, are very... extremely effective. Which are they? Virgo, Taurus, meaning it forms the shape of a bull, so it has been named Taurus. It forms the shape of a pitcher, so it has been named Aquarius. If it forms the shape of a balance, its name has been given as Libra. And if it is the shape of a maiden, its name has been given as Virgo. So these are twelve sections, and these twelve sections affect humans, not just humans, but animals, minerals, plants, the universe, the atmospheres, they affect all things, these zodiac constellations (`burūj`).

Now, how do these zodiac constellations affect? I want to tell you a little bit about its state, how our elders have explained it. The reality is that this, the highest sphere, is the encompassing sphere (`falak-i muḥīṭ`), which is called the simple sphere (`falak-i basīṭ`). Below the simple sphere is the sphere... the eighth sphere... this is the ninth sphere. The sphere below it, the eighth sphere, is called the sphere of the zodiac (`falak-i burūj`). And in the sphere of the zodiac are these twelve sections. And after this, the spheres that come, what are they? Saturn's comes, Jupiter's comes, Mars' comes, the sun's comes, Venus's, Mercury's, the moon's. So all these sections have come, and these planets are revolving in their own places. They are all revolving. If you look from down here, since the entire atmosphere is transparent, now this transparent atmosphere, your gaze will go to the zodiac constellations. Because there are stars there. You will see the planets too, but whether they are planets or stars, you will see them all on one level. You will see them all on one level, that they are all revolving.

So these planets, if they are revolving, for example, Saturn is, Jupiter is, Mars is, the sun is, Venus is, Mercury is, the moon is. When they revolve, the ones who draw the horoscopes, who are acquainted with astrology and the like, they know very well that when they revolve, revolving means they will certainly move on their path, in their orbit. So when they move, these constellations (`burūj`) that are above, they touch those constellations. Meaning, they appear to be related to some or the other constellation. So according to that, we will say this star is here and this constellation is here, but when they come into alignment with the constellation, we will say that the moon is now in the constellation of Aries. The sun is in the constellation of Taurus. This one is in such-and-such constellation, that one is in such-and-such constellation. So as soon as a star enters that constellation, that constellation and that star, according to both of them, effects will start to be produced in this universe. And all those who have knowledge of astrology, the astrologers who derive anything, they derive it in this very way, that they take the star according to its... whichever house it has gone into, whichever section it has gone into, according to that they derive the effects.

But these seven planets that we have, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, these seven planets also have seven houses. You will say, how seven houses? There are twelve houses up there, twelve sections. But what happens is that in these twelve sections, they have also made one house each their own house. So when that star goes into its own house, its power becomes very great. Its power increases a lot. Of that star. So it is called `tāli'`. So when it rises in that house, and that house, when it goes into its house, its own house, for example, understand that Aries is a constellation, Capricorn is a constellation. And suppose the moon's house is Capricorn. So when the moon goes into the constellation of Capricorn, it will be said that it is in the `bayt al-sharaf` (house of exaltation). And that will be called the `bayt al-sharaf` for it. And because it is in the `bayt al-sharaf`, what will happen? Its power will increase a lot. And the effects will also be produced in this universe accordingly.

One thing I had to explain was that in all the zodiac constellations, each celestial body also has a house (`bayt`). The second thing I had to explain was that when Allah Ta'ala commanded these celestial bodies to move, and commanded them to revolve, how did the revolution happen? Due to the revolution of the encompassing sphere, all the spheres below it started to revolve. So the encompassing sphere that revolved, because of it all of them started to revolve, so that revolution that was happening, so Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury that were revolving, they were illusory. They were not visible. They were illusory stars. This shininess, this shininess that we see, was neither on them nor on the stars. There was no shininess on anyone, they were illusory. They were in their place and were not visible to us.

The plan of the divine power was this... you will say, when it had to be made, it could have made everything. What difference would it have made? When it had made so much, it could have made them shiny. But the divine power did not want that. The divine power wanted that their shininess, which we call the shell (`ṣadaf`), the seed, that part of the seed should remain lying in the world. It should remain lying on this earth. And when those illusory rays started to fall on them, every thing returns to its origin. `Kullu shay'in yarji'u ilā aṣlih` (Everything returns to its origin). Every thing returns to its origin. Air goes towards the sphere of air, water towards the sphere of water, every thing returns to its origin. Similarly, when the rays started to come, according to their own liking, the things that were there, those things, the rays started to pick them up. For example, the rays of Saturn came, so the things of Saturn's liking, the things compatible with it that were lying on the surface of the earth, the rays took those things and started to lift them up. Those rays dragged those things and took them away, and going there, what did they do? The crust... there, they became shells (`ṣadaf`), they became shiny, and today they appear shining to us.

So these shells that have been formed on these celestial bodies, their parts were lying in the world before, and their rays have dragged them away, and after taking them away, this thing has been formed. The second thing the divine power wanted was that the most important thing for humans is oxygen, which... by which they get life, and for them to breathe. So this layer for breathing that it made, how was it? That these rays, when they came to the world once, on the surface of this earth, they took their compatible things and going there, they became shells. But when they came the second time, there were no such things there. And these rays were not so deep that they could enter the solid, hard part of the earth. Rather, what happened? They struck and reflected back. But now, the second rays, see, the first ray that fell, if you put a battery, a cell, the sound that you will hear on the first day, you will not hear on the second day, there will be a slight difference. So that fresh battery, the work that it will do in its place... so in exactly the same way, these celestial bodies, their first light that fell on this universe, those lights, what did they do? Those rays took their shells and dragged them and they became shells.

But the second rays that came after that, they were weak, and they could neither enter this earth nor could they reflect back and reach their shells, but they got lost in the atmospheres. So in the atmospheres, the part that was above the earth, there they came to their place and they finished in the middle. So the middle atmosphere, they changed it in such a way, they altered it in such a way that the oxygen layer was created. In this universe of ours, the oxygen layer was created, and the lower part of the oxygen layer was called the sphere of breeze (`kurrah-i nasīm`), it was called oxygen, and the upper part was called the sphere of intense cold (`kurrah-i zamharīr`). Above the oxygen is what... I don't know, maybe they call it ether. Well, whatever it is, they call it that, and we call it `zamharīr`. `Zamharīr` is the upper part, the lower part is the sphere of breeze (`kurrah-i nasīm`).

So, `nasīm`, which is... which we breathe from and which is the water of life for us, that is `nasīm`. And `zamharīr` is the treasure after that, which is termed as `zamharīr`. So these were two things I had to say, that this was the result of the rays of the celestial bodies, that after coming here, they became their shells, and second, this sphere of breeze (`kurrah-i nasīm`) and `zamharīr` were created. And this star, how it is `naḥs`, `sa'd` and that. Now... the sun and the moon, these are the two `farā'id` and they are called the `nayyirayn`. These are the `nayyirayn`, the shining stars. And similarly, in these celestial bodies, there are two `sa'dayn`, two good stars, that have a very good effect, just as Saturn and Mars have a bad effect, similarly... who are the two good `sa'dayn`? Jupiter and Venus. Jupiter and Venus, these are called the `sa'dayn`. So, the `nayyirayn` happened, the `naḥsayn` happened, the `sa'dayn` happened.

So, these are called so according to their effects, that these are the `nayyirayn`, these are the `sa'dayn`, and these are the `naḥsayn`. And those effects, they cast upon us.

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 13 -->

I have told you before about the planets, that the Lord of the worlds has set up our solar system in such a way that there is Zuhal (Saturn), Mushtari (Jupiter), Mirrikh (Mars), Shams (Sun), Zuhrah (Venus), 'Utarid (Mercury).

Some companions requested that their English names be given. And the buruj (zodiac signs), of which I had mentioned twelve, such as Jaddi, Dalo, Hut, Saur, Asad—I want to tell you their names in English. The name of Zuhal is Saturn. Mushtari is Jupiter. Zuhal is Saturn, Mushtari is Jupiter, Mirrikh is Mars, Shams is Sun, Zuhrah is Venus, and 'Utarid is Mercury, Qamar is Moon. And apart from these, Uranus and Neptune, etc., which were discovered in 1781, 1846, and 1930, do not fall within our solar system, although they are planets. However, they are not in our solar system, and they have only discovered three, but there are countless such planets. Our knowledge tells us that they are countless, but the thing is that our solar system is affected by them if we include them.

And secondly, the sections I had told you about, that there is Jaddi, Dalo, Hut, Hamal, Saur, Jawza', Sartan, Asad, Sunbulah, Mizan, 'Aqrab, and Qaws. Their names are as follows: Capricorn is Jaddi. Dalo is Aquarius. And Hut is Pisces. Hamal is Aries. Saur is Taurus. And Jawza' is Gemini. Sartan is Cancer. Asad is Leo. Sunbulah is Virgo. Mizan is Libra. 'Aqrab is Scorpio. And Qaws is Sagittarius. These are the names of the twelve sections that were formed there.

I had stated before you that every star, Allah Ta'ala had given it a reign of 1000 years, that is, had entrusted it with a plan. And in the beginning, the one who ruled was Zuhal. And after Zuhal, in its assistance and aid, Mushtari came. And in the third millennium, Mirrikh came. In the fourth, Shams came. In this way, all seven stars came one after another, and I had discussed up to six stars, up to 'Utarid.

In Zuhal, I had also mentioned the connection with ma'dan (minerals), nabat (vegetation), and haywan (animals), that the minerals and the vegetables that came into existence in the world, the minerals were formed only during the time of Zuhal. And the nabatat (vegetation) came during the time of Mushtari. And the haywanat (animals) began during the time of Mirrikh. In this way, their beginning continued to happen. And I had explained to you in detail at that time which minerals were formed at which time, what kind of vegetation grew, and what kind of animals were born and walked the earth. And the khama'ir (leavens/essences) of which kind of people were formed.

The most important thing was the khama'ir of people, that for instance, during the time of Zuhal, what kind of khama'ir were formed and for whom? And during the time of Mushtari, the khama'ir of 'afif (chaste) and dindar (pious) people were formed. And during the time of Mirrikh, since the reign was of Zuhal and Mirrikh was its assistant and aide, therefore it produced such people who are qatil (murderers) and who cause danga fasad (riots and discord) here. And those who cause a lot of trouble, the khama'ir of such people came during the time of Mirrikh. And during the time of Shams, it is clear that the khama'ir of kings, dictators, and those who rule in the world, their khama'ir were gathered in one place. And after Mushtari... after Shams, came Zuhrah, 'Utarid, and Qamar. In Zuhrah, I had told you that the khama'ir of the Arabs and of all women were formed.

During the time of 'Utarid, since he is the munshi-e falak (scribe of the heavens), during his time, all the accountants, hisabdah (account keepers), kuttab (scribes), the khama'ir of such people were gathered in one place. And in the end, Qamar came, who in the seventh millennium, provided murafadat (assistance), provided aid to Zuhal. Now it is clear that although Zuhal has a kharabi (malevolence) in its nature, Qamar, being sa'd (auspicious), since it is also one of the nayyarayn (two luminaries) and is a very good and pious star, for this reason, it did what? It reduced its nuhusat (malevolence). And in its time, the creation of man actually took place. Those khameere that were formed during the time of those six planets, those six planets' khameere that had been formed, they, after undergoing takhmeer (fermentation), their birth, in whose era did it happen? It happened in the era of Qamar. And in the 1000 years of Qamar, this thing happened, and after 1000 years, what happened? The takmil (completion)... after undergoing... their birth, in whose era did it happen? It happened in the era of Qamar. And in the 1000 years of Qamar, this thing happened, and after 1000 years, what happened? The takmil (completion) of this dawr (cycle) of Zuhal happened. The chhota dawr (small cycle) of Zuhal was of 7000 years, and the bada dawr (large cycle) of Zuhal is of 51,000 years. In this way, the sequence of every star has continued in the same way. And as I said, if we look at the present time, it is the dawr of Zuhal that is ending, and the dawr of Mushtari will begin. So this is what Allah Ta'ala says: `wa ashraqat al-ardu bi nuri rabbiha` (And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord), that the earth will be filled with the light of Allah. So when will it be filled? As soon as the dawr of Zuhal ends, the dawr of Mushtari will begin, the zuhur (appearance) of Janab-e Mahdi will happen, the arrival of Janab-e Qa'im will be imminent, all conditions will change, the sitr (veil) will end, kashf (unveiling) will come, the state of the jaza'ir (islands/realms) will change, the hadarat (presences) will spread. That is, such a great inqilab (revolution) will come in the era that it will have no limit. Although, it is not a total destruction. There will be no such destruction, and the earth will not be overturned in this way, in the way that we understand that in Qiyamah there will be such an overturning. It won't be like that. But despite that, you will see a tremendous taghayyur (change), and the conditions will change. Just as when the night passed, the matter was over. And when the day came, a bright day came, and its matters are entirely different. So it is the same situation, that now the day of din (religion) is here, and it is clear that the zuhur of the Imam is at hand, and he will not be in a state of khafa (concealment), in a makhfi (hidden) state.

Anyway, now when the moon, in the seventh millennium, began its murafadat of Zuhal, the first thing it did was to start moderating the fiza (atmosphere). The fiza started to become moderate, and a good atmosphere was prepared. Now look, what is on the earth? Flowers are also blooming, tuyur (birds) are also flying, streams of water are also flowing, it is also raining, winds are also blowing. There is great shadabi (lushness), gardens have blossomed, fruits are on the trees, haywan (animals) are also present, wuhush (wild beasts) are also in their places. All these things are present, of course, but in this makan (dwelling), the dwelling is there, but there is no makin (inhabitant) making a sound. Now the arrival of the makin is imminent, and Allah Ta'ala says about the makin: `wallahu anbatakum min al-ardi nabata` (And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth like a plant). The Holy Quran is saying that `wallahu anbatakum min al-ardi nabata`, Allah Ta'ala, O humans, has made you grow from the earth like a plant.

So it becomes clear that despite the Holy Quran saying it so clearly, today no hakim (philosopher/doctor) or any firqa (sect) or any 'alim (scholar) from the scholars of Islam says that man was created in this way. But rather, they say something like this, that either they accept what science says, or they say that Allah Ta'ala's taqdir (decree), as it wants, in that way the creation happened. But we want to know in what way it happened. In the world of Islam, the greatest scholars who consider themselves worthy of being called so, Parvez Sahab, who wrote Ma'arif-ul-Quran, and he is from the Ahl-e Quran, and he thinks that no one has written better than him. He wrote many books, his Urdu is excellent, and he has a great command of philosophy, he knows mantiq (logic), there is no doubt about this. But after writing all this, he established topics that, in the context of the creation of Hazrat Adam, he wrote a whole book. And the first topic he gave was this very thing: that the creation of man, the birth of Janab-e Adam, and after that he established the topic, Janab-e Adam's growing up and being appointed to risalat (prophethood) and nabuwwat (prophethood), and after that the events, then Shaytan and all these things he established. So you see, the topic is very alluring and very interesting, and the first is that the birth of Janab-e Adam. Now if you read the whole thing, you will see that except for the fact that it is poetry, and it is stated in it that fragrant winds are blowing, the greenery is waving, and the fiza is moderate, and such conditions have arisen, and it is so, the universe is decorated, and the state of the sun is this, and when the moon is in the night, its nuraniyat (luminosity) is this. This kind of lafazi (verbiage) upon lafazi, page after page, they have blackened. So, writing poetry, how long does it take? So in this way, he has written all this, page after page has been written, but everything is there except the birth of Janab-e Adam himself. Now you can see, the book is available.

So, it is clear that since these things did not reach them, they did not prostrate at the door of the wealth of Amir al-Mu'minin, so it is clear that how would they attain these 'ulum (sciences)? They did not attain any knowledge at all. And Allah Ta'ala had clearly stated here in the Holy Quran, if there was some 'aql (intellect) and if they had understood it by taking this, there was a lot in it. That why did Allah Ta'ala say so? That `wallahu anbatakum min al-ardi nabata`, Allah Ta'ala has made you grow like a plant. The Holy Quran is stating this clearly and explicitly. Despite this, they say strange things.

Now, what was the state of science? Science kept doing somersaults. And its state was that sometimes its nazariya (theory) was something, and sometimes its nazariya was something else, it kept happening. And it... sometimes it followed Darwin's theory, sometimes it believed in the theory of evolution, that there was a jarsuma (germ), cells were formed, from cells the matter progressed, and happening, happening, happening, in this way the universe kept progressing, progressing. And today I read a revolutionary thing in the newspaper which I will tell you. It is an astonishing thing that their old theory is also faltering a bit, and they have presented a new theory. It was published in the Arab Times, and I want you to hear it, and it is possible that you have read it too. And a 66-year-old professor and scientist has proven that theory wrong too and said that man has not come from mud, etc., and we... how he came, as they have stated, you will hear.

My point is that science, whatever theory it has adopted, and their nazariyat (theories) which are of science, they have kept changing. And most of all, the mushahadah (observation) that we have had of this changing of theories, that is in the context of the lunar and solar eclipses. In the context of the lunar and solar eclipses, their theories have changed in many ways. And their theory was also this at one time, that the ebb and flow, the madd-o-jazar (tide) that happens in the sea, from this the lunar and solar eclipses are produced. And after that, they said no, but rather they... who are rotating and moving, in that, in the moving, if it comes in between, then the lunar and solar eclipses are produced, as you all know. So anyway, these are their theories, and it is clear that despite this, they proceed with great ehtiyat (caution) and with great mushahadah, and from that, we have no denial at all.

So, my point is that with this theory, they have tried to prove that Darwin is completely wrong in his place, and it is not so. But the reality is that Darwin's theory is also correct, in its own way. We say that Darwin's theory is also correct, but the only difference that has occurred is... now since those explanations have not come, it will be a bit difficult for you to understand. But what I have to say is that if there is a ladder, one who sees it can think that the ladder has been placed for those who are descending, and I will see that it has been placed for those who are climbing. So it's just a matter of perspective, because of which Darwin's theory became what it is. Otherwise, in its place, it is a theory for sure, and he has presented a complete thing and has presented it correctly. But what he said, that our ancestors were those, that is wrong. It is not like that. But rather, this is an 'adhabi shakl (form of punishment), and how punishment comes and how they are sent into the darakat (lower ranks), you will, Insha'Allah, hear it in detail when that occasion comes. I only have to say this much, that now you... this... the... which is our nazariya, and not just a nazariya, but the haqiqat (reality), since we do not speak from a nazariya, but we speak from haqiqat. So our Imams and our Ahl al-Bayt, and Amir al-Mu'minin who is the sarchashma (source) of this, what they have stated is this very thing, that how man was created, and the other things like nabat (vegetation) and haywan (animals) and all the namiyati (organic) things, how they came into the world, he... as it was presented, I have presented it before you, and that thing will surely be in your background.

So now, see that when this entire world, haywan have also come, and madaniyat (minerals) have also been formed, and nabatat are also present, and everything is there, but Hazrat Insan (Mankind), his arrival is imminent here, and his wujud (existence) has not yet come. The sabab (cause) for bringing wujud into being was who? It was the moon. And Allah Ta'ala had placed the moon seventh so that in its time, the creation of man could happen. And that creation of man whose khameere had been formed from all six planets. They were formed in the time of Zuhal, they were formed in the time of Mushtari, they were formed in the time of Mirrikh, they were formed in the time of Shams, they were formed in the time of Zuhrah and 'Utarid. In the time of all of them, the khameere were formed. I had said that they have been leavened, and they have been collected, their divisions are separate, and people of different natures have been separated. That is, dindar (pious) people were separated, so that was done in the time of Mushtari. Kings and those who were to come as leaders and dictators, they were formed in the time of Shams. Anyway, all that which had happened, now how did their creation happen? The first thing the moon did was to moderate the fiza. It moderated the fiza, and in the universe, there were neither such heavy rains, nor so much cold, nor so much heat. A moderate condition was created by it. First, it cleaned the fiza. This thing happened. The second thing that happened was that the 6000 years that had passed before it, in the time of Zuhal, Mushtari, Mirrikh, Shams, Zuhrah, 'Utarid, the madaniyat that were inside the earth, in the core, and no human hand had touched those madaniyat. It is clear that human existence was not there, so who would touch it? Or would animals touch them? That question does not arise. So then, these madaniyat that were there, these madaniyat were finished in their place. How were they finished? So what was the matter? That in this universe, there were many earthquakes. And some conditions were such that there was an upheaval. `a'liyaha safilaha` (its high ones became its low ones), as Allah Ta'ala says that We made the high ones low and the low ones high. So in this way, the ups and downs that were created, and those madaniyat were ground and crushed in their place and were finished. In the same way, the nabatat that had grown, whether they were in the form of fruits, or whether they were general jharpat (vegetation) or of any kind, that which had grown in the universe, perished in 6000 years, was finished, and vapors rose from them. Vapors rose from madaniyat, these vapors rose from all the nabatat, and the haywanat, whatever they were, whether they were siba' (predators), darinde (beasts), or whether they were muhallal haywan (permissible animals), every animal that was dying, vapors rose from them. But nature was distinguishing them, and it was the taqdir (decree) of Allah Ta'ala that He distinguished between the halal and haram. And it is clear that the halal was being taken to a specific place, and the vapors of the haram were generally rising. Anyway, nature, from all these haywan, nabat, or ma'dan, from their being crushed and finished, the vapors that arose, all of them together became a cloud and cast a shadow, and these rains started to fall. Rains started to fall in this universe, and these rains were special, and nature was giving it a मौका (opportunity), at a specific waqt (time), nature... though rains would have fallen before this as well, many times, but these rains were very special, and nature was making some arrangement, for the arrival of man. So now these rains that fell, these rains, our du'at say that this was happening in the entire world. At that time, there were no houses, no thing. You should imagine such a world, when there are no houses, no city, no thing, no big... there are none. In such a state, the things that happened in 6000 years, from their vapors, the rains are falling. Imagine this. When the rains fell, these rains fell in a slanting state, and those rains, after coming to the earth, since it was raining continuously, the force of these rains created pits in the earth. Just as pits are formed even today, in the same way, this rain created pits in the earth, and along with creating pits, some water also collected in those pits. I hope you are understanding. These vapors rising from the ma'dan, nabat, and haywan of 6000 years, they became a cloud and cast a shadow, and rains started to fall, and what did these rains do? They created pits. Rains also fell, and pits were also created, in the entire world. There was no part of the universe that was left out, it wasn't like that. In the entire world, these pits were formed. And the pits were of what kind? They were of the kind that, just as children usually make gharonde (sandcastles) in the sand, they make gharonde with their feet and pull them out, pits of that kind were formed, because the rains were falling in such a way. And in the entire world, pits of this kind were formed. And I also told you that along with the pits being formed, some water also collected in it. When this condition had occurred, then Allah Ta'ala's power wanted that the second rains that fall, after those rains fell, that there be very heavy rains, from this... the first rains that fell, which created pits and water collected in it, stronger rains than this should fall. So, after this, rains fell again, and those rains were more qawi (powerful), zordar (stronger), and musladhar (torrential), those rains started to fall. Now, these rains that were falling, which fell upon the first rain, these rains were stronger, and what happened was that this water and that water, both mixed with each other. And in the pits, they mixed with each other. The first water that came into the pits, nature had made such an arrangement for it that it was a matter of unas (females), it was in the state of the water of women. And the second water that came, it was in the state of the water of men, that is why it was considered qawi (powerful), and that is why it is `ar-rijalu qawwamuna 'ala an-nisa'` (men are the protectors and maintainers of women). So this was a powerful water. So this water and that water mixed, and they merged with each other, and along with that, the heat of the pit, that heat started to cook this water in such a way as things are cooked in a degchi (pot) for us. Just as things are cooked in a degchi, in the same way, the heat of the earth started to cook this water, and this water, after being cooked, started to boil and bubble up, and the vapors started to form and fall, so what happened from that? It started to become less, a khulasa (essence) started to form, it started to condense. And along with that, a quality started to form in it, that by this repeated boiling and falling of vapor, a dohiyat (oiliness) was created in it, a tel-pan (oiliness) was created. This water became oily, and this water, after being cooked to a certain extent, this water settled, and that water which settled, on it, the tadbir (planning) of the moon had started from there, but the moon, with a look of istehsan (approval) or with a look of iltija (entreaty), looked towards whom? Towards Zuhal, that now you plan and help me in this matter. The matter was that Allah Ta'ala wanted that when man is created, all seven stars, all seven planets, should also have a hand in it. So it is clear that Zuhal helped it, because the badshahat (kingship) was its, and anyway, nature wanted it to help. So, if Zuhal had not helped, that water, from the pit, it had become so oily, and it had become so much like pare (mercury), that it would have probably come out and gone out of the pit. So to keep it in the pit, whose tadbir worked? The tadbir of Zuhal worked, and it kept that water in the pit. This is what Allah Ta'ala says: `sulalatan min tin` (an extract from clay), and `wa ja'alnahu sulalatan... nutfatan fi qararin makin, fa-ja'alna an-nutfata mudghatan, fa-ja'alna al-mudghata... 'alaqatan, fa-ja'alna al-'alaqata... 'izaman, fa-kasawna al-'izama lahman, thumma ansha'nahu khalqan akhar` (And We made him an extract... a drop of fluid in a safe lodging, then We made the drop a clinging clot, then We made the clot a lump of flesh... and We made the lump bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We developed him into another creation). So Allah Ta'ala has enumerated all the stages of the janin (fetus) in this verse. It is that first, an 'itr (essence) was extracted from tin (clay), and the name of this 'itr is sulalah, which was placed in the backbone of the father and in his spinal cord. This water, Allah Ta'ala calls it sulalah, and sulalah means that which is extracted. And after that, when it finds a qarar (resting place), with the mother, then it is called nutfah (sperm-drop). And after nutfah, it becomes 'alaqah (leech-like clot). After 'alaqah, it becomes mudghah (lump of flesh). After mudghah, its state becomes that of 'izam (bones), and then Allah Ta'ala says: `fa-kasawna al-'izama lahman` (then We clothed the bones with flesh). We clothed those bones with flesh. `thumma ansha'nahu khalqan akhar` (then We developed him into another creation). We made the final creation after this, that is, We blew the ruh (soul) into it. So this is the sequence the verse is showing. With exactly this sequence, the child of the earth and sky was passing through, and who was being born from the pit. And it is that this water of the pit, there, which had settled, I told you that it was the tadbir of Zuhal due to which it could settle. And who is this? You are seeing that one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, the seventh is the moon, and Zuhal becomes which one? The eighth. That is why with us, if a child is born in the eighth month, it does not live. What is the matter? It is that the tadbir of Zuhal happened here first, so it could settle. Otherwise, if the tadbir of Zuhal had been given after the seventh, that is, after working on this child, after the seventh, if Zuhal had also been given a tadbir in the eighth, then what would have happened? This child would have suffocated and died. So nature, from whom it has to take work, it takes work from it, and this was doing the work of making it settle. So Zuhal did this work. Mushtari on its... the a'za'-e ra'isah (vital organs), and which are the cause of the greatest... for it, it paid attention to those things, and it paid attention to the heart and the brain. Whose? Of Mushtari. Mirrikh paid attention to the asfal hisson (lower parts). And Shams completely prepared the heart, and in the body of man, it was its tadbir, the tadbir of Shams. Because it is also the heart, and the sun has become the heart of this entire solar system, that is why it paid attention to the heart of the human child, and it shaped the heart. Now Zuhrah came. Zuhrah did this, that it made the tamiz (distinction) that this one who is being born is a male or a female. This tamiz of the shakl (form), whether the eye is small or big, or all the other a'za, how they should be, making its features was whose job? It was the job of 'Utarid. 'Utarid did this job, and when that child was completely formed, now it was the job of Qamar... now since Qamar had done the first job, you know that, that it did all this work, but now the separate tadbir of the stars began, and the tashkil (formation) started, and in that water, all the a'za and jawarih (limbs and organs) started to form. And in it, our... the a'za'-e ra'isah were also formed, our small a'za were also formed, and all things were prepared, and the man... whether he is a male or a female, this tamiz also came. When all this thing happened, now the moon was entrusted with the task again, that you do the final work, `wa ansha'nahu khalqan akhar`, that the work of blowing the ruh into it, that was of the moon itself. I had told you in the beginning, you would remember that I had said that when man fell from there, a shabih (likeness) came from there, so in the coming of that shabih and in accepting its nadamat (repentance), a part of its entire jism (body)... we had done a graft... a part of it had accepted nadamat, a part had accepted its... nadamat after the fact. In this way, a tartib (sequence) was established. And I had told you that the first to accept nadamat was the natiqah (rational soul), and after that was the hissiyah (sensory soul), and after that was the namiyah (vegetative soul). And in our jismani (physical) terms, it was the heart, and after that, it was the brain, and then its quwwaten (faculties) and all those things happened, the a'za'-e ra'isah happened, and then the asfal hisse, and our hair and nails and the soles of our feet, all came. So, a kaifiyat (condition) of this sort exists. So now, when you are understanding this, now the moon, in the very end, the blowing of the ruh into it was related to the moon, because the markaz (center) of the namiyah is the moon. You understand? The markaz of the namiyah is the moon, so for this reason, the moon paid attention to it, and it bestowed that namiyah which it had with it. Which is its own thing. It's not someone else's thing. The namiyah that was in the moon, it was its own. Whoever is being born, it was of that, and it bestowed that namiyah. From bestowing it, what happened? It grew. It grew and was formed. When that child was completely ready, and harakat (movement) had started in it, and the heart started to beat, the a'za'-e ra'isah, and the chamra (skin) was stretched over it, and he was a completely fine human child. And when he became one year old. So, until he became one year old, what did he go through in the pit? His hal (situation) is this: that he was in the pit, and just as our child gets ghiza (nourishment) from his parents, nature was providing him ghiza from the jawf (depths) of the earth. And how? From that water which was left in the pit. That water which was left in the pit, from that same water, he was getting it through the naf (navel), just as our child gets it, in the same way, he was getting it through the naf. And the second zariya (source) was the angutha (thumb). He was sucking the angutha, and in sucking, nature was providing him... through the angutha also. Today our child also sucks his angutha, and he sucks it in the same watirah (habit), because this thing is included in his fitrat (nature). It is not so that he does it just like that. No, rather it is in his fitrat, the fitrat-e ilahi (divine nature) works. And since this thing is in the fitrat... so he sucks the angutha. But that child, who was the child of the earth and sky, when he was sucking, nature was providing him with ghiza. It's not that milk was flowing or anything, it's not like that, but rather he was getting ghiza, and he was obtaining ghiza. From his own self. This was the intizam (arrangement) of nature. When this kaifiyat was going on, then, just as our children, after birth, are given tamarrukh (massage), that is, oil is applied, and to provide that child with good ghiza, now you can't feed him anything from the mouth except milk, but they make him strong and his a'za tandurust (healthy) by massaging him with oil, etc. In exactly the same way, this child of the earth and sky was rolling in that same water, and nature, from that water, which had become oily, was massaging him with it, and nature was... massaging him. All these things were happening, and one year passed. For one year, he was taking ghiza in this way, as I have told you, and after one year, he, with ease, came out of that pit. When he came out of the pit, now the condition of that child was this... since this was the child of the earth and sky, it has been said that this newborn child was equal to our four-year-old child. Our four-year-old child's equal was his... this... and he came out, and after coming out, some water was left in the pit. Some water was left in that pit, and this... he came out of the pit. Nature willed that all of these newborns, who were born from all the pits, should all be dhukur (males), men. From all the pits, as many as were born, innumerable from the pits, in the entire world, who were those newborns? They were men. All of them were men. And the bachawa pani (leftover water) that was in that pit, on that leftover water, nature willed that pani should fall on it again. So, barishen (rains) started to fall again, and that barish ka pani (rainwater) came and fell into that pit again. And again this pani, the leftover pani and this pani, mixed with each other, and after mixing, in it too, a kaifiyat of the same kind started to happen, as had happened before.
