Now, what happens with this? That you gave that amount, and you were freed from its bonds. Now you will say, "Why were the bonds put on the *nafs* in the first place, that it has to be freed?" "Why the bonds?" So, I ask the world of Islam, please pay attention. Any person should answer me with a cool mind, that the entire world of Islam, which today has so many, crores, countless Muslims, are all their children born as pure and Muslim? Do they not need to have the *darb* (ritual strike) applied? And do they not have to be made Muslim? Why do they make them Muslim? If *qudrah* had already created them as Muslims, and this necessity of surgery did not arise here, then how good it would have been. Why was this kept? When it is known that *qudrah* keeps it and wants us to cut here, we should do the surgery, and that is called "making a Muslim." Look, "making a Muslim." So, it was known that this happens, *qudrah* puts some bonds, and we have to make them Muslim. In exactly the same way, some bonds come upon our *nafs*. There is a bond on *namiyah*, there is a bond on *hissiyah*, there is a bond on *natiqah*. To be freed from that bond, it is `min ma tuhibbun` (from that which you love), that wealth which you love very much, spend it. And this money is used for such a thing that in its reward, what does *qudrah* do? It frees that *nafs* from those bonds. You will say, "By doing what, what happens?" But what to do? Until you spend, you will not attain that thing. Just as you do *tazkiyah* (purification) with *zakat* (alms), you purify your wealth, in the same way, these are *fiqaqat*, and by paying them, these things are released. So, you gave *sadaqah* (charity), you did *qurbani* (sacrifice), you did the feeding for *ziyarah*, you recited the Holy Qur'an, you read Yasin for him, you prayed for his forgiveness, and along with doing all this, you paid the *fiqaqat*, then the *nafs al-namiyah* will also be released, and the restrictions that are upon it, it will get release from those chains. And what kind of chains are they? They are all spiritual things, what will you understand? Although it is physical, it is a spiritual bond. And freed from those bonds, it will be released. And you will say, "Well, after three days it has to be released anyway, so what is the need to give? What is the need to do?" But you see, with what trouble that released prisoner comes out. After three days, he is released for sure, but with how many troubles he is released. To give him relief, if you do this little bit, what will you lose? Today, you are sacrificing your life for him, weeping and wailing, so you should do this so that he is released. When he is released, then as I have told you, the *namiyah* after being released goes into the moon, and the moon, this, from crescent to full moon, and from full moon to crescent, it happens for this very reason. It is the *rihiyya* of the believers, the *namiyah*, which are shining, and this is becoming the moon and shining, the *rihiyya*. These are the *rihiyya* of the believers which are shining. And these, through Mercury and Venus, go to the sun and are washed, and then they come to use in forming the body of the Imam, as I have explained to you in detail. So, when you have seen that this is the matter with *namiyah*, and with *hissiyah*, it is that it went with the *natiqah*. So, when *hissiyah* went with *natiqah*, we call that a *surah* (form). And when a *surah* met with a *surah*, and *surah* after *surah* started to connect, the circle, in a small circle, a small circle in a smaller circle, it started to join, and happening, happening, the *du'at* (callers), and after the *du'at*, the *hujjat* (proof), after the *hujjat*, the *bab* (gate), and after the *bab*, they reached the rank of *bab al-abwab*. And there, all the forms took one human form. Look, everything will be in human form. A human's thought is also a human. Look, today Hindus and others, whatever gods or idols they make, they will either make them in the form of a human, they cannot make them otherwise. They will make them a bit crooked, but they will make them in the form of a human. Or if not, they will make them in the form of an animal. So, just in the same way, *qudrah* has kept it that the best stature is that of a human. That *haykal* (form/temple) which will be formed of those forms will also be in human form. Meaning, a place for the head, a place for the ear, a place for the nose, a place for the hand. Just as, whatever one's rank is, that form will be adjusted there, and it will be a *haykal* in the form of a human. And the place for this *haykal* to reside is, as I have told you, the Ka'bah. And who is the one who keeps it there? It is the Imam of the time. By the command of the Imam, that *haykal* moves, and that *haykal* always resides where? In the Holy Ka'bah. And in that *haykal*, how many forms are there? At least there are 100,000. That is why the reward for one *rak'ah* (unit of prayer) is 100,000. It is equal to 100,000 *rak'ahs* to offer one *rak'ah* of prayer in the Haram, in the Baytullah (House of God). So, when you have learned that all this is there, then you pay attention that our *namiyah* that has emerged from the grave, that *namiyah* which emerged from the grave after three days, and after all the bonds were released, and after being washed and cleaned in all those things, after being cleansed of all filth and dirt, after the impurities and dross were removed, it came into this world, and after coming into the world, and coming upon some fruit, and the Imam eating it as food, and it being capable of becoming his son, what does it mean to become a son? The body. Only the body. And the *nafs* of that boy is what? It is the *athar* (effect/trace). The point that is to come in the *Tamur*, that is its *athar*. So, the origin is in the *Tamur*, which I call, there the name is Ahmad, and here it is Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him. So, you have to understand this, that this kind of... The Prophet said one thing and clarified the whole matter. So, when this kind of matter has been understood by you, then it was known that this is the state, and there are *hijab* and *muhtajib*, and this is the situation. So now, when you have understood this, that the *athar* of the *Tamur* happens, so this *nafs-e-hissiyah* of ours that emerges, that *hissiyah* also, when it ascends in the form of a *surah*, it also has some bonds, it has some restrictions. To free it from those restrictions and bonds, you also have to pay *fiqaq*. And along with paying *fiqaq*, you have to do your deeds. But the reality is that the matter is not so straightforward, that the road is also right, your motor is also right, its parts are also right, the petrol is also full. All things have to be accounted for and arranged. In the same way, the journey of the hereafter is also not a solitary matter. All things have to be considered. The character should also be correct, the worships should also be there. Although you have not performed worship all night long, but you have performed the five daily prayers, you have shown respect, you have also fasted, you have also given *zakat* (alms). So, all these things should be there to some extent, so that your journey can pass with moderation, with a middle path. And if, suppose, this does not happen, then valleys will come, and you will face difficulties. There are difficulties for the soul, and there are difficulties for the body, that we think our leaving the grave is easy. Oh, it is very difficult. I am saying it for the sake of speaking, that he is a *mu'min*, so his *namiyah* also leaves. But who knows, if suppose there is a *mu'min*, and there is another *mu'min*—one *mu'min* is there who offered prayers, gave *zakat*, did this, did that, did Hajj, performed worships, had good character, did all things. And another *mu'min* is there, who engaged in major sins. Who committed sins against God, who, the greatest sin is *shirk billah* (associating partners with God). I have continuously explained to you about *shirk*, how *shirk* happens. If, God forbid, we have committed *shirk*, God forbid, and after that, lying is the greatest sin. The situation is such that lying has become such a habit for us that it is like honeyed milk. And it is the greatest sin. Here you told a lie, there your *surah* (form) started to become dark. And an effect started to fall on it. This is a matter of giving with one hand and taking with the other. This is not a matter of delayed payment. And after that, the greatest sin is wine, and after that is adultery, after that is murder. These are the five great sins that I have mentioned before you. If any person has committed these sins, then one *mu'min* who is walking straight, and another *mu'min* who has committed all these things, there will be a big difference between the two. There will be a big difference between the two, and what kind of difference will it be? The difference will be that this *mu'min* who has engaged in major sins, who has committed such great sins of God, which are called *kaba'ir*, about which the Prophet said, "Even if you perform Hajj, all things will be forgiven, `illa al-kaba'ir` (except the major sins)." Except for the major sins. Yes, if he repents for the major sins, performs `tawbah al-nasuh` (sincere repentance), asks for forgiveness, then the Lord of the worlds is the one who forgives. But if he does not want to, and if this is the matter, then obviously he has fallen into trouble. He has fallen into trouble, so what has happened? The *namiyah* is far from being released, some of the *hissiyah* also remains. You understand? The matter of the *namiyah* being released is a distant thing, if some part of the *hissiyah* also remains... some part, not all. Some part of a *mu'min*, if it remains, then what a severe torment it is, just tell me. It is the same matter as if you are burying a living person. What a torment it is, what a calamity it is. God forbid, God forbid, through the grace of our Auliya Allah (Friends of God), may our state not be like this. But I am telling you that even believers are subject to this trial. Now, apart from them, the people who are there, what will be the state of their death, and what state of their death will you see? That their death does not even happen. They think the departure of the *nafs-e-hawaiyah* (aerial self) is death. Oh, where did the death happen? The departure did not even happen. Departure is what is called when *namiyah* has also left, *hissiyah* has also left, *natiqah* has also left. There is no *natiqah* at all. The pilot is not there to pull the *nafs*. *Hissiyah* remains with them as *hissiyah*, *namiyah* with them as *namiyah*. I will explain in detail in tomorrow's lesson, but today I only have to explain about the *mu'min*. And some other things of the *mu'min* are still remaining. I have to tell you that if the *namiyah*, *hissiyah*, and *natiqah* of a *mu'min* progress, then minus *namiyah*, minus *hissiyah*, minus *natiqah*, now the thing that remains, what is that thing? Six parts remain. I said tough bones, soft bones, tough sinews, soft sinews, muscles, and hair, nails. These six parts are called the six *fuzlat* (superfluities) which are buried in the grave of a *mu'min*. Now, the one who is being buried is being buried with the six *fuzlat*. If the *namiyah* has left, then that *mu'min* is what? Minus *namiyah*, minus *natiqah*, minus *hissiyah*. Now he has gone in total, and now he is buried with only the *fuzlat*. Now what is the state of these *fuzlat*? That now they have entered the *dawlat-i 'alam* (state of the world). What is *dawlat*? It is a mill, which in our terminology is called *mizaj-i mu'tadij* (tempered disposition). Remember, the name of this mill that works in nature is *mizaj-i mu'tadij*. This, the clouds and rain and the rain that comes, and the vegetation that grows, the process of all these things is called *mizaj-i mu'tadij*. So, *mizaj-i mu'tadij* is a very big procedure, to explain which a lot of time is needed. And that, anyway, understand that the formation of stratified clouds, and the falling of rain, and from it the growth of vegetation, and that vegetation becoming food for some animal, and those foods, being slaughtered under a knife by some halal animal, that slaughtered meat coming into our food, and eating that food, and from that food, the formation of the *nutfah*, and it being the cause of the settlement for some child, and that child emerging from it in the form of a human. So, now this happens in this way, and through a very long procedure... God forbid, God forbid, it is not like what the Hindus have, that life after life, or *awghaman* (transmigration). That, God forbid, is not there, which they call rebirth or reincarnation. Curses upon our *du'at* for such a thought. It is not like that. And if this coming again was not to happen, then God would not have said this in the Holy Qur'an: `minha khalaqnakum wa fiha nu'idukum wa minha nukhrijukum taratan ukhra` (From it [the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.). "Oh, from this grave, We had taken you out. Into this grave, We are putting you. From this grave, We will have to take you out." `inna alladhi farada 'alayka al-Qur'ana la-raddika ila ma'ad` (Indeed, He who has ordained the Qur'an for you will [surely] bring you back to a place of return.). Allah has made the Qur'an obligatory upon you so that you may be returned to your place of return. All these things, most of the verses are indicating that your *'awdat* (return) happens, our return happens, our coming back happens. `wal-akhiratu khayrun laka min al-ula` (And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].). "Oh, your hereafter is better than your first." Meaning, your first life and the life that is to come, there will be a big difference between this life. In this life, if you have acted with understanding, with comprehension, then you have prepared for the coming life. The hereafter is the coming life. This life is the first life. So, these are all indications in the Holy Qur'an which are telling that we will have a return. And we, this is what Mawlana Rumi has also said, that we have to come into this universe countless times. Now look, what is the reality? The one who came, never came. You understand my point? The one who came, never came. And the one who went, went forever. Now I am proving this to you. For example, suppose there is an 'Amr. 'Amr's *nafs al-natiqah*, his *nafs al-hissiyah*, his *nafs al-namiyah*, and he passed away. After passing away, *nafs al-hissiyah* joined with *nafs al-natiqah*, reached the *hujjat*, and it became part of the *haykal*. Now tell me, who is the one being released? It is only the *nafs al-natiqah*. It is the one who was joined with the *hissiyah*. When it was released, it is the same one who was saying "I, I." The one who was calling himself "I" all his life, that was only the *natiqah*. Which was released, and after being released, now what remains? *Namiyah* remains. So, *namiyah*, along with its body, is going to remain in this universe. And until it does not create it in the form of a *natiqah*, it will not be released. Now you will say, how will it create it? In exactly the same way that the *natiqah* was created there from your own body. Just as one *shabih*, by regretting there, created your *natiqah* for you, in the same way, you here, your *namiyah*, you will make it into *hissiyah*. You will make *hissiyah* into *natiqah*. And how will you make it? You will make it through these same worships. You will make it through these same spiritual exercises. You will make it through this same love for Amir al-Mu'minin. You will make it through this same monotheism of the Lord of the worlds. These same beliefs, these same ethics, these same worships, these same dealings. From these, you will progress. From these, you will... If you think that you can achieve spiritual progress from physical progress through some other procedure, you cannot. The procedure for achieving spiritual progress from physical progress is only this. That you will have to walk in this way, then this is the straight path, and you will have to pass through this straight path. From this path. So now what is it? That that *natiqah* which... that when it was released from you, now it is part of the *haykal*. And your *namiyah* which was released... please pay attention. Your *natiqah* which was released, that is part of the *haykal*. And the *haykal* has been formed where? At the place of the *bab al-abwab*. And at the place of the *bab al-abwab*, it has been formed in the shape of a human. Suppose that you, one number, two number, three number, four number, let's say I give numbers. Number one there takes the place of the eye. Number two takes the place of the ear, some take the place of the nose, some take the place of the head, some take the place of the hand. Suppose. Whoever took whatever according to their own account, they took it. That *haykal* has been formed. So, the place that you take in the *haykal*, then in the state of *namiyah*, your *namiyah* that has emerged in the form of *rihiyya*, and after being washed has come, and has become the body of the Imam, then in the body of the Imam too, it will take the same place which it had taken in the *haykal*. I hope you understood. The place that you took in the *haykal*, if you took the place of the eye, then in the *nasut* (human realm), meaning in the body of the Imam too, you will come in the place of the eye. And you are what? The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, has given the command for *wudu'* (ablution) to perform the prayer. Common Muslims will say, "How good it is, we stay in dust and dirt, and how good it is that purity is achieved, we do *istinja* (ritual cleansing), purity is achieved, and becoming pure and clean, washing our hands and feet, all the parts that are external, after washing them clean, we go and stand in the court of God, how good it is." That's it, the matter is over. Oh, this was not the thing. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, the Seal of the Prophets, he did not just tell about *wudu'* for this reason. Oh, he has encompassed millions of things, the Seal of the Prophets. Among those countless things, the most important thing was this, that when you sit down to do *wudu'*, here you said "Bismillah" (In the name of God), there the *haykal* started to move. And that in the noble *nasut* also, the movement started. Oh, there are many other things that have started to move. Many things have started to move. Here you said, `Allahumma... Muhammad al-Nabi ka`, here you rinsed your mouth and read the supplication. And you read the supplication which the Prophet and the progeny of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt have told. If you read the Qur'an, that will have no effect either. You will have to read the same supplication that has been told to you. Here you read that supplication, there what will happen? That in the place of the mouth, whatever is in the *nasut*, that will come into motion. And in the place of the mouth, whatever is in the *lahut*, that will come into motion. And they will look towards you. So, what does it mean? That your *wudu'* will start to become complete. And your transformation will begin. So, the transformation that you have, it happens at every single moment. Its beginning is where? It is from *istinja*. It is from *istinja*. Now, there are great points, if I were to open them, it would become too much, but it is very difficult, it is possible that it will be heavy on your intellect. That is why I do not want to open those things. Otherwise, I would tell you why *qudrah* gave such organs, and why it made them lower things. Why was the practice of *istinja* kept? I would tell all these things. But the reality is, you understand, that these are all our illusions, this is our corrupt illusion, which we, with the Tenth, and the Ninth, had said, "No, no, we do not believe, and we will not believe anyone." The denial that we did, that denial has fallen to this extent here. And it has made us fall so much that today we are hiding our own flaws. We are covering our own faults. Why did this covering of flaws happen? It is because of "there." The covering of flaws came, and we started to cover our flaws. So, it became a matter of shame. So, it was known that it is all a matter of "there." And in the same way, when you do its purification, then this purification happens. And how does the purification happen? Until you say, `Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah` (I bear witness that there is no god but God, I bear witness that Muhammad is the messenger of God), until then purity cannot happen. The purity of anything will not happen until you recite the *kalima tayyibah*. Now, you have recited the *kalima tayyibah*, and if you have started to recite the *kalima tayyibah* in a long and drawn-out way, as has been told, commonly among the Muslims as it has been told, then what will happen? That *kalima tayyibah* will also become deficient. The milk is a lot, oh, the pot is full, but with henna in it. What will you do? If a drop of urine falls, what will happen? So, it all became impure. So, in the same way, if you have recited the *kalima tayyibah*, and after that, you said, `al-khayru wa al-sharru min Allah ta'ala` (good and evil are from God, the Exalted). "Good and evil, whatever there is, is from God." God forbid, God forbid. Oh, He is pure good. He wants only good. He wants to take you from physicality to spirituality. He wants to clean you right there. You did not get cleaned there, and you came here, and on top of that, you are blaming God, that evil is also from God. Some gentlemen had come, it was the early days. And they told me... my zeal was a bit more, so I gave him a slap. So, those gentlemen were very displeased, that you are saying this, you are doing that. I said, "Brother, you are reciting the *kalima tayyibah*, `al-khayru wa al-sharru min Allah ta'ala`." That goodness is there, badness is there, whatever there is, is from God. Now, the slap that has reached you, it has reached you from God. What can I do? I am helpless. So, eat the slap. So, anyway, although it is a joke, but very many points emerge from it. If we were to explain this saying, `al-khayru wa al-sharru min Allah ta'ala`, the whole of Islam would be torn to shreds. The whole of Islam would be torn to shreds. No thing will remain. It will be shattered into pieces. Just give me the proof for that. Oh, He is pure good. He is the origin of all. He is the total intellect. From there, you take blessings. From Him, you ask for everything from the true giver. And you are saying that whatever evil is reaching is from Your side. Wow. You do the evil, and you curse Satan. You do the deed yourself, and you curse Satan. Can this be? It cannot be. So, Satan does mislead, but why do you get misled? Why do you get misled? So, the fault is actually ours. And this is the thing, remember, that God is as He is. He is *'adil-e-hakim* (Just and Wise). And with Him is justice. With Him is not injustice. So, it was known that the way that 'Ashir al-Mudasir had set for *lahut* and *nasut*, that is the same way for *lahut* and *nasut*, by which our progress will happen. And the death of a *mu'min* is not just the departure of the *nafs-e-hawaiyah* (aerial self), but it is the departure of the *namiyah*, and the departure of the *hissiyah* by joining with the *natiqah*. This is the reality of death. Now, the six parts that are left are buried. Now, after being buried, as I said, for these six *fuzlat* to be cleansed, 300 years are needed. 300 years are for the cleansing of the grave. And I have told you that the things that emerge from his body, when the cleansing of the grave is done in 300 years, this is a wash house. The grave is what? It is a procedure. This is done. Now, the second procedure starts, of the spheres and the constellations. When they go into the constellations, then the 12 constellations I told you about, in each constellation for 60 years, and according to 60 years, if you calculate for 12 constellations, 720 years, take out 20 years from that, 700 years. 700 and these 300 years, 1000 years. The duration is 1000 years, after that your return happens, and that *mu'min* comes into the world. That *mu'min* is born again at someone's house. At whose house he has to be born, these are all things that who will be the siblings, what is there, what is fate, what is plan, what is predestination, what is free will, all these things are to come. But I am just telling you that his return happens, and he comes into the world. When he comes into the world, then obviously now the one who is coming, who is he? Although you may call him by his name, you may call him Zayd, you may call him whatever, but in reality, who is that Zayd? It is the *hissiyah*... no, but the *namiyah*. The *hissiyah* has gone. The *namiyah* has now come as *hissiyah*. You are calling that *hissiyah* Zayd and so on, because that is the soul. Because now it has been replaced. Now it has moved forward, that the *namiyah* took the place of the *hissiyah*, the heart took the place of the liver, the brain took the place of the heart, the liver took the place of the brain. Now, happening, happening, happening, what will happen? That one part of it will be reduced. And which part will be reduced? The foot. The part of the foot that was reduced, the part of the sole that was reduced, that part which is lying in the universe, that treasure that is lying upon it, meaning the human who is whole, he is not one whole *shabih*. He is one part. Within that one part, the account that has been kept for collecting, the part of yours that has been kept in the spheres, from there you will be taken out and joined. In this way, becoming better and better, you, coming again and again, passing through this world again and again, what will happen? You will have to progress within one *dawr-e-a'zam*. One *dawr-e-a'zam*, I have explained to you in detail. Now, how many returns one has to make, there is no need to tell this, anyway, their returns are also fixed, that a *mu'min* has to make how many returns. But it is not necessary that after 1000 years he must come. No. It can be that two or three thousand years pass in between, and God holds you back, then brings you. This is in the hands of *qudrah*, and it will be according to your accounts, that when you have to be brought, you will be brought, when you do not have to be brought, you will not be brought. And in this way, coming, coming, what will happen? One day you will be completely released. So, how will you be completely released? That at the time when you will start to end... in exactly the same way that a lamp is burning, a flame is burning, a wick is burning, a lamp is burning, so now look at it, that the lamp that is burning, your attention will always be on the flame, on that lamp, you will not look at the oil that is being consumed to light it. So, that lamp, you are looking at it, that for how long it has been burning, but you are not looking at the oil, that how many tons and tons of oil is being put into it. So, in exactly the same way, you are a *shabih*, a form, a human, as a human you are manifest, and from beneath you, how much is coming and how much is going, you do not know. But what happens is that burning, burning, burning, when you will be about to be extinguished, when you will be completely cleaned from here, then what will happen at that time? That the part that is reduced, that part will be joined with what? With the highest-ranking part of the *Saq-i-Mutahhid* (United Trunk). The highest-ranking part of the *Saq-i-Mutahhid*, which has become deserving of faith, will be joined with you. And when it is joined, then some flexibility will be created in your nature, some shock, a jolt will be created. Now you will say, why was I needlessly joined with this, that this shock was created? Why did this happen? So, this is the arrangement of *qudrah*. If a shock was created, then there are your accounts with it too. There is a give and take, because of which it was joined. It will not be joined just like that. With whom the joining is made, the joining is made with understanding. The joining, whoever's it may be, will be made with understanding. And that joining will start to form from it. And in this way, gradually, a *mu'min* will keep progressing, and he will, the *nafs-e-hissiyah* will progress with the *natiqah*, then *namiyah* will progress by becoming *hissiyah*, then the lower parts will keep increasing. Happening, happening, happening, all the *natiqahs*, all the ones that have been released, are all included in the *haykal* of the Imams. All these mirrors have been joined to become a big mirror, and that mirror has become a *shakhsiyyat* (personality), which is equal to *'aql* (intellect), and you have become capable of progressing from here. And that progress cannot happen... `fa bi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?) `la tanfudhuna illa bi-sultan` (you will not pass except by authority.). You cannot get out of this *dawlat-i 'alam* (state of the world) without the authority of a *sultan*. And who is that *sultan*? It is the *Sahib-i-Mawr* (Master of the Cycle). When the *Sahib-i-Mawr* comes, he will take all these things and ascend, and now countless things have gone, countless people have gone in one *dawr-e-a'zam*. Because one *dawr-e-a'zam* has passed in the world. One *dawr-e-a'zam* has passed. We, in the 399th *dawr* of the second *mawr*, in the first *dawr* of the 400th *dawr*, in the *dawr-e-sitr* (cycle of concealment), we are sitting here. This much of the world's duration has passed. Now, how much will pass, for this, nothing can be said, because it is our choice, that we become clean quickly, it is our choice that we take a long time to become clean. But this is certain, that every single particle of the world has to become clean.

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 18 -->

I have explained to you the state of a believer's death. I believe you must have understood that how a believer's death occurs. And I had told you that we have three souls, three types of *nafs*: *nāmiyah* (vegetative), *ḥissīyah* (sensory), and *nāṭiqah* (rational). A human does not have one soul. Just as the idea is prevalent throughout the world that a human has one soul and when that soul departs, that's it. It is not so. A human has three souls. And *nāmiyah* is separate, *ḥissīyah* is separate, and *nāṭiqah* is separate. The virtues of the *nāmiyah*, its powers, its functions, its matters—they are completely separate. *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt Amīr al-Mu'minīn* mentioned in his sermon where he discussed the *nāmiyah* in detail, and he also spoke about the *ḥissīyah*. In the same way, he spoke about the *nāṭiqah*. If you... if you read your master's sermons, you will certainly find all these things in his sermons, in his sayings, in his pronouncements. You will find all these things are present. But we need to... that book, *Nahj al-Balaghah*, which is second only to the Book of God in rank for us, to understand it is a great thing. It should be part of our study. There are two things which I always say, and *Sayyid al-Mālik* stated this with great severity. And that is, the books that should be by our bedside are two. One is the *Qur'an al-Majeed*, which we should be reciting day and night. It should be read. And the second thing which we must always read with discipline is *Da'ā'im al-Islām*. *Da'ā'im al-Islām*. What is it? The seven pillars (*da'ā'im*): *walāyat*, *ṭahārat*, *namāz*, *rūza*, *ḥajj*, *zakāt*, and *jihād*. This book on the seven pillars that we have was written by the order of the Imam. And it was written... *Qāḍī al-Nu'mān* wrote this book, and its authenticity (*sanad*) was given by *Mawlānā Mu'izz, ṣalawātu-llāhi 'alayh*. And this is an authentic (*mustanad*) book that we have. And this authentic book, the *du'āt* give it such importance that every single page, every single line needs to be read and absolutely memorized. So we should always... now, praise be to God, its translation into Gujarati and its translation into Urdu have all been done. The translations are available, and you can buy the translation, read the translation, and you can also read the Arabic. So we need to... we should read *Nahj al-Balaghah*. This is because it is the word of *Mawlā Amīr al-Mu'minīn*, who had said, "*naz-zilūnī min ar-rubūbīyah wa qūlū lī kull shay'*" (Bring me down from divinity, and then say whatever you wish about me). "Lower me from divinity, O people, do not make me God (*Rabb*). Lower me from divinity, and then say whatever comes to your heart about me." Meaning, you can praise as much as you can, you can say as much as you can. The Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*, said the same thing for Amīr al-Mu'minīn, that in praising Janāb-i-Alī, you can say whatever you wish. If someone says something you think is a lie, don't deny it. Did you see? If there is something in praise of *Mawlā* that you consider a lie, do not deny it; you might just not be able to understand it. So tell me, in the realm of possibility (*imkān*), if a picture of the Creator could be drawn, it would be *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt*. Just as Allah Ta'ala is the manifestation of oneness (*waḥdānīyat*) in His place, in the same way, in the realm of possibility, the manifestation of oneness is *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt Amīr al-Mu'minīn*. And you people are understanding all these realities. You are seeing, and you have understood *tāmūr* well, which is called *Bayt al-Ma'mūr*, and how *tāmūr* was formed, how the *nisbat-i-a'lā* and *nisbat-i-adwan* were formed. You know all these things, so you should understand all these things. So anyway, this is a moment for reflection, that you must adhere to the *sharī'at* (religious law) of the *da'ā'im*. Because before learning the *ḥaqā'iq* (realities), adherence to *sharī'at* is absolutely necessary. And *ḥaqā'iq* are not given without explaining the *sharī'at* and without explaining *ta'wīl* (esoteric interpretation). This is... understand that here, the situation in the *Jazīrah* of Hindustan, the functionaries (*manāṣib*) who have passed through here, from their experience, they saw it in such a way that they agreed to give it. Otherwise, believe me, *Sayyid al-Mālik* does not approve of it. That the *ḥaqā'iq* be given? No. There is no need to give them now. First, teach them *sharī'at*, teach them *ta'wīl*. After that, we will see, at that time we will give them a verdict. Now you imagine that all the students (*talamidhah*) there... I recently went there to Najran, and I saw that education takes place in closed rooms, and there are approximately 2,000 students. 2,000 students benefit, and the vast majority are kept at the level of *sharī'at* and *ta'wīl*. The *ḥaqā'iq* are told to very few people, and that too in closed rooms they are told, and only special people are taught. It is not taught to other people. So why this restriction? It is due to its importance. Due to its importance. So we should understand its importance. And when, alhamdulillah, all things are becoming clear to you, and everything is being explained, then you should have the same desire to know the *sharī'at*. Understand the *sharī'at* as well, because "*bazr al-ḥayāt al-abadīyah*" (the seed of eternal life)... this is the seed of eternal life. If we are not aware of the *sharī'at*, we are nothing. *Amīr al-Mu'minīn* once said that if a believer comes to me who is unaware of the *sharī'at*, I will crush his nose. Please pay attention. *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* is saying this, so he is saying it for a reason. He became so displeased that he said, "I will just crush him." So it is clear that studying *sharī'at* and studying law is very necessary. This is the philosophy of law that you are learning, how the law was codified, how it was made. So anyway, I have... in my series of talks, what I had explained was about the death of a believer. I had explained about the three *nafs*—what their centers are, where they came from, where they were placed, and when we received them here, and after receiving them, what their repositories (*makhzan*) became. The brain is a repository, the liver is a repository, the heart is a repository. These are their repositories. And when death occurs, how the *nāmiyah* separates, how the *ḥissīyah* exits, how the *nāṭiqah* becomes separate. I have explained the detailed death of a believer to you. And I said that the *nafs al-ḥissīyah*, along with its form, that which is the pilot, which is a thing from "there," which was its concept, which was its system of administration (*niẓāmat*) there, which was its administrative plan (*tadbir-i-niẓāmat*), and for which it cried when it fell, and left its antecedents (*sawābiqah*), upon those antecedents it has to work here. And the form it creates through knowledge and action, all those things that happen, what are they? They are called its *sūrat* (form). And this *sūrat*, joining with the *ḥissīyah*, becomes three-in-one. *Ḥissīyah* plus deeds (*a'māl*) plus that concept that came from there. So all these three things, after combining, become one form and reach *Bāb al-Abwāb* (the Gate of Gates), passing through stages. It is called a *haykal* (spiritual body). And at whichever station that *haykal* is, its *nāmiyah* also comes to that same station in the body. This is a spiritual state, and that is a physical state. What is the spiritual state? A *haykal* is formed in the shape of a human, and where does that *haykal* reside? In the *Khāna-i-Ka'ba-i-Muqaddas* (the sacred house of Ka'ba), and it is by the Imam's order. And an Imam, when he appoints (*nass*) his son, what does he do? He entrusts the *haykal*, which is the essence of that *da'wat*, of the spirits (*arwāh*) of all believers. Meaning spirits (*rūḥ*) here means what? Those forms (*sūrat*). The essence of those forms is handed over to him. This is called doing *nass*. *Nass*. And this *nass* is called Imamate. Until he receives Imamate, he is not an Imam. And in this way, he became Imam upon receiving *nass*. And which child was it? That child is the one who is the same believers who passed away, and after three days from the grave, their *nafs al-nāmiyah* came out. Or if they were very good believers, their *nāmiyah* came out earlier. And after coming out, what happened? It went to the moon, and mixed in Mercury and Venus, and after being in the sun, it came back to the moon via Venus and Mercury. And the moon threw this, and the fruits absorbed it, and that fruit came into the food, and those foods became sperm (*nuṭfah*), and they were used in the formation of the child. And these foods, slowly mixing, the child's formation began, and it became the body of the Imam, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*. Just as we have power over our clothes, they have the same power over their bodies. They have the same power over their bodies, that they can bend it, make it disappear, or show it whenever they want. And similarly, you see that one time the Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*, was present. It was the occasion of Eid, either Eid al-Adha or Eid al-Fitr. And all the people were coming, and all the tribes, after coming, were offering congratulations for Eid in the court of the Prophet. So the Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*... you will say, did they not pray the Eid prayer with the Prophet? So many people, the whole of Arabia, how could they pray? Each person prayed in their own place and came. Well, when they came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, we have come to offer you congratulations for Eid." So the Prophet said, "O people, you have come to me to offer congratulations for Eid. Tell me, with whom did you pray the Eid prayer? Who led your prayer (*imāmat*)?" So there, there were tribes... you tell me, it was the assembly of the Master of Both Worlds, the court. So many tribes were seated. He asked one tribe, and its leader replied, "O Messenger of Allah, we... the prayer... it was *Amīr al-Mu'minīn*, Hazrat Ali, who led us in prayer." They prayed under his leadership. He asked the second, he also said the same. He asked the third, he also said the same. Whoever he asked, they all took Ali's name. And Hazrat Ali was sitting next to the Prophet with his head bowed, he was sitting there. And the Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*, kept asking and smiling. And after asking everyone, he turned towards Hazrat Ali, and after turning, he placed his hand on the head of Janab-i-Ali and said, "If there is a *Ḥablullāh al-Matīn* (the strong rope of Allah), that rope which *Wa 'taṣimū bi-ḥabli-llāhi jamī'ā* (And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together) commands you all to hold, that is Ali and his progeny." So, the main point was to show this, that look, if he wishes to show manifestations, he can show thousands. That is why he became *Maẓhar al-'Ajā'ib wa-l-Gharā'ib* (the Manifestation of Wonders and Marvels). There is no personality in history who can compare to Ali, to be called *Maẓhar al-'Ajā'ib wa-l-Gharā'ib*. His state was such that when he walked, they would call him *Maẓhar al-'Ajā'ib wa-l-Gharā'ib*. That the one who manifests wonders is going. "Look, the one who manifests wonders is going." So his state was such that people had forgotten his name and called him by the name *Maẓhar al-'Ajā'ib*. Why? Because his state was such that when he walked on the path, pebbles would bow and greet him, voices of salutations would come from there, an animal would come and greet him, a tree would prostrate, it would go into bowing (*rukū'*), it would bow and greet. So seeing these states... and the miracles of Janab-i-Ali were such that there was a miracle at every step, so what must the state have been? They were seeing all this, but the world (*dunyā*) is very bad. The world is very bad. Just as even today, we understand many things very well, but our hearts are not inclined. We do not become that good. Similarly, the people there, because they were from the *shāk-i-muṭahhir* and *nasl-i-mustakbir*, what happened? They could not be inclined. They could not bring Islam. They could not believe in Ali as he should have been believed in. That is why *Amīr al-Mu'minīn* said, "If I give all the wealth of the world to my enemy, he will not be ready to believe in me. And if it is my lover (*muḥibb*), even if I crush him, even if I kill him, he will not leave my feet." So the real matter was that in the pre-eternal world (*'ālam al-azal*), those who loved, loved; those who hated, hated. That is why the Prophet said, "*al-arwāḥu junūdun mujannadah, fa-mā ta'ārafa minhā-'talaf wa mā tanākara minhā-'khtalaf*" (Souls are like conscripted soldiers; those whom they recognize, they get along with, and those whom they do not, they disagree with). We were a troop. Because it has been explained to you that of the countless souls that were created, those who showed remorse (*nadāmat*) there, did so, and those who did not show remorse, did not. To show remorse is to accept the whole chain. To accept the *bay'at* is to accept the *Ahl al-Bayt*. This is the chain, and one must accept the chain. Today I want to say that you have seen the salvation of a believer, how his salvation occurs. And I had told you that the final reward of his salvation is his body, which consists of six humors (*fuzlāt*), which is buried in the grave. And after being buried in the grave, what happens? These noble humors... as Chakbast said, "What is death? The dispersal of the elements." But the point was, is this dispersal a problem? It is a matter of concern. It's not like that. The dispersal of elements is not just like that. It is that "*in kullu nafsin lammā 'alayhā ḥāfiẓ*" (Verily, over every soul there is a watcher). An angel is present to protect every single part. So the Lord of the Worlds, who can send an angel for every drop of rain, will He not protect this? He will protect everything. So those noble humors, what happens to them? I said 300 years is the duration in the grave, and 60 years are in the worms, then 700 years here and 300 years there, in 1000 years, its return (*'awdat*) happens, and it comes back and returns. But it is not necessary that it comes back in every thousand years, because it is a long duration. The period that is set is for a span of a human generation, in which there is purification. Just as the general Muslims (*'āmmat al-muslimīn*) believe, the moment one dies, there are only two paths: either paradise (*jannat*) or hell (*dūzakh*). And see their resurrection (*qiyāmat*). What kind of scene of resurrection do they paint? Do you know? The scene of resurrection they paint is that the sacrifices we make in Eid al-Adha... for this sacrifice, a fat goat should be brought, a rather good one should be brought, spend a little extra, but because the reward is great. What is the reward? The reward is that it will be ridden. So it is clear that if you bring a skinny one, it will be a problem. It should be rather good and fat and healthy, so that we can ride it. Where? On the *pul-i-ṣirāṭ* (the bridge over hell). That path which is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair, on that *pul-i-ṣirāṭ*, the ride is happening on what? On that goat which they are sacrificing. And they are mounted on it. And if they slip a little, it's hell, and if they reach straight, it's paradise. It seems as if life has become a balancing act. This is just buffoonery. These are all absurdities. These are things that are incomprehensible. These are nonsensical things. They are not things that can enter anyone's intellect. Who will understand? Who will explain? Who will make these fools understand what is what? They think there is a scale in the east and west where all things will be weighed. Brother, those are weighed in the scale of intellect (*mīzān-i-'aql*). It's not some such thing that a grocer is sitting with a scale and weighing. So all these things, all these points, are to be understood, to be comprehended. It's not that they are such things. They... here, the Muslims say that the trumpet of Israfil is in such a state that it is a big horn that has stretched from east to west, and who knows how many angels are lifting it or not, but Israfil is blowing it. Israfil, who is an angel, who is among the great angels, the chief of angels, he is blowing. And what happens when he blows? In it, there are as many holes as there are people. When air comes out of a hole, that trumpet sounds, and from here, people start rising from their graves, shaking off their shrouds. This is some... is this some game, some spectacle? Rising from graves, and that's why they place twigs and make a chamber for them... These are all nonsensical things. None of this is true. If there were no knowledge, no core (*lubb*), no rationales (*ma'qūlāt*), and no knowledge of the Quran, all this would become absurd. There is no such thing. It's not that a person dies when a leaf falls from the Sidrat tree, nor does a person become alive when air comes out of the holes of a horn. None of it is true, it is not so. But all of them are things to be understood from a knowledgeable perspective. Because there are countless things to understand. That's why, in terms of moving away from my main topic, I am leaving them and moving forward. I was saying how your humors progress, and how, along with their return, you come back to the world and you progress. But when a believer progresses, then regarding the progress of a believer, I had said that there is a difference between the progress of a believer and a sinful believer (*momin-i-muqassir*). Who is a *momin-i-muqassir*? One who is a sinful believer. You will say, who is not a sinner? All are... you can easily understand the difference between a sinful believer and a non-sinful believer. One who commits major sins (*kabā'ir*) will be considered a sinful believer. I have listed the major sins for you. The believer who commits major sins is the one who will fall into trouble, and he will not be saved easily. And the first punishment he will get is that he will have to endure three days of confinement in the grave for his *nāmiyah* to be released. For three days he is imprisoned, and the *nāmiyah* cannot be released easily. He has to endure the torment of the grave for three days, but not more than three days. And the believer who is pure and clean, he passes away and his *nāmiyah* is released. The *ḥissīyah* also goes, and the *nāṭiqah* also goes. The pilot has taken all the things. Now, what is the need? See, if there is a train, and the horsepower of the engine is considered. If the weight is high, but the horsepower is more, the engine will pull it. So, either our knowledge should be so vast, so comprehensive, so dominant, so strong, that it can pull all the garbage-filled wagons. Meaning, if there have been some sins, if there are garbage in our body, and we are tainted by sins, then it should be pulled by the power of knowledge. That is why Allah Ta'ala said about the virtue of knowledge: "*yarfa'i-llāhu-lladhīna āmanū minkum wa-lladhīna ūtū-l-'ilma darajāt*" (Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees). The exaltation of ranks is based only on knowledge, not on deeds. So why are deeds put behind? For this very reason. Now you see, either make the engine powerful enough to pull the heavy wagons that are tainted with sin, or keep reducing the sins so that even a light engine, one with less power, can pull it. Both options are before you. That is why *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* preferred this more: that not every person has the capacity to acquire knowledge, to be able to delve into knowledge, to master all sciences, and for his life to be sufficient, for him to find a true teacher (*mu'allim-i-ṣādiq*), and for books to be available. All these things are not possible. So at the very least, do this: by abstaining from sins, filter your body, purify it, so that when the puller pulls, it doesn't have to exert force. That is why he said, "*takhaffafū talḥaqū*" (Be light, and you will catch up). This is a single sentence of *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt*. He says, "*takhaffafū talḥaqū*." "Be light, and you will catch up." This does not mean to diet. It does not mean to make yourself thin. No, no. By reducing sins, you have to purify yourself so that you can catch up. So that is why *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt*... at the time when he fought the battle... of... your... the battle that was fought of the camel, that which... so, that very great battle that was fought, in the final sermon of that battle which he gave, in that sermon he said this, that "*takhaffafū talḥaqū*." "You become light, and you will catch up." This is called the Battle of the Camel (*Jang-i-Jamal*). So, anyway, I have explained to you that a believer is purified in this way. But now, besides a believer, now, in "besides," everyone else is included. See, the religion tells us that "*wa mā ba'da-l-ḥaqqi illā-ḍ-ḍalāl*" (And what is there after truth except error?). After truth, if there is anything, it is misguidance. Now you will say, isn't there some middle path? No. You fall from the peak of a mountain and get stuck in the valley. Now there is no stopping place on the way. Now you will say, no, tell us of some step where we can rest, where something can happen. Well, Inshallah, I will tell you. I am saying that after misguidance from the truth, after leaving the truth, there is nothing but misguidance. But despite that, the mercies of Allah Ta'ala, His bounties, His... His favors are very, very many, countless. What can be said of His mercy? Now see, the condition of the general Muslims, that condition is, of course, different from that of the infidels (*kāfir*). They recite the *kalimah* of monotheism (*tawḥīd*), they follow the Prophet of Islam. At the very least, they perform the outward prayers, fasting, etc. They worship Allah, they prostrate, they believe in the monotheism of the Lord of the Worlds, they recite the *kalimah Lā ilāha illā Allāh*. Although it does not enter their hearts, they do not recite it with its true meaning, but they do recite it. So it is clear that there is a difference between them and the infidels. But along with the difference, if they did not do the work that was meant to be done, then what will happen? All that they have done will become like scattered dust (*habā'an manthūrā*). The state of a pot of milk will be ruined by a single drop of urine. The very same will be the situation. And what is that? If someone is a *Nāṣibī*... if someone from the Muslims is a *Nāṣibī*, meaning one who has enmity with Ali and the followers of Ali, who is hostile, he is finished. His end has come. And calamity will befall him. Now, on this, you might quickly conclude that the Shī'ān-i-Alī will be saved. No. They will be in even more trouble. Now you will ask why? They love Ali and the followers of Ali very much. No, they do not love the followers of Ali completely. That is why they are in trouble. They neither understood Ali, nor the followers of Ali. This is that Shia. The chain that was to be followed, if they had followed that chain today, all these sciences would be with them. They did not follow it. And most of all, see, the proof of misguidance and error, what is it? To check if rice is cooked in a pot, you press a couple of grains. In the same way, to test the general Muslims, just see if their history (*tārīkh*) is correct or not. One whose history is not correct, which of his pillars will be straight? Which pillar of that camel will be straight when its history itself is not correct? One scholar gives one fatwa, another gives another. Has Allah kept his religion as such a plaything? That whoever wishes can set the date as they please? When Eid is occurring, there are two or three Eids. There you have it. They are celebrating Eid. I mean, in one city there are two or three Eids. Is this a way? So the world of Islam, the Messenger of Allah did not leave it in such a neglected state. He codified every single law with strictness. It wasn't like that. It is the leavers who, when they want to leave, leave everything. When they left, everything was left behind. So see, even the history became wrong. So today, neither is the history of the Shias correct, nor that of the *Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamā'ah*. So when the history itself is not correct, then tell me, which of their things... neither is their *Laylat al-Qadr* Laylat al-Qadr, nor is their Day of 'Arafah the Day of 'Arafah, nor is their Day of Ghadir the Day of Ghadir. So no day is the day it should be, and no night is the night it should be. So what will be correct for them? What deed of theirs will be their deed? Neither is Eid, Eid, nor is *Shab-i-Barāt*, *Barāt*. So it is known that the whole affair, from here to there, is ruined. The whole matter is wrong. So, I was saying that still, the mercy of Allah takes them. Who are they? They are the *'affīf* and the *ṣulaḥā*. The reality is that among these Muslims, there are some religious people for whom, to explain, there is a completely different school of thought, and it becomes a matter of digressing from one's place. That is why I want to leave that topic for a bit because it is a very delicate matter. And the *ṣulaḥā* and the *'affīf*, as they are called. Those who possess chastity and adopt purity, and perform ablutions, and believe in Ali, and love the followers of Ali. Such are those pious believers. They are the closest to the believers. And these *ṣulaḥā* and *'affīf* are those whose salvation also happens slowly. But how does it happen? At a rank lower than that of a believer. At a rank somewhat lower than a believer, their salvation also happens, but it does happen. Now, for those other than them, salvation is very difficult. And it is just like this, as you imagine, that I set a destination at the very top, my goal, that this is the truth. The thing at the very top is the truth. And from here down, I draw a ladder. And by drawing the ladder, I am saying that those climbing this ladder are Budh-mazhab (Buddhists), Hindu-mazhab (Hindus), Yahudis (Jews), Muslims, Shias, Bohras. All these communities are climbing, following their respective religions. So it is clear, we who are sitting at the peak, we are the people of truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*). We are the people of truth. We are sitting at the peak. Now, one who reaches near the truth and then rolls down from the top, who falls, will he be hurt more, or will the one who falls from the first step be hurt more? Tell me. The one who falls from the top will be hurt more. It is clear that these Bohras who have fallen after reaching very close to us, they will be hurt more. They will have more torment, they will get more punishment. And after that, if anyone will get it, it will be the Shias. And after that, the Ahl as-Sunnah. And after that, all of them... now there are levels to it, we don't need to get into the details, but... torment is to be faced, it is to be faced. Punishment is to be received, it is to be received. And they will have to receive continuous punishments. Now, the matter of punishment that begins, it begins with the torment of the grave (*'adhāb al-qabr*). And the stage before the torment of the grave, which stage is it? It is the valley of death. The valley of death. A person who, let's say... leave aside Muslims for now... let's say a *kāfir* (infidel). If a *kāfir* is passing away, dying, what happens at the time of death? This is what I am explaining. At the time of death, he has only two souls: one is the vegetative soul (*nafs-i-nāmiyah*) and the other is what? The sensory soul (*nafs-i-ḥissīyah*). Only these two souls are with him. And as soon as he died... the rule of death I have explained to you before. The principle I explained was what? That the *nafs al-hawā'īyah* (aerial soul), which was among the counted souls, that soul ended, and he collapsed. He finished here. The tongue was sealed, on the mouth. And the doctors saw, the breath stopped, the heart stopped, he is dead. They issued the death certificate. As soon as the death certificate was received, death occurred, now they take him. Now what is the condition of this poor soul? The condition of this poor soul is this... that the *nafs-i-nāmiyah* is within him, and the *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* is also within him. Meaning, what happens is, as I told you that the souls are outside, but their repositories are inside, right? The organs that are working are inside him. So that *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* and *nafs-i-nāmiyah*, which were acting upon it, will join with it and what will happen? The *nafs-i-ḥissīyah*... there is no pilot to pull it. There is no rational soul (*nāṭiqah*), no noble covenant (*'ahd-i-sharīf*), to pull it away. So when there is nothing to pull it, it just lies there. Now that there is nothing to pull it, what will happen? The *nafs-i-nāmiyah* and *ḥissīyah* are inside it. The matter of *nāmiyah* is far off. The trouble is of the *ḥissīyah*. The *ḥissīyah*, which has been sensing throughout its life, that *ḥissīyah* is within its body. This *ḥissīyah* will remain within its body and will spread. It will spread just like, if a thermometer breaks, how the mercury spreads. In the same way, this thing will become diffused in the body. The Du'at say it becomes diffused (*shā'i'*). It becomes diffused, it spreads. And after spreading, what are you doing? You are thinking he has met death. You are wailing, and he is listening. You are giving him warm water [for the final bath], and he is feeling it. You are taking him to the grave, and he is feeling it all. And what is the thing that will separate? Only one thing will separate. I told you that the *nafs al-hawā'īyah* departs, that's one thing. The second thing that will depart is its concept. Its imagination, its concept, that concept... now you will ask, where did its concept come from? Although its concept is not in the Realm of Light (*Wujūd-i-Nūr*). But it does have a concept. Even if it is bad, even badness has a concept. Let it be a concept of badness. Whatever his beliefs are, whatever creed he follows, whatever actions he did, whatever deeds he did, whatever knowledge he acquired, from all that, a hideous picture of his is formed. A hideous picture of his is formed. And that picture, that satanic picture, and that hideous picture, that is the *sūrat al-khabīthah* (the vile form), the frightening form, that form separates from him. When it separates from him and he begins to see it, he is astonished, thinking, "Were these the deeds I did? Was this the picture? If only there were a great distance between me and it!" The Quran states this: "*būnan ba'īdan*" (a great distance). "If only there was a great distance between me and it, O Allah, so that I would not have to see this picture of mine." "Was I living to see this picture? Today I have met death, so this valley of death should have been peaceful. The trouble is that now I am seeing the picture I was creating my whole life. It has turned out to be so dark and ugly." Seeing that ugly form, he will become terrified. This is the very first valley of death. This is the first torment that he will receive from Allah. As soon as he sees his form, he will start trembling, thinking how ugly a form he has received. This is the first punishment. The second punishment is that *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* will appear to him. As I told you, there is no person leaving this world, no living being, who does not see Ali. It cannot be. Why? Because you are the master of the age (*ṣāḥib al-dawr*). You are the master of the time (*mālik-i-waqt*), and in the *nisbat al-'ālā*, you hold the highest station. And in that respect, in the state of possibility, you are the God of the time (*khudā-i-waqt*). So your appearance is absolutely necessary. That is why the Prophet said, "Ali, *qasīm an-nāri wa-l-jannah*" (the distributor of Hellfire and Paradise). "*'Alīyyun ḥubbuhu junnah, qasīm an-nāri wa-l-jannah*" (Ali, love for him is a shield, the distributor of Hellfire and Paradise). That is, love for Ali is what gives salvation from the fire of hell. And Ali is what? He is the distributor of hell and paradise. So you saw that when he appeared to the believer, it was with good tidings, saying, "Come towards paradise. You have endured hardship your whole life, now paradise is prepared for you." And to a *kāfir*, what are you giving? It is *nazārat* (a warning). Now you are threatening him: "Why did you...?" Now you will say, a *kāfir* was born in a *kāfir*'s house. He received no lesson, nothing. Neither did he have any Muslim company, nor did he receive the call of a missionary. He doesn't know the Imam. Nor does he know anything. The reality is that our intellects are very limited. We do not see all these things. If Providence (*qudrat*) does not provide all these things and then punishes, then it would be a reflection on Providence itself. Providence provides this to everyone. It is the right of Providence to provide the right path to everyone. At some point, it shows them the right path. But when one does not understand the right path, then they are left alone, saying, "It is your choice. If We had to compel you, We would have compelled you right there." Why did Providence not compel us? In that pre-eternal realm, that spiritual realm, when the Tenth Intellect presumed equality, to make him understand, the First Intellect and the Second Intellect would have explained together, "Brother, you have been given intellect, knowledge, power, life. You are in this spiritual realm, near the supreme throne of Allah. So believe, understand." They would have made him understand. Why? Because with Allah, there is no compulsion. He has everything, but not compulsion. When there is no compulsion, then it is a realm of free will. If there is free will, then it is upon our understanding. Because it was a realm of free will, at that time we chose what we thought was appropriate for ourselves. We chose, so we came to remorse. We chose, so we became *kallam*. We chose, so we became the Tenth Intellect. We chose, so we became pure among all creatures. If we chose, we did. If we did not choose, we became *shāk-i-muṭahhir* or *nasl-i-mustakbir*. So it was a realm of free will. Not of compulsion. Now this that is happening here... now they are coming into a state of compulsion, now they are getting trapped. And now their form is becoming vile, it is becoming bad. Because the Messenger of Allah had given them guidance. The one who was to make them understand had made them understand. You will ask when he made them understand, what he made them understand? I don't know anything, there is no letter, no... no voice from the radio, nothing. Leave all that. But this is... That is why the Prophet said, "*wa mā 'alaynā illā-l-balāgh al-mubīn*" (And our duty is only to convey the clear message). We have no other duty but to convey. If the Prophet had not said this, this is proof that it is the duty of every messenger to convey. It is the duty of every conveyor to convey. The work of conveying happens, and it is conveyed. If the message does not reach you, then let it not reach. You want to remain in evil, then remain. How is God? As you are, so is He. You might think that we will become this or that. It cannot happen. That is why it is said in the noble Quran that God has not changed the condition of a people until they have a desire in themselves to change. This has been turned into a couplet, but it is a verse of the noble Quran. It is a verse of the Holy Quran that Allah Ta'ala does not change the condition of a people until they themselves change their condition. So it means that one has to change oneself. Since they did not change, God also did not change. As they desired, God also said so. So now this vile form starts appearing before them, and they start trembling because of it. And *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* appears to them at that time, and he will give them a warning: "Now go towards hell. You did not do the work you were supposed to do. Now you have to face punishment. You have to face punishment." Where for the believer there is good tidings, here for him there is a warning. Now this form will be separated from him. This form, which is his ugly form, his evil form, which holds his evil beliefs, and all his evil thoughts, evil characters, evil deeds, evil words... Now you will say, how many Muslims will be good, how many infidels will be good? Leave aside the good and bad. Take the fundamental thing. Those good and bad, I have also explained that God sees every good person and every bad person. I will tell you, in the course of the lesson, how their goodness is rewarded, and how their evil is rewarded. How the results of their night vigils are obtained, and how the result of their good character, their good deeds, is obtained. But they must receive punishment, and that fundamental thing is their heedlessness, their turning away from the truth of the religion. As they have turned away from the religion, their first punishment is that their form appears before them, and they start trembling, thinking, "If only there were a great distance between me and this." Now this state of the form occurred. Now with the form, what happened? You gave him the ritual bath (*ghusl*), shrouded him, and after shrouding him, you went and buried him. When you are burying him, this vile form is walking along with him. This vile form that has come out of him is walking along with its body. Just as the owner does not leave his house, a horse always looks at its stable and turns, in the same way, this house in which it has lived for many, 60-70 years, it does not leave that house. That vile form keeps wandering along with it. And when you take it and bury the corpse, as soon as you bury it, what happens? That you have buried it. Now what has happened? That the body, whose humors, the six humors are his too, as they were ours, along with the six humors, what else is there? Plus *nāmiyah*, plus *ḥissīyah*. Do you understand? Plus *ḥissīyah*, plus *nāmiyah*, he was buried with that. He is buried with the *nāmiyah*, he is buried with the *ḥissīyah*. This is the doomsday, that he is buried with the *ḥissīyah*. Just think about it. The one whom we consider dead, he has not been able to die. What will happen? Sensation (*ḥiss*) is present, but only one difference occurs with death, and what is that? In the active state, our sensation is like this, and after death, the state that occurs is a passive state. The state of active and passive, the state of potential and actual, that state remains. Now, in this state of potentiality, they are put in, and that body is buried. After it is buried, that vile form stands there and watches the scene, and it wails greatly in its place, and it is in a state of great anguish. Our pens cannot describe that state of anguish. They cannot describe that state of anguish, that the form is watching its own body, with which it was attached for a long time, whose essence it itself is, whose output it itself is, it starts watching that body. And with great regret, it watches the body. But the body gets buried. It tries to somehow attach itself to the body. So many attempts are made by that form... Our eyes cannot see them, and we cannot know what is happening and what is not happening, but that vile form is clashing with the body. And it hits it countless times, to become attached to the body, but it cannot become attached. It cannot become attached, and finally, the body is buried. After being buried, this vile form that is there, it starts circling around it. It starts circling around the grave, and its circling is in such a way that, just as we circle the Kaaba, or we circle around some good thing, in the same way, it starts wandering around its grave. It keeps wandering, and this wandering of its continues for how long? For 40 days. It continues for 40 days. That is why the forty-day mourning period (*chehlum*) came into being. Did you see? The *chilla*, *chilla* that came about, it came from this. You understand? *Chehlum* is this. Why? Because those who came and taught us, did the Prophet not tell us? Did Ali not tell us? Did the prophets not tell us? This *chilla* was told by whom? By this very form, it said, "Look, it's a matter of 40 days." For 40 days it stays near its grave and wails. It cannot leave. And it is sitting there, doing this. What happens is that finally, when the final period starts to end, after 40 days, at that time, it goes out of its mind. It goes out of its mind, and because there is corporeality in it, a little corporeality is in it, so because of that corporeality, it takes on a form and starts to cry a little. And those sounds of crying are heard. That is why in old graveyards, the sounds of crying are heard. Our Du'at call it *anīn*. Its name is *anīn*. Those sounds of crying are called *anīn*. These sounds of crying keep happening, and after being there for 40 days, after 40 days of confinement, their release is completed, and this form is removed, "Now go. Get out of here. Now you are not fit to be here." "You are not fit to be near this grave, which is your grave." So now that form leaves from there. After leaving, its condition becomes even worse. The condition of that form, which is called the *sūrat al-khabīthah*, becomes even worse. Its condition becomes even more wretched. And what is that condition? Either what does it do? As they say, "a rat in a trap fights with its teeth." The same is the case, that now it is ready for battle. "Do whatever you want, however you want." Such becomes its state. And after leaving from there, it comes straight... six or seven places have been mentioned. Those are its dens. These are its dens, its lairs, its homes, its abodes, where it stays. The first thing it likes very much is the latrine (*bayt al-khala*). It likes the latrine. That is why our elders, the venerable Du'at, the 12 etiquette they first wrote in the treatise were for what? For the latrine. You would say, brother, what is this? They should have written for the mosque. They should have written for the throne, or for something else. What is this, etiquette for the latrine? It is for this reason that it starts from here. First, say *a'ūdhu*, then say *bismillāh*. So this... this latrine, this is its abode. This is their abode. This is the latrine. And what are you commanded? "Go with your head covered." And you are going with your head uncovered. And why is there a command not to go with the head uncovered? It is because these forms are present there. Because these are their abodes. If there are two, or four, they are there. At least one is there. Because these are their abodes. So these... if sometimes it happens that they are countless. And your eyes cannot see them. Because they have left the body, you are in a state of the body, so you cannot see them. They hang from there. And what do they do first? They affect the head. They affect the head. That is why we are commanded to go with our head covered. He had said that the reason for covering the head is that there is filth there, and if a fly sits there and then sits on our head, how bad is that? Brother, your outward eyes see this. I was just reading a pamphlet, I wanted to read it to you too. Regarding ablution, they have written a page and a half, some Maulvi sahib, and the absurdities he has uttered in it are worth seeing. That from wiping the feet this happens, from wiping the hands a person starts getting fat, from wiping the face it gets irrigated, becomes fresh and verdant, and this and that happens. These are fantastical things regarding ablution. And the things I said, you can compare them. Inshallah, if you give me some time, I will give you a pamphlet. You read the pamphlet. It is about ablution. Anyway, that was a digression. I was saying that now this vile form, its first abode is the latrine. In the latrine, it... because it is vile, it likes a vile place. And now, if it leaves this vile place and goes somewhere else... it happens that a person gets tired of staying in one place, so we also have picnics, we go on excursions, we celebrate holidays, we celebrate Juma, other people celebrate Sunday. They do celebrate. So anyway, what is their way of celebrating? They also need recreation. How do they recreate? I will tell you. They leave from here, and if they get bored of staying in one place, the other place they look for, which place is it, do you know? It is where there is a garbage dump. Where all the garbage comes and falls, or where garbage is lying, which we call a garbage pile in our language, or a place where there is a lot of garbage, they are buzzing there like countless flies. These are the vile forms. Did you understand? And its third place is where dead bodies are kept. The mortuary, where the bodies of dead people are kept. They also go and rest there a little. These are their abodes. Those are also their recreation spots. They stay there. And if they leave from there, then a barren field is also very pleasing to them. And thorny trees, very dense thickets, that is also very pleasing to them. Thorny trees are very pleasing to them, they hang there. They go to that place. And after that, the thing that is dear to them, sometimes for their recreation, what is that place of recreation? It is a crossing. The crossing of roads, on that crossing they are always present. They are always there. That is why accidents happen. You think that this is his fault, that is his fault, he didn't see the light, he did that. You can say all you want. The speakers can say all they want. But we will say that this is it. The real reason is that they are present at the crossing. And when you come under their influence, if you have not recited *a'ūdhu billāh*, if you have not recited *bismillāh*, if you have not opened your umbrella of protection, and if you have not taken refuge in prayers, if you have not remembered Allah, then you are going to fall into trouble. So, in this way, when do calamities get averted? When we turn to Allah. And they are not averted when we turn our face away from Allah and do not turn to Him. So at this crossing, they are present. And the countless clashes that happen, they derive pleasure from it. They take great pleasure in it. So, in this way, when do calamities get averted? When we turn to Allah. And they are not averted when we turn our face away from Allah and we do not turn to Him. So at this crossing, they are present. And the countless clashes that happen, they derive pleasure from it. They take great pleasure in it. Just as, because you think that after death, a person will improve. Brother, there is no question of improving. He will become even worse. You understand? There is a big difference between our thinking and the reality. So they go there and cause a lot of... incidents. And they do things, and I want to explain it in a little more detail, because I am especially addressing my sisters, and then my brothers too, and I want to tell them what miracles and what effects these things leave behind. Look, in the world, ghosts, fairies, spirits, witches, demons, whatever all these are called, they are not different things. They are the name for this. Did you understand? It is only one thing. This is the vile form. These are its different manifestations, different states. You named it a witch, you named it a ghost of the world, you named it an apparition, you named it this, you named it that. Now what happens is that the supernatural acts that happen, the supernatural acts that happen in many places, that they show you things they do, great, great things, great miracles happen, big things happen. Indeed, they happen. Why do they happen? So if you are a believer in miracles and a servant of miracles, then accept them. But we are not servants of miracles. These are just the wonders they show, it is because of these forms. These are countless states. Just a small... a little bit, just reflect, and empty your mind for a moment of reflection and understand and listen to one thing I say. And that is, did the Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*, in his noble *sharī'at*, not say that I am making *ghinā* (singing with musical instruments) forbidden? Tell me. *Ghinā*. *Ghinā* means singing with musical instruments. If someone recites with a beautiful voice, let him recite. But if he recited with musical instruments, then that is *ghinā*. Reciting with musical instruments is called *ghinā*. Today, whether it is a *na't* being recited, or praise of Ali is being done, or for anyone, for the Lord of the worlds, praise is being done, whatever is happening, it is all misguidance, it is error. Why? Because it is happening on a harmonium. It is happening on songs. And you tell me, how many *qawwālī* sessions happen where? You are seeing it. Why do these *qawwālī* sessions happen? It is because these forms are being nourished. They are getting food. This is their food. Because we were forbidden from this so that your *ḥissīyah* (sensory soul) does not get food, so that you incline more towards the *nāṭiqah* (rational soul), not towards the *nāmiyah*, not towards the *ḥissīyah*. That is why we were forbidden from *ghinā*, so that you start becoming pure right from here. Why do you get filtered through sieves? Why don't you filter yourselves beforehand? Are you understanding? Why don't you filter yourselves? Why do you go to such places?
