It happened to our elders as well, when they got into such situations, when they were taken there and got into a big problem, he was a *pīr*, and he was a *pīr*, and they went and got stuck, and there was a *qawwālī* session happening there. "Come on, Maulana, today there is going to be a *qawwālī*." There is going to be *simā'*. From *'ayn*, with a lot of *'ayn*, they produce more than Arabs. *Simā'*. A lot of *simā'* is going to happen. You should listen to it. So Maulana Fathullah sahib used to say, "Brother, what should I do? I want to listen very much. It's a very good thing. *Simā'*, what can I say, what an atmosphere it creates. But I don't have ears. I don't have ears." So the reality is that if you incline towards it, it pulls you towards itself. It is like an itch. It is not something that will leave you. Keep scratching, and the itch will keep coming. So this is pleasure-seeking. This is pleasure-seeking that happens through the eyes, that happens through the hands, that happens through the nose, that happens through the ears. This is pleasure-seeking, which you are seeking in different ways. But there are guards of the *sharī'at* on it. If you sought pleasure in the right way, then it is permissible (*jā'iz*). That is the legitimate child. And if you did it in the wrong way, then it is the illegitimate child. In this very world, you get stoned for it. So where will you go in the religion? So I am saying that all these vile forms, these are the ones that do all these things, they create all these illusions, and all these things are the calamity and trouble caused by them. Along with this, there is another thing too. What is that? *Raml* (geomancy), *Jafr* (a form of divination), all these things... these shops that are set up, they read hands, they read feet, they do this, they light wicks, and they tell you... "Let's check our accounts." Brother, what accounts? They will tell you your entire account. But I should know that the thing I am telling, God forbid, let no one tell it. This is the real skill. Let someone tell this. Yes. That complete theory is what one would call it, which tells from A to Z. What is this, that they tell four things and leave five? No, no. The skill is that which tells from top to bottom. That theory is yours. That thing... it is a system, an arrangement. And that philosophy is called the philosophy of the Āl-i-Muḥammad, *'alayhimu-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*. What is this, that you take one part at a time and start explaining it? So now look, these shopkeepers that are there, you go there, and you are amazed. "What he has told! The one who told it!" Oh. He has amazed me. "From my childhood, since I asked about my birth..." The moment I said my date of birth, and with the date of birth, he drew my birthstone. And with that, he started, and the whole story unfolded, and until the end, he did not take a breath. He explained every single thing. Why wouldn't he explain? When he has four or five hunted vile forms sitting with him, then if he doesn't run his shop with these forms, then how will the poor man run his shop? Are you seeing? So this is a skillful thing. A skilled person, this skillful thing, for God's sake, do not consider it spiritual. A cobbler's job is only to repair a shoe. And another, a blacksmith, will only repair an iron thing. This is a skill. So this is also a skillful thing, and that skilled person... and what is that skill? That they keep such vile forms under their control, they tame them. How do they tame them? I will tell you that too. But after taming them, what do they do? They get such work done from them. They get this work done and tell you. "Well, how did they know? All these things, how did they know it? In his time, how did he tell that this incident had happened? His past is this, his future is this. This thing will suit him, this will not suit him." How did he tell this? The reality is that this vile form, which has left the body, since it has left the body, because it is a spirit, at least even if it is a bad spirit, it is a spirit. It has left the body, so now what will happen? That in the universe, whatever is happening, it is happening by the plan of the Imam, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*. Who is the God of the time? The Imam of the time. By the plan of the Imam of the time, the sun is rising, the moon is also setting, the stars are also coming out, the clouds are also raining, everything is happening, it is happening by the command of that same Imam. Not a leaf will move. "*lā tataḥarraku dharratun illā bi-idhni-llāh*" (Not an atom moves except by the permission of Allah). Every particle cannot move without the permission of Allah. That Allah, where did He come here to give the command? Allah has already commanded whatever He had to. Now the Imam's command is running in the universe. This is the God of the time. Now these particles are all moving. Now, if you have taken that movement in the wrong way, then you have fallen into trouble. Meaning, what is the state? That if we have tried to benefit from *Raml*, *Jafr*, etc., what will happen? Because these have left the body, the plan of the Imam that is running, that today a cyclone is to come here, and in East Pakistan, now Bangladesh, 2 million people are to be finished in one tidal wave. So they must be finished. If this is the plan of the Imam, then it is clear what will happen? These vile forms will come to know. You will say, "Brother, how did they know?" Brother, since they have left the body, that is why they come to know. You will say, "Brother, why did the Imam not put a restriction on this?" He cannot put it. It doesn't happen like that. They become aware of it. After becoming aware, what do they do? They go and tell. That is why so many things are true, and so many things are false. Because they have been telling lies their whole life, so what will they do? They will tell four true things, and you have bet on that very number, and you have won a lot. And after that, finally, you are completely bankrupt. So these are the kind of people who do this. They will make one person win, and after making a hundred win, one time they will... they will turn you away from the path of life. The loss will be such that you will turn your face away from life itself. You will think of suicide, there will be no other option. This is the state of these vile forms. And these vile forms, which I said is one thing, which has different names, and they have different functions. Now, among the different functions, one function I left out, I will explain that. What is that function? The work of the evil eye (*nazar*) that happens, they also do it. It is absolutely a true thing. The evil eye is not a wrong thing. It is absolutely a true thing that the evil eye occurs. From the evil eye, a green plant also dries up. From the evil-eye, a mountain also breaks into pieces. And a person becomes thin. He doesn't die. They cannot kill him with it, but they can make him sick and all that can happen. The evil eye can do this. You will say, "Brother, how does the evil eye work?" The reality is what happens is that if, suppose, you are wearing some good clothes, or with a good voice, or in any matter, you are going before someone, and that person, without remembering God, without saying *māshā'Allāh*, without saying *subḥān'Allāh*, he... either he clapped or he said, "How nice are the clothes you are wearing! How nice is what you have said! How nice is what you have done!" The moment he said "nice," that Satan wants nothing more than for a person who turns away from God to turn away. Immediately, what will that Satan do? It will align its gaze with his gaze. As soon as the gazes met, it became a satanic gaze, and the evil eye was cast. So this is how the evil eye is cast. Did you understand? The evil eye is cast in this way. And the evil eye is a true thing, it is not a wrong thing. But if, against the evil eye, what is there? If at that very moment, if you are facing such circumstances, at that very moment you have said *subḥān'Allāh*, *māshā'Allāh*, or you have remembered Allah in any way, that God of the time, then what will happen? Your purification will happen. And if you have not remembered, then clearly you need the help of prayers. Then take the help of prayers and ward it off. But the thing that has an effect is this. In fact, I will tell you more, that it has other miracles too, it has other wonders too. I am going to make you aware of those wonders. These are the vile forms that, after leaving the body... now what remains in that body? The *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* and the *nafs-i-nāmiyah* have remained, which has been buried. And this vile form has left. Now about the vile form, there are more details, and there are... now I have to tell you its abode, I have to tell you its prison, I have to tell you the place from where it is released, I have to tell you its rides, and I have to tell you its stations. So many things are still remaining. Because this is a very interesting thing. It is an interesting thing, and it is a thing of lesson (*'ibrat*) too. Along with that, we have to take a lesson too. And we have to seek refuge in Allah, and most of all, we have to prostrate in the court of Allah, that the Lord of the worlds has kept us on the straight path, on the *ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm*.

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 19 -->

Regarding the last lesson, I had explained that the fate of those outside of Islam—that is, other than Muslims—the kafir, the mushrik, their fate is indeed very bad. But as for the Muslims, I had said that their fate is of the category of Jahannam, but they too are not able to escape this punishment, because if they have adopted the stance of a Nasibi towards the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and his Ahl al-Bayt, or made comments on them, then they too will have to suffer the consequences. And they too will have to endure severe hardship, both at the time of their death and after their death. So no one is exempt from it. When we understand that the world of Islam cannot escape it, then besides Islam, the other religions that exist—be they the Shah-e-mutahhir, or the people of Musir-e-mustakbir, or, you could say, the other religions in the world, be it Buddhism, or Confucianism, or so-and-so, Judaism, or Hinduism, or the Hindu faith, or any other kind of religion—all these people of different religions, what are they? What is their specialty? They are believers in shirk and kufr, in ilhad. All of them will receive punishment. And they will have to endure severe torments. Now, what happens is that just as there are degrees within iman, in the same way, there are degrees within kufr. There are levels within it too. There too. You will see so many Hindus, you will see so many mushriks, so many worshippers, so many who do not bring iman in Islam, you will see them too, that they too do believe in one God. There are many who do not believe in God. So, by believing in one God, will they attain success? It is not so. They will not attain success either, but the difference is that it does make some difference. Among those who are successful and those who are unsuccessful, a difference certainly does arise. Now, the thing is, in reality, what is it? That, look, every person has to revolve on their own axis and also revolve in their surroundings, just as this world revolves around the sun and also on its own axis. Meaning, every person has to render their accounts here, and secondly, they also have to receive their accounts, so that based on the accounts they have brought, their progress will also take place. Meaning, Allah Ta'ala, as He had said that, *`aduwwun ba`dukum li-ba`din `aduww* (You are enemies, one to another), which the Quran Majid says, that you descend into this world as enemies to one another. So, it became known that this shirk, this kufr, and this ilhad, or you could say, the Shah-e-mutahhir, Musir-e-mustakbir, Nazir-e-mustakbir, they will never live together in harmony. Clashes will keep happening between them, wars will keep happening between them, in thoughts, in ideologies, and in it. In every single thing, a difference will remain. So, that is why the Quran Majid said what? *Kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihun* (Each party rejoicing in that which is with them). Every group is happy in its own place. It thinks that we are successful, we are right, and so on. But in reality, not every group can be right. The reason for that is that the right path will be only one. The straight line, I have always explained to you, sir, that the straight line will be only one, which joins two points with the shortest distance. The one that joins two points with theshortest distance is only one straight line, and what is that straight line? It is the line of Ruhaniyyat. Our din, our mazhab is the correct din, the correct mazhab. And its truthfulness, its proof is this, that in comparison to our ideology, when we say, through the Quran, that *haatu burhanakum in kuntum sadiqin* (Bring forth your proof, if you are truthful), if you are truthful, then bring your proof. They cannot bring any proof. And they cannot present such an ideology that encompasses the entire universe, that encompasses physicalities, spiritualities, intellects, sensibles, every single thing, and explains every single thing. No such ideology could be presented in the world. Please, come here. So, no such… just move forward a little. Please move forward. So, no such ideology has been presented in the world to this day. So, I said to you that in terms of kufr and shirk, it is necessary for all of them to face punishments, and they will have to endure punishments. They will have to endure the punishment of the grave, they will have to endure the punishment of death, and they will have to endure the punishments after that, the details of which you will hear. So, I was telling you that a non-Muslim, or you could understand it as a non-Sulaymani, who goes, that person has not been given the straight path. So it is obvious that they will have to suffer some punishment here. Now, the matter of more or less is different, and where is this increase or decrease happening? The increase or decrease happens only in this regard: that the person is a believer in Allah, a believer in the Prophet, or a believer in the Prophets, or a reciter of the Kalima La ilaha illa Allah. There is some reduction in it, but not a reduction of the kind that, in terms of Sulaymaniyyat, one is completely removed from this realm of darkness, is purified from it, and crosses over. That thing, that supremacy, they cannot achieve. And they cannot achieve the progress that a Sulaymani has. As for the fact that since we have achieved it, then we are indeed the saved ones, we are indeed the people of Paradise, we are indeed on the right path, we are indeed on the straight path. But what is this? What is the difference that arises? That if you are on the straight path but did not walk, then where will you get the destination? If you remained on the straight path, but you did not do the things you were commanded to do and did not refrain from the things you were commanded to refrain from, then you, while giving your accounts, while suffering in this world, it will take you a very long time to reach your destination. But you are certainly standing on the right path. For this, I give you this much guarantee, and this guarantee exists, from Allah and from the Prophet of Allah, that we are on the right path. So, I was telling you that a non-Sulaymani's situation is such that they lack the third nafs. I had told you that the third nafs is what? The Natiqa. They do have the Nafs-e-Namiya and the Nafs-e-Hissiya, but since they do not have the original nadamat, they do not have the third nafs, which in reality does what job? It does the job of a pilot. It takes our nufus on the straight path. The nafs that takes the Nafs-e-Hissiya and the Nafs-e-Namiya from here is the Nafs-e-Natiqa. Since the Natiqa does not exist—why does the Natiqa not exist? Because they did not show nadamat. Now you will say, they didn't show nadamat, but they did have some conception. Yes, they did have a conception. Either they had the conception of Shah-e-mutahhir or the conception of Musir-e-mustakbir. They certainly did have some conception. And nature has preserved their conception. Now you will say that this too was in the Mudd-e-Nur? No. The means of preserving their conception is lower. It is below the celestial spheres. Theirs is a means where their deeds and so on are preserved. And to each one, his destiny—the nasib-jusi, whatever his form is, whatever his thought is—that is given to him, that this was your thought, take it. This is your thing, take it. This is justice from Allah Ta'ala, that no one's thing is changed for another's. It's not that this one's goes to that one, or that one's comes to this one. It's not like that. This is justice and fairness from Allah Ta'ala, that as you think, so you will become. How is Allah? As you are. So, you should keep this absolutely in your mind. And this ideology, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, of the Muslim world, in which kufr has been mixed. In Islam, kufr has been mixed. That is *Al-khayru was-sharru min Allah Ta'ala* (Good and evil are from Allah the Exalted). That good and evil are from Allah's side. The fact that they attributed evil to Allah is the worst thing they have done, because of which the entire Islam has been ruined. For this very reason, what happened? All their ideologies changed. For this very reason, what is it? On one hand, they believe that *Al-khayru was-sharru min Allah Ta'ala*, that good and evil are from Allah's side. I explained this to you in detail. That, how can it be? He is pure good. You create evil. You are doing evil. And from where did we do the evil? From where the qiyas-e-fasid was done. And that was done by Ashar who said that I am equal to him. This qiyas-e-fasid is where evil began, and Satan was the one who started his canvassing from there, he started his speeches there and began to say that we do not accept. We don't accept above, we don't accept below. And those followers who were of Satan, they became his progeny. Now, these became the progeny of Satan and all this happened. But you should consider that after coming into this world, such a conception of ours is formed that if we happen to face death—any person—then it is obvious that after death, it is obvious that there are no hands, no feet, no opportunity to act with what, the realm of action is gone. Now he is going into the clutches of death. Now what will happen? That this boundary is ending and another boundary is coming. So surely, he will surely have a vision of Allah, and it is obvious that now his condition will become good. No, no, no. It does not become good at all; rather, he becomes even more vile. One who is bad becomes even more vile, he becomes vile. Now you will say, "Brother, how can such a thing be possible? Even after death..." The reality is that the factory that nature has set up is such that even after death, you will remain in your own conception. It is not that because of death, the situation will become completely different, or there will be a vision of Allah Miyan. There is nothing like that. The vision that will happen, whose vision is it? I told you that there will be a vision of Imam Hazrat Ali. People will see their Imam of the Time. But they too will see Ali as what? That he is the distributor of heaven and hell, and as a warner. So, anyway, you must have understood this point very well, the meaning I am presenting to you. And now, I had to tell you how the purification of the people of iman happens from here. I told you that in the capacity of nasut and lahut. How namiya progresses, how hissiya progresses, how natiqa progresses. Since our natiqa was from there, for that reason our hissiya also went, our namiya also went. Some went three days after, some went three days before, but everyone's main conception was their main conception, that departed from here with their deeds. This was a review of a Momin. The review of when a Momin's death happens here and when a Momin progresses in his degrees. But for a non-Momin, for a non-Momin, as I said, that since he did not get the natiqa, then there is no pilot to take the hissiya. There is no engine to take it. What will happen to that hissiya inside the body? The moment death occurred, the nafs-e-hawaiyya came out, and his nafs-e-hawaiyya, after coming out, now the hissiya that remained in his body, that will become diffused. To become diffused means it will spread out, and it will remain in a passive state. Now, when the hiss is present in a passive state, you should consider that the doctors are saying that death has occurred, but in reality, in another sense, death has not occurred. Death has not occurred in the sense that you are considering death. That has just entered a passive state. And in that same state, it has to witness all the stages, the hardships of burial, and after that, the time for burial also comes. Now, what happens in the state of burial is that one separate thing that happens is its conception. That vile conception, which it had taken and made its own. Why? Because its very foundation is wrong. Since the foundation is wrong, and its entire conception is vile upon vile, for this reason, he has neither the love of Ali, nor of the Ahl al-Bayt, nor the conception of Tabut, nor of Siddiq. With him, what is the conception? There are many strange and peculiar conceptions, and all things are vague, just as the current situation of the Muslim world is. No one can explain any single thing correctly. They can't explain a single thing. In fact, in the matter of Hazrat Adam, they have made lakhs of mistakes. They have made thousands of mistakes. They couldn't even understand how Adam sahib was made, being made with both hands, this being made of clay. Insha'Allah, when the next lesson's opportunity comes, I will narrate the story of Janab Adam. But anyway, the point is that they couldn't even understand it themselves. So when they are sitting with such a conception, which is called Wahhabiyyat, which is called fasad, which is called Nasibiyyat, then because of such bad conceptions, because of shirk, because of kufr, because of ilhad, their conception has extreme filth. And there is extreme evil. And with this same filth, what happens to them? Their inteqal also happens. When the inteqal happens, what does inteqal simply mean? That the nafs-e-hawaiyya has left. Just one thing. The nafs broke, the heart's movement stopped, this is death. What is the second thing that happens? If you call inteqal, inteqal, then what is it? That conception of theirs that was there, it separates. Just as a Momin's conception separates, which we call a surat, that through his natiqa, with knowledge and action, he made a good form, and it becomes. In exactly the same way, a kafir's surat also separates, which is extremely vile, very ugly. And that conception, after separating, what does it do? It stays with its own corpse. As long as the corpse is not buried. And when it is buried, it cries a lot, it becomes restless, because it had lived in that house for a long time, it had lived in that house. When you leave your old house and take another one, see how you repeatedly turn back to look at your house, so that you remember the love, you remember your dear ones, you remember sitting in that place, it bothers you that, "Oh, we lived in this house." So, you will definitely turn back and look at that house. So, in exactly the same way, this one has lived with that house for ages, has lived with that corpse, has lived with that body. So it cries a lot for that body. So while crying, what does it want to do? It wants to somehow become connected. It wants to join with it, to attach to it. But it cannot join. The reason is that death has occurred. So it keeps looking with great regret. All the burial rituals are completed. When the burial ritual is over, then what happens? For forty days it keeps wandering. Forty days is the period, and it is this forty days that they came and said in our ears, because of which what happened? The Chehlum came into being. Otherwise, we did not have the word Chehlum. Neither is there chilla, nor is there chehlum. This is all a wrong thing. And this matter of chehlum was established from where? It was established from here. That this one remains there for forty days. And this one keeps circling its body and grave. And looks at its grave with great regret. That this body of mine was buried here and I am in this state of regret. So, after remaining there for forty days, what happens in forty days is that this one is in a state of great pain. It is in a state of great torment and hardship. This one is taken away. It has some physicality in it. And from that physicality, some sounds begin to be produced. At night. Which is called anin. Our du'at call it anin, that these are the sounds of crying that are heard in old graveyards. Anyway, now this is its condition and after it leaves, I had told you in detail that there are some places, some locations, some spots that are its dwellings, its houses. And the very first house is the bayt-ul-khala. It goes to the bayt-ul-khala and there it hangs in such a way as spiders hang. Like bats hang. There, what one, what two, what a thousand, what five hundred, as many as there are, as the situation may be, they hang there clinging to one another, which is why the Shari'ah has forbidden us from going to the bayt-ul-khala naked. It has also forbidden us from going bare-headed. From not sitting for too long. "Brother, what's the matter? Why shouldn't one sit for a long time?" Because it is a vile place. No blessing or grace is going to be bestowed there, nothing is going to happen there. Na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, if we go and start lighting incense sticks, thinking, "Come on, this is a smelly place, let's light an incense stick." So what are you doing? In essence, what has the conception become? That you have shown reverence to a vile thing. Meaning, that vile conception, you are worshipping it with incense sticks, na'udhu billah. Even if you don't have such an intention in your heart, it will be so. Na'udhu billah, you should not do such a thing. You should... is there a need to put fragrance in such a place? Is there a need to do that in such a place? No. There, you should put phenyl. There, it's a vile thing. But I am telling you that such conceptions remain there. If it gets another chance, then the garbage dump is its place. And if there is a third place, then it is the morgues, where corpses lie, and where dead bodies are kept in hospitals, there they go and stick. When they leave from there, they wander in barren fields. When they leave from there, they go and get stuck in dense bushes and thorny trees. And they hang there in countless numbers. In the jungles. And where there are thorny trees, especially there they are found in greater numbers. And leaving from there, one of their recreational spots is also where there is what is called a crossing, the road. On the road, just as we understand that we come and go on the road, or suppose some animals are also there, they are taken along the road, or suppose motors and other things go. So there we think that the road is only for them, no, but it is also the path for all these vile forms. You will say, what need do they have for a road? They pass through everything, through the body. Why do they need a road? No, but what happens is when a road is made, they also get the शौक to adopt that road, they also walk on that same road. And especially they adopt that road where there is a crossing. At the crossing, they are there in large numbers, and they sit there in leisure and watch the show, for when a car will overturn, when there will be a disaster, when an accident will happen, so that they get pleasure. So, we think that accidents are happening because of their mistake, his mistake, but God knows best, how much their gazes have clashed. But what is it? That if you are sitting in a car and have not said Bismillah, you are sitting in a car and you have not taken the name of Allah, then it is obvious that at the beginning of every work, one has to take the name of Allah. And *fasta'idh billah* (seek refuge in Allah), the Quran commands that we should seek refuge from Satan in Allah. We don't seek refuge from Satan, and we are doing such things, so it is obvious that if Satan intervenes, then what will happen? Such things will come to pass. So, these accidents... and for this very reason, what happened? The entire Shari'ah, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, forbade praying in such places. In graveyards, it is forbidden to pray. "Brother, is our graveyard... what's wrong with it? It's a blessed place. The graves of great saints are there." No, but you cannot pray in the graveyard. Yes, if it is far from the graves, you can pray, but you cannot pray among the graves. Now you will say, "Well, what is in our graveyard?" No, the matter is that in our graveyard, the situation becomes different. Because they are still in a potential state, they are not in an actual state yet, they have not been buried, they have to pass through a period of 300 years. That has to be passed by everyone, that is going on. For this reason, since it is still in a potential state, you cannot pray on that land. This was the philosophy of the Lawgiver, Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, that you did this. For this reason, you forbade it there. And what else is there? It is obvious that in a garbage dump, how will your heart agree to pray? And you will not like such a thing in the bayt-ul-khala. But leave this for the Bohras, because what do the Bohras do? You know that their Shaikh Aadam, the one who came after Daud Qutub, who was a da'i, who was one-eyed—first he was one-eyed, then he went blind—so this one who was, that vile one, that vile one's death occurred in the bayt-ul-khala. For this very reason, what do we have? We call the bayt-ul-khala Shaikh Aadam. If someone has to go to the bayt-ul-khala, they say, "I am going to Shaikh Aadam." Now, how did this term for Shaikh Aadam start? Even we used to think in our childhood, "What is this about Shaikh Aadam?" In reality, this term started because since he died there, it started being called Shaikh Aadam, Shaikh Aadam. So what they do is, even today, the Bohras who are devout and who know, they not only recite Fatiha there in the Hammam, in the bayt-ul-khala, but they also light incense sticks. Did you understand? So, these are the realities. So I was telling you that these are all places of filth. One should not pray there. And for this very reason, the road is also not a place for prayer. And you see, in the Muslim world, take any country. In Islam, take any country, that you cannot point out a single free country where people do not pray on the roads. And you see, when this is the condition of the road, and the Lawgiver of the Shari'ah has forbidden it, then praying there is not just a violation, but it is a direct confrontation with the Shari'ah. And it is a defiance of the command. So you have seen that this is how this act happens. And I have mostly seen in my travels, especially in Hyderabad, that when there is an opportunity for this, when the Jama Masjid gets full, people pray for miles on the roads. Is that prayer a prayer? You will say, "What's wrong?" "Brother, you pray in some other place." Is it necessary that you pray behind that same imam? You pray, pray somewhere else, pray in a mosque. What is this, that you have found roads for praying? And on the roads too, what is it? Forget about the prayer mat, first of all, they have come to pray once a year, and that too, they sat on the newspaper in front of them and started praying like this, they are selling newspapers with advertisements, they spread the newspaper and "Allahu Akbar". Let's go. Because they have to do it once a year, so well, today, after one year's Eid and Qurbani, if it becomes fifteen percent, then it's good, at least we prayed. This is how Muslims are, these are the Muslims who pray the Eid prayer. So anyway, what I was saying is that all these vile places are their haunts. They create mischief there. And I had said that they also have another ideology, and that is what? Casting the evil eye. Casting the evil eye is a completely certain thing. The evil eye is cast, a mountain can be broken into pieces, a standing tree can be burnt down, it is because of this very evil eye. And what is the evil eye? It is when you praise something, and if at that very moment, these things are floating in the atmosphere, and if they are passing by, and your gaze, as soon as you praise something, and you did not remember God. You said "wah, wah," and along with it, you also clapped, but you did not mention Allah, you did not say Masha'Allah, you did not say Subhan'Allah. Then what will happen? This Satan will immediately see that where the name of Allah is not, there my name should certainly be. His gaze met your gaze, and the thing in front was destroyed. Its deterioration began. It started to weaken. It became sick. Its health started to deteriorate. And it got involved in all sorts of things in the world. So, this thing of the evil eye being cast, why does it happen? It happens for this reason. If we take the name of Allah, say Bismillah, say Masha'Allah, say Subhan'Allah, then from all these things we get salvation. So anyway, what I was saying was that they wander in all these places. And for this very reason, the Shari'ah has forbidden praying in such places. It has forbidden it, saying, "Don't pray in such places." When they do all this, now their direction is a new turn for them. And what is that new turn? It is this, that now we should ride. Just as a human has a desire to ride something, or a so-and-so wants to ride something, in the same way, they also have a desire to ride. And what do they ride on? On siba'. Meaning, on animals, those animals that are predators, fierce, bad predators, lion, cheetah, bear, this bear, they go on these animals, and go and ride them in hordes upon hordes. Thousands and thousands, five hundred, countless, they go and on one elephant, on that, all the animals, all the siba' that are there, they ride on them. After riding, as soon as it tears and rips, in whatever way it shows its ferocity, in whatever way it hunts, they get pleasure. They keep taking pleasure. This is their recreation. They are riding on it and having recreation. Now, while having this recreation, what happens? Sometimes their heart gets bored, and they move on from there. Now, since they are stuck in this darkness, they have no salvation, no liberation. So what will they do? They leave from there, and after leaving from there, they get the desire that no, our prey should be new, we should find a new ride. And they straight away, what do they do? Animals, such animals that are lawful, they come and ride on them. Now, which are the lawful animals? It's either a camel, or an ox, or a cow. These animals, which are used for sacrifice, they come and ride on all of them. But in riding, what has nature done? Since these are lawful animals, it has placed a restriction there. And it has placed a restriction there that, "Look, you, even if a whole horde comes and two hundred, three hundred come and ride, it will not happen like that." You can be on all of them, but if you have to ride a cow, then only seven will ride. If you have to ride a she-camel, then not more than ten. If you have to ride a goat, then not more than one. For this very reason, the Shari'ah of the Shari'ah did what? That a goat has to be sacrificed, you will say, "For seven people, one goat is enough." No, no, no. It cannot be like that. A goat will be sacrificed on behalf of only one. Why? Because only one surat will come on it. Not more than that can come. Did you understand? The wisdom of zabihah. We think we are doing zabihah and cutting the goat for the sake of eating, so that we get to eat meat and so on. Oh no! The Shari'ah is commanding for this reason, that the vile soul that is attached to it, that vile surat, should be separated from it. If you do this, then you will get the reward of sacrifice. This was the view of the Lawgiver. And what is our view? Our view is only looking at the meat. It is looking at cutting the goat. It is looking at selling its hide and looking at eating the meat. That's it, this was our view. And the view of the Lawgiver of the Shari'ah was this. Did you understand? So, one vile surat is there. And the goat that is struggling, when you are cutting it by taking the name of Allah, you will say, "What hardship you are giving it? How you are cutting its throat..." What is this? The throat will be cut, so and so will be... Oh brother, you are thinking that by taking the name of Allah, the hardship that it is facing, it is there for sure. But the hardship will not be of the kind that you are thinking. In reality, that struggle is due to the vile soul being separated. That vile soul that is with it, since it is facing death, for that reason it is separating. You have separated that vile soul. In the same way, in cutting a cow, seven people participate, seven people can be partners. Why? The Prophet kept this, because seven vile surats come. For this reason, seven of you have said. And on a she-camel, ten come. For this reason, you had said that on a she-camel, ten people can be partners. There, ten are partners. And ten partners, after becoming partners, cut it. It wasn't that the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, since it is a big animal, distributed the shares, and in a small one... if he had done it in that sense, then in place of seven and ten, here in the goat also two or three could have become. But no, the Prophet did not do that. He did only one. Why? The reason was this. Are you understanding? So, the vile surat has to be separated. And for the vile surat, there is a restriction that it cannot ride more than that there. It cannot happen. They cannot ride. They cannot wander. But to fulfill their desires, after leaving the predators and attacking the lawful animals, their heart is still not satisfied. So now they attack humans. They attack humans. And the first to be attacked is the ignorant woman. The first thing to be attacked is what? An ignorant woman. Alright. The first shape of the attack on a woman is what? When they attack, what is the thing that they find most pleasing? A woman's beauty. You will think beauty is from the face, no. A woman's beauty, according to the Shari'ah, is from her hair. It is from the hair. So this one, if a woman's hair is seen, then it will immediately, this, will on her… Now you will say, "Brother, thousands of women have kept their hair open, nothing happened." Even if it happens thousands of times, but if it happens once, then it has happened. You were not given the command to keep your hair open. You were given the command to tie it. Now, especially at the time of prayer, because you are coming before the angels, you are coming before the Ka'batullah, you are coming before Allah. So you should, you should come after taking complete refuge from Satan. You are giving an invitation to Satan and at the same time you are worshipping Allah. This cannot happen. So you will have to tie your hair. So it attacks the hair, they are possessed first. On an ignorant woman. And they take full advantage of her ignorance. If suppose, she is a superstitious woman, one who indulges in superstitions, then she will be the first to become a victim. The first to, the one who believes in superstitions, that kind of woman becomes a victim. And after becoming a victim, what happens? Now she babbles, she babbles, all sorts of things start to happen in the world. And after that, what happens? "Oh brother, what happened?" "I don't know, my health is bad." "Brother, what's wrong with your health?" "I don't know." "Oh, it must be an aseb." Aseb, what, this, that, what Satan, what... this is all one and the same thing. And all these things are what? As I said, Ramal, Jafar, this, that, whatever you may say, in the world, whatever things there are, all the devil worship that is happening in London today, and blood is drunk, so and so is done, all this is what? It is this very thing. It is only one thing. These are the vile surats. And these are the abdal. And these are the uqtatiyah. And these are the... they come and ride. And after riding, now what is it? The condition has gone haywire. They won't leave. You will say, "Well, there must be a reason for this." And what is happening now? She is applying makeup, the benefit is going to it. She is drinking alcohol, it is getting pleasure. She is doing wrong things, it is getting happy. Why? Because in life, whatever lust it had, whatever desire it had, it could not be fulfilled. Now it is extinguishing its desires by looking at this, by looking at all those things. It is fulfilling its desires. It wants to fulfill its desires until its last breath, but what desires are fulfilled? But the effort is ongoing. Even after death, that filth did not go away. That evil did not go away. That dirtiness, its darkness did not go away. And it is constantly trying to fulfill all those desires. So, through that woman. After that, it attacks whom? On children. It attacks children. And after that, who becomes the third target of the attack? An ignorant man. On a man too, if he is an ignorant man, then it attacks him too. And after attacking, it takes him over. So, this is an absolute reality that Satan attacks, Satan comes, he rides, all this is an absolute reality. But what is this Satan? It is this vile surat. It is one and the same thing. It has different names, different tasks. And this comes and rides. And until you have taken a beating with a shoe, it doesn't... Some of it is that there are accounts. There is also give and take. For some, it is because of give and take. Some, you also give invitations. What do you mean by invitation? Brother, you eat food every day, but when you give an invitation, you make something special, so that since you have invited someone, it is obvious that you will sit with them and eat heartily and also feed them. This is your intention. So, you knowingly or unknowingly, or without realizing it, or despite someone forbidding you, if you have done it, then you have, as it were, given an invitation. What is that invitation? For example, the first invitation is to make rekha'en. To make rekha'en… The moment they are made here, they are present there. You will say, "Brother, they are made and like this they are lit…" Oh brother, they are luminous. Just as they are, so are the angels. They are also their brothers. It is befitting for them, but if you too will light lamps in Diwali, if you too will do as that community does, if you have a great शौक for bursting firecrackers and lighting lamps and doing fireworks, you will do it on 300 other occasions of the year, but on that day, "Oh no, today we have to…" "Brother, why are you doing this?" "It's fun, it's great fun." Oh brother, what fun? They will be ruined, you are ruined. That's a different matter, you are ruined first. That's why it is coming. So what did you do? You invited it. You gave it an invitation. Now, after giving the invitation, "Brother, you gave an invitation, I have come." Come on. Now after coming, now you see your condition. It is not a matter of laughter. The time when Satan had said, "O Allah, for Adam, peace be upon him, when he comes out of the womb..." I will explain that in detail. Those are very long matters. "That for Janab Adam there are mosques, for them there are those who give the adhan, for them there is this, there is that, for them there are books too, there is everything. What is there for me, O Allah?" So Allah Ta'ala had said to Satan, "O Satan, you too have your books, you too have your mu'azzins." "Your mu'azzins are all the musicians. All these who are qawwali singers." "Yes, you will say that the naat…" These naat reciters are the foremost Satans. I am telling you clearly. This one, don't go by the naat and the Quran. This Satan reads the Quran better than anyone. Satan knows the Quran so well that perhaps no one else knows it. He knows it so well. You will say, "This is the light of Allah." Oh brother, by being the light of Allah, that doesn't happen. That... what kind of talk is this? Nothing happens. He has no reality. He has no reality. Because he has not understood the meaning. He has not understood its meaning and implications. But what is the condition? They think he has become a great hafiz. If you have understood the meaning and implications and are acting upon the Quran, then yes, we will respect you, that you have done a great job. You don't know the meaning and implications. You are just sitting as a hafiz from memory. What is the use of that? It is of no use. So, this... don't be deceived by their naat, by their Quran reading, by this. This is just... from ilhan... these are their traps. These are their traps. Through which they want to trap you. And this... as I said, you have not had the experience. I have seen such spectacles too. Where, such good naats they recite, they recite them, that don't even ask. So, don't fall into such deception. So this... these are their traps and this is how it is. Anyway, they torment. And coming... in this way... they torment with these things. So they come and ride. And they start tormenting. And not only… …but also, when Janab Adam was in his mother's womb, Satan had said, "That if God has sent down books for them, then what are your books?" "The marks of tattooing." These black dots that they put on, make on their faces, on their necks, on their hands, and the various shapes they make, flowers they make, these are the books of Satan. The marks of tattooing, these are the books of Satan. Their callers to adhan are the musicians. The great singers, Alauddin Khan and so-and-so Khan, all these are the Satan's callers to adhan. Did you understand? These are their mu'azzins. So, all these... these things... Surat al-Hamd, that Allah Ta'ala told us the dua, that is the way to make a dua. That when you submit a request, how should you submit it? Just as you write, "Your Highness, so-and-so sahib," and after that... for this reason, after that your request comes, and at the end comes your plea, that "I request that for me..." In the same way, the Surat al-Hamd is that you see in the Surat al-Hamd, first is Allah Ta'ala's... *Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil 'alamin, Maliki yawmid-din* (All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, Master of the Day of Judgment). All these things are what? You praise Allah. After that, in the middle, *ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim* (Guide us to the straight path), we are being given the lesson that you should ask Allah. And *walad-dallin* (and not of those who go astray), "O Allah, do not do such a thing to us that you have sent down your wrath upon, do not do that to us." This is the best surah, the best request, which you have to present before the Lord of the worlds every moment. You recite the Fatiha, you recite this. You pray this namaz, you recite this. Without this, namaz cannot be accepted. This is the... …after reciting the surah, the very first surah you recite is what? *Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril waswasil khannas* (Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws). Did you see? Meaning, "I seek refuge, `audhu billah minas..." "with the God of people, and from the evil of the whisperer, the khannas." Khannas is what they call Satan. "From the whisperings of Satan, I seek refuge, O Lord." "And, *yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas* (who whispers into the breasts of mankind)." "Who whispers into our chests." What does that mean? …conspired. So, Satan will come and suggest to you from there, that you should increase this conspiracy even more. So that. Such… this is an airy matter. It is not like this. We will talk about solid things, that how Satan comes. How... thousands, lakhs are floating. And while floating, what happens? When they pass by you, and at that time in your heart you are planning to kill someone, you are planning to suppress someone, or you are planning to do any evil. Obviously, you will be doing it with your heart and mind. When your heart and mind are doing that planning, then what will happen? That this one will straight away enter your chest. What? It is a spirit, it can enter the chest. These ribs cannot stop it. They enter the chest and go near the heart and say, "Oh, you have to hit this much? It's better if you hit with full force. It's better if you kill his whole family. Then neither will the root remain, nor will the issue remain, nor will so-and-so remain, nor will so-and-so remain. If you have to finish, then finish the whole family. What will be gained by hitting just one?" So, they whisper such things. And the whispers they put in our chests are that when you become a Momin... …only this much? This should also be done. Such a planning should be done that the one in front becomes silent. He should not even make a demand from us. He should not even call so-and-so. Some such planning should be done. All these conspiracies that are there, from what are they born? From this very surat-e-khabisah. It is this surat-e-khabisah that is wandering in thousands and lakhs. And from this… when they leave from here, I have told you about their haunts. I have told you about their rides. And after the rides, I told you that... I also told you that they have a passion for staying in graveyards. I also told you that. And about the sound of their crying, I also told you anin. When they leave from there, now they have fulfilled all their desires, they have tormented people, they have harassed them, whatever they felt like, they have fulfilled all their desires. And after that, what happens? They try to leave this realm of darkness. They don't want to wander. And they want to leave this realm in some way. "What is this? We are just lying here all the time. After all, we have no purpose in that." "Our body has been buried. When we go to the grave, nothing is gained. The graveyard is in that state. And all our brothers, wherever they are, are all wandering." All… it's a vagabond state. It's the state of a cut kite. They are suffering. They are wandering. No one is there to pick them up, no destination. No pact, no this, no that. So, in the end, what is to be gained by remaining in such a state? It is better to leave this realm. When they try to leave this realm, they make a collective effort. And in this collective effort, great things come to pass. Now I am leaving all those things because the topic will become even longer. But if there had been a chance, I would have explained it to you. That when nature wants it, then surely floods come. Nature wants it, then great storms blow. Nature wants it, then earthquakes come. Nature wants it, then… but when nature wants such a thing, then with whom does it work? It works with these very ones. These are the ones. These are the surat-e-khabisah that bring earthquakes. But why? When the owner of a garden tends to the garden, he plants very good flower trees, very good fruit trees, then he definitely puts up a fence. "Brother, why are you putting up a fence?" He is putting up a fence… so he has to dig the ground, he has to do so and so… "No, but you will say that the owner of the garden is wise. He is putting up a fence for the protection of the flowers. He is putting up a fence for the protection of the fruits." So the fence has to be there. So in the same way, you will have to know that these… their existence is also in its place. It is useful. In what way? That the work nature has to take from them, it takes. And it takes it. And after taking it, it throws them into a corner. That the communities upon communities, neither did the story of Nimrod remain, nor the story of 'Ad, nor Thamud. The nations were wiped out, destroyed, their signs did not remain. So, when God had to wipe out, it was finished in a second. And when He had to keep, then Allah kept, and Allah kept him. So anyway, they wander and try to leave. When they go towards the heavens, then nature also wants that their wandering should happen. "Let's see their cleverness too. Let's see their flight too." "Let's see how they fly." When they go up, then below the moon… I had told you about Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon. These are the seven planets I had enumerated for you. And with the seven planets, I had told you about the seven heavens. And after that, I told you about the sphere of the constellations and the sphere of the spheres. This was the realm of the heavens. But below the realm of the heavens, there are two stars whose shells do not exist, who do not shine. They are not visible. Only two stars. And the whole world accepts this too. So many scientists there are, so many astronomers there are, they all believe that there are those two stars, whose name is what? Rahu and Ketu. Their name is Rahu and Ketu. And in our language, what is it called? Ras and Zanab. Ras means head, Zanab means tail. Ras and Zanab. The Zanab is very bad. It is more bad. The Ras is not that bad. Anyway, these two, these two stars that are there, that are below the moon's sphere, they come below the moon. And they are not visible, they are non-luminous. So these two stars, why has Allah made them? Every kingdom that will be formed, it will have some necessities. And what are those necessities? One of the biggest necessities is a prison. That a prison should be made so that those who commit crimes… "Oh brother, why do you think like that? Make such a kingdom, it's better that you don't even think of a crime." Can it be like that? Oh brother, if there is a kingdom, there will be a crime too. If there is a crime, there will be a prison too. So, in nature's prison… nature also had to make a prison. And which prison did nature make? It made this Ras and Zanab, below the moon's sphere, a prison. And these are two big prisons in which these surat-e-khabisah are tied up. They are imprisoned there. And they are imprisoned. And when are they imprisoned? When they have fulfilled all their desires. Their accounts are settled. If yes, they are caught without reason, then the angels of God will catch them and throw them in. And if they are not caught without reason, they have fulfilled their desires and are coming away, then come on. If they come straight away, it's good. Otherwise, the angels are also present to beat them. And they catch them and imprison them. And these are imprisoned in Ras and Zanab. And they are imprisoned in a countless state. This imprisonment that happens is such an imprisonment, such a hard imprisonment, that don't even ask. They cannot move from there. They cannot go anywhere from there. There, those same surats are wandering. And they are wandering there. But there is a time when all the doors of that prison are opened. And they are given complete freedom. That "Go wherever you want in the world. Do whatever you want." Just as on the day of Eid we give freedom to our children, or the country gives freedom to its prisoners. In the same way, in Allah's nature and in God's law also, such days come for them, in which they are given permission that, "You do whatever you want. Go, you are free from prison today for two days." But after that, you will be caught again. And which days are those? They are the days of the lunar and solar eclipse. They are the days of the lunar and solar eclipse. On which they are given freedom. For this very reason, what happened? That if Muslims say, or Hindus say, or Brahmins say, so don't you... they also say, so anyone can say anything. From that, a true thing, if it comes out of someone's wrong mouth, he does not become truthful. A wrong person, if he is saying a true thing, he does not become truthful. He has said it. Just as there are many who speak a lot in their sleep, but the reality is that those who are people of reality are saying, you should understand that on these days of lunar and solar eclipse, what should you do? You should worship. It's not that you, if a pregnant woman is there, she should lie down. And so-and-so should be done. Or oil should be given in charity. All sorts of superstitions in the world. There are all sorts of superstitions in the world and it's going on. This should also be done, that should also be done, so-and-so should be done, the sun should not be looked at. And it should not be like this. Oh brother, all these... yes, of course, if science says that the eyes get damaged by looking at the sun, then why do the eyes get damaged? The reason is that these surat-e-khabisah come out and attack. That is why they forbid, "Brother, don't look." And they have become blind. Thousands, not lakhs, have become blind. So it is obvious that at such a time, what should you do to yourself? You should keep yourself in a state of prayer. For this very reason, we have the lunar and solar eclipse prayer. That you should remain in a state of prayer. You... the rain will fall. The storm will come. You keep your umbrella. You take your umbrella. You turn towards Allah in a state of prayer. So it became known that these two days are their days. When they get out all their heart's desires, their heart's steam. And they create a lot of mischief. They create a lot of mischief. And when they descend from the sky, what is the condition? That just as there is a special season for fishing, then a lot of fish are available, then you see, you cast the net, and they are caught. That is the condition of these. For this very reason, what happens? You will see that all those who do ramal, jafar, and such things, all those who do the work of Satan, all those who do these practices, they do their practices on this very day. The reason for that is that this is the season. They have come in countless numbers. You cast the net, and they are caught. So, they also know with which net they should be caught. And they... because they are of the same kind. For this reason, they easily come into their hands. They come into their hands. And after coming, they become Muhammad Sher. And they become Peer Sarkar. And they become so-and-so. They, after coming into their possession, show new spectacles. They deceive the world, they make fools of them. And these spectacles happen. "Oh, what happened? You go to that dargah. Oh, the sick person is immediately..." "Either the sickness will go or the sick person will go." "Brother, what is this? The madman got cured." Oh brother, the madman got cured, but the other sicknesses won't go. You will immediately get relief. That's true, brother. So this is the condition. That we are being taught. "Brother, you must go. That dargah… what tasawwufat!" "Oh." "The tasawwufat of the dargah, don't even ask." "Oh brother, they would be." We have no argument with that. That they would be saints. They would have worshipped Allah too, they would have done so-and-so too. But what from that? That their ilhaq is not there. They are not on Sulaymaniyyat. If there is a ticket, it is a Sulaymani one. But if you bring this whole pile, what is it? If it is not Sulaymani, then it is nothing. If it is not Sulaymani, it is nothing. So, what is to be gained from this whole pile? So, they do all these spectacles. And all these, all these magicians, those who do ramal, those who read palms, or those who speak, or those who make prophecies, or those who turn the tasbih and speak, they may turn the tasbih this way or that way, but they are giving you the opposite result. And why are they giving the opposite result? And they are speaking the truth. So many things they say are true. The reason for that is that these who are there, as I told you, these surat-e-khabisah who are there, they have a lot of accumulated knowledge in their bags, in their pouches. Now, if they are talking amongst themselves, then what is it? "I have had ten hunts today." "Oh." Just as one hunter tells another. That is their condition. "I have had ten hunts." He says, "I have had twenty." He said, "I have had twenty-five." Someone said, "I have had a hundred." So, as many as have hunted are there, but after death, they themselves have been hunted. They themselves have gone. Now they are taking them along, "Come, you also do our work." Now they will also make them do their work. So, exactly the same is their condition. That these, all the... this kind of work, all these people who do these businesses, they are all artists. They are artists. Because their art is more. And this... the skill they have is very little. The show they put on is a lot. Just as it happens, right? A lawyer's situation... there is no lawyer here, right? A lawyer's situation is that in front of him, there are piles of books. Books are like this. So that the client who comes, the moment he comes, he is impressed by the books, that this lawyer's mind is very sharp. He has filled so many books in his mind. Now, what will he not argue? So they make the first impression. So, in the same way, what is it? That first of all they make an impression. And after making an impression, they do it in such a way. So, on their suggestions. For this very reason, Allah Ta'ala says in the Quran Sharif, that *yuhina ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufal qawli ghurura* (They inspire each other with adorned speech as a delusion). That these, what do these Satans do? They whisper in each other's ears. And their qawl is a false qawl. "Oh, don't go by their qawl. Look, look, don't be deceived. If they speak the truth 25 times, then with one lie of theirs, they will ruin you completely." What is to be gained? And why do they speak the truth 25 times? The reason is that they are in the world of life. They have died. The surat-e-khabisah in the form of which they are wandering in the world. And the plan of Imam alayhis-salam that is going on, the angels that are appointed, on the rising and setting of the sun and moon, on its changing, on the movement of the heavens, on the falling of the rain, every single thing that is happening in the world, in all these things, the plan of Imam alayhis-salam that is going on, they are watching it carefully, they are seeing it. They are seeing it. Now they have come and said, "Look, a storm is coming." "What a thing he said! Exactly at the minute and second he had mentioned, the storm came." But why wouldn't it come, sir? If he told the truth once, he will also lie ten times. This is their nature. And they have told lies. That is why you have gone astray. And they... so, for this reason we have been forbidden from reading palms, from looking at hands. And from having recourse to them. And from not going to them. From a distance, greet them. "Oh brother, you are good, we are good." "Your dargah is very good, but for God's sake, keep us in our place. We don't want to do so-and-so." We don't say bad things to anyone, and no one should say bad things to us. That is the best thing. So, all these are matters. And you are seeing that a fair is going on there, which the Prophet has forbidden. These are the followers of the Prophet's name. They are the reciters of the Prophet's kalima. They are sitting as the Prophet's teachers. They have done the work as murshids. They have spread guidance, and the condition is that the harmonium is playing there. The tabla is playing, the harmonium is playing. What is it? "Brother, it has to play for 24 hours." "Why 24 hours?" "Brother, the sahib-e-qabr cannot sleep." "The sahib-e-qabr cannot sleep, he needs singing for 24 hours." What is this? Now, what is this, after all? Oh brother, did the Prophet, peace be upon him, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, establish this? In the time of the companions, in the time of the Prophet, in the time of Ali, did you ever hear such singing? When it is not in the Shari'ah of Muhammad, then how did this singing become lawful? You, by taking the love of Ali and the naat of the Prophet, or by taking the naat of the saints, you think that all this has become lawful? No. This is like putting poison in a pitcher of milk. Bad is bad. Good is good. So anyway, this is the condition of the surat-e-khabisah, that for them... I have told you about their days of leisure too. Their days of leisure and activity also... they celebrate. And how they bring calamities. And how they are imprisoned. And how they trap people and how they torment people. Anyway, for them, a period has been appointed. Which the Quran says, that *amhilhum ruwayda* (so grant them a brief respite). That for them, a period has been fixed. So for Satan, there is a period. And when is that period? Until Qiyamah. Until Qiyamah, he will keep tormenting you. *illa 'ibadallahil mukhlason* (except for the sincere servants of Allah), the Quran says, "Except for those servants who are of ikhlas." He cannot torment them, Satan. But he will surely torment others. So, those who have taken refuge, it is obvious that they have remained on the right path. Those who have not taken refuge, their thoughts are bad, their character is bad, their actions are bad. Whatever thing they think of, it will be wrong. Whatever they say, it will be wrong. And they will keep getting trapped. And they will keep getting trapped. From that... there is no gain in criticizing them. As it is said, "O camel, which of your parts is straight?" Nothing is straight. Whichever part you touch, it's crooked. The whole structure is crooked from top to bottom. So anyway, from them is God's refuge and from God's is salvation. And `audhu billah min dhalik (I seek refuge in Allah from that). Allah has said for this very reason, *fasta'idh billah* (seek refuge in Allah). When you take the name of Allah, turn towards Allah, then you should seek refuge from them. So, seeking refuge from whom? *minash-shaytanir-rajim* (from the accursed Satan). *shayatinul insi wal jinn* (Satans among men and jinn). Now, you have neither seen Satan, nor raised him, nor what, nor what. This Satan who was from the time of Adam, is he still tormenting from then on? And is his mention still going on? Oh sir, this Satan, his progeny exists. And in every era, it exists. And in every era, not one, but thousands, lakhs exist. And who are they? Those who are dying, their conceptions are. Who are wandering in the atmosphere. And if you are bad, then they will come and torment you. How is God? As you are. If you have sought the refuge of Allah, then you will get the refuge of Allah. If you have not sought the refuge of Allah, then for God's sake, you will not get the refuge of God. And they will surely keep tormenting you. Did you understand? How they torment, and how it happens. So anyway, a period has been appointed for them, and that is the eve of Qiyamah. And I will tell you that in Qiyamah, after they are released from jail, what happens. I will mention that along with the story of Qiyamah. At that place, it will be a suitable topic. For now, what I wanted to mention to you was just this: how the wandering of these conceptions of filth happens, where their works are, where their haunts are, and what their character is like, how they mislead, how they lead astray, and how they... *yuhina*, Allah Ta'ala says, *yuhina ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhruf*... they whisper in each other's ears. They whisper. This very thing comes and says in your ear, that "Do my chehlum. Do my so-and-so." They said it, and that's when the custom of chehlum started. There is no chehlum, malum, in Islam. There is no chehlum, no dasma, no chah mahina, no woh tha... there was nothing. These are all our created things. Not the first jume'rat, not the second jume'rat. These are... because the elders established it, they became silent, that, "Brother, the day of jume'rat has come, let's go, read Fatiha, do so-and-so, and go." But from this, it doesn't mean that you make it a part of religion and make it a shari'ah. No, there is nothing like that. There is nothing like that. Yes, the day of death that happens of the elders, their Urs is there. That is a matter of respect in its place. But it is not that the day of everyone has that importance. And that... you read Fatiha in your own place, there is no harm. But to fix it for everyone, this is not a proper thing. This is not a proper thing. The matter of the elders is different. So anyway, what I was saying is that these shayatins who are there, in what ways do they lead astray, in what ways do they mislead, I have given you some examples of that. I hope that from these few examples, you have understood many more examples. You must be understanding very well that a lot of what happens, all the mischief in the world, the fitna that happens in this world, and all the bad things that happen, in all these things, who are the ones who work? These very ones. If God allows me to speak, then the epidemics that spread, what are they? These very things. If there is an epidemic, it is these. If there is anything, it is these. If there are germs, it is these. If there are viruses, it is these. Everything is these. Did you understand? Everything is this one thing. This is the name of one thing. If you want to save yourself, then everything will be saved. Otherwise, if you did not seek refuge in Allah, then it is obvious that you will be trapped in their net. …that a…

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 20 -->

I had mentioned this in the context of the ruh (spirit), that the evil apparition, the one we call the tasawwur-e-khabith, or evil apparition, I had mentioned its possibilities and stations, where they reside, what their state is, where they ride, and what kind of harm they inflict. And in the end, after they are exhausted, they are caught in the kuzatain (the two prisons) at night. But as long as they remain in the world, they cause a great deal of corruption. One might think, why are they left loose? What is gained by leaving them unbridled? It would be better if Allah's police caught them. But what can be done? Your system of accounting is such that they are compelled to settle their accounts, and you are also compelled to give your accounts. They have been let loose for this reason, that there is a give-and-take with you, and that give-and-take of all things must be finished. And for this give-and-take, you have to be ready. So, some give-and-take happens. What happens? Sometimes your day-and-night accounting and give-and-take continues, but sometimes a robber comes and snatches your money from your hand and runs away. In the same way, these entities also resort to mischief. They engage in mischief, they do give-and-take, and they do mischief. In short, they create havoc throughout the world. But most often, what happens is that due to our own heedlessness, our foolishness, our ignorance, we start inviting them. We invite them. At the very least, it should not be that we are so foolish, that we have so little intellect, that we invite such impure spirits from which we seek refuge by saying "*'A'udhu billahi min al-shaytan al-rajim*" (I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan). We seek refuge, but we don't refrain from inviting them.

But we start inviting them. And I have told you how that invitation happens. The lines that we draw in front of our houses, and the various shapes we make and keep, through these they come. Or when you light an incense stick, lighting an incense stick over a picture has no meaning. It is wrong. What is this? This is puja (idol worship). It is a form of puja. If you have to light an incense stick, light it somewhere else, and its fragrance will spread. It does not mean you should offer flowers on a picture. This is... you have become worshippers of idols ('ubbad al-asnam), it has become idol worship. Absolutely not. Placing flowers... if you accidentally drop them, that is a different matter. But if you are intentionally placing them for this purpose, thinking that you are placing flowers... that is what happens. And performing aarti, which is prevalent among the Dawoodis today, is an extremely impure custom, a custom of the Hindus. Performing aarti, this thing of waving a lamp around, what is it? All these are their customs. What will happen from this? These impure spirits get a signal, and they get an invitation card. They say, "Come on, this person follows our ways, so let's go and set up our camp there." They come. Or, you were told that if you style your hair, first you should hide it. And if your hair is ever visible, your parting should be from the middle, not from the side. And you made the parting from the side instead of the middle. You were told to protect your hair; you started cutting your hair. You were told that if you keep your hair, you should braid it. You just tied it up... what you call tying it at the back. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said that this is the sitting place of Shaitan. This is Shaitan's seat. But you don't understand this.

So what will happen? It is obvious that this thing... the most beloved thing for them in a woman is what? It is her hair. So, from the hair, they will immediately start entering. And what other thing is there? I said that Shaitan's book is the mark of tattooing. These tattooed marks, the black dots they make, those who burn their hands and feet, and who make various pictures of snakes and other worldly nonsensical things, or get them tattooed on their chests... what is all this? This is all Shaitan's... these are writings, and on this, these people die, and they come, thinking, "Come on, this person follows us, this person understands us. This one is one of us." Do you understand? So, may God protect us from these things. We should not do such things from which... So, to adhere to such customs which we have been forbidden from... you are following those customs. What is it? A lamp is being carried with the bride. Hey, for what reason? That just as this lamp burns, she too should keep burning like a candle. Meaning, she should remain radiant. It doesn't mean, God forbid, that she keeps burning... she should remain radiant. If one took this meaning, it would be much better. But they don't take this meaning. What is it? That she should remain radiant. Like a lamp, she should be radiant. Hey, what does it mean to be radiant? What is your point in carrying a lamp? Now what happened is that they took it, and the lamp started to go out. "Oh, this is a bad omen! Do this, instead take a torch." So they started taking a torch. Why? So that it doesn't go out. Just as they started shining torches on the gods and goddesses, with globes, similarly, with our brides, we also started taking torches. This is all nonsense, and all this is imitation of the Hindus. And the Prophet said, "*Man tashabbaha bi qawmin fa huwa minhum*" (Whoever imitates a people is one of them). Whoever adopts the likeness of a people, his count will be among them. And "*tamutuna 'ala ma ta'ishun*" (you will die upon that which you lived). Your death will be in the same way as you spend your life. You liked Hinduism, so alright, your final reckoning will be done on Hinduism. As you sow, so shall you reap.

If we have, in our place, adopted the right path, then everything will have to be corrected. You will say, "I have taken the pledge of allegiance, now do whatever you want." This cannot be. If you have taken the pledge, then you must adhere to all things and also be aware of the Shari'ah. You might say, "I will remain ignorant, I will remain ignorant, Allah will forgive me." Hey, why did you remain ignorant? You will be caught for this from the very beginning. You will be caught from the beginning. That is why Mawla-e-Ka'inat said, "Whoever comes to me ignorant, I will break their nose, whether male or female believer." That is why it was said that one should seek knowledge even if one has to go to China for it. So, what we learned is that this thing is useless, and it is something that puts one in trouble. Shaitan misguides us, and in the same way, he comes through these tricks, and he will cause us harm. If we keep giving such invitations, he will surely keep coming and will continue to cause us harm. So, in any case, they keep creating havoc in this universe, and new uproars keep happening. The truth is, may God make me speak the truth, all the calamities, all the earthquakes, all those things... within the workshop of nature, even the natural calamities, as we call them, when they come, nature also works through them. Nature works through them. Storms blow, this and that happens. So why do we give the adhan? We give it for this reason: that these things are happening, and they are coming, but you should become safe in your place, so that your angels who have come for the adhan may stop them, and you may remain safe. And thousands of times such things have happened that when you gave the adhan, that thing was averted from you. Indeed, it happens. Why wouldn't it? When you take the name of Allah, why wouldn't it be averted? So, you should at least recite *La hawla*. You keep inviting them and also keep reciting *La hawla*. This makes no sense. You should seek refuge from it, and you should seek refuge completely. Because Shaitan... that is why the Prophet had said... see, this is a very great saying of the Prophet. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, says that Shaitan runs with your blood. Hey, what is this thing? Why did the Prophet say this? He runs within your blood. This means that our sensations, our emotions, our feelings... within them, various things come to us, and we bring out new ideas from our minds. And man is never satisfied in his place. "Oh, I should eat something better than this. This should be more delicious." Oh, you've used ten spices, now you need to use thirty-two spices. You have done this, now you have to do something of a higher level. You have bought so many cars, now you need to add one more. Now one has to sit in a plane. Hey, what is this? You have transportation, things to wear, a bed, a place to live, a house, food to eat, drink... whatever you have... in that, you keep wanting more and more, going beyond the limit. And that is because you... you don't see that you are putting yourself into so much trouble. And you are becoming more heedless of the world, and you are becoming more distant from the din. You are getting lost. This should not happen.

And what do these entities do while living in this world? For them, this is fun. The moment they see any person showing the slightest heedlessness towards the din, they grab their hand. "This is my person." That's it. "You've only stopped going to one Jumu'ah prayer." "Hey, what's the need to go to this Jumu'ah? We are among those who go on Eid." What... "Alright, it's over." So this Shaitan... that is why "*khatamallahu 'ala qulubihim*" (Allah has set a seal upon their hearts) that Allah will seal their hearts. Allah will seal their hearts, and they will abandon everything, stop coming, and as for the da'wat... "what da'wat?"... they will abandon everything. So all these things... their thoughts will be ruined, everything about them will be ruined. So I was saying that they cause a lot of mischief, they do a lot of things.
