How long will they remain? Until the Riser of the Resurrection (Qa'im al-Qiyamah) comes, and after he comes, after the sultan comes, what will happen? He will gather all the haykals into himself and, taking them along, will depart. `fa-bi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma...` (Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?). Allah Ta'ala says, `la tanfudhuna illa bi-sultan, fa-bi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (you will not pass through except by authority. So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?). You can never pass through except with the help of a sultan (authority). So it is known that the sultan is the one who is to come, the Riser of the Resurrection, who is to do justice and equity. When he comes, all the haykals will have to be released. But to go and merge into the haykal, this is in our power, that through our deeds we may enter, and the Imam may accept us too. Now, what will happen there? For the soul, a spiritual paradise, meaning there is knowledge ('ilm), there is gnosis ('irfan), there too one has to learn, to read... you might think that death has occurred, it's all over, eating is over, drinking is over, this nourishment is over, that nourishment is over. No. To read more, to do more, all of that is after death. What is there here? That is the most of all. This is because those who enter the haykal and those who progress through their stages, on every single step, they keep learning the sciences. They keep learning the sciences and continually they acquire sciences and gnosis and insights and all these things, and this progress continues. So for them, for the spiritual thing, spiritual sciences, and for the physical thing, physical... and for the physical thing, what kind of paradise? Now, the concept of paradise that people have tied for you, that is in its own place; what the Majestic Qur'an describes is in its own place. That brother, there are such pleasures there, such things are there, and those things are there, absolutely we too... `amanna wa saddaqna` (we believe and we affirm). We also believe. And what is that matter? The real matter is, should the soul progress, should the soul itself take everything, and the body not? No. This body of ours, this has been tempered in a great fire. This has been tempered by the fire of fasting. This has prayed prayers until its ears burst. This body is an act of hardship ('amal-e taklifiya). This is an act of hardship which you call a burdensome act ('amal-e taklifi). You will say, 'No, no, brother, don't speak ill of prayer. It is a hardship.' Brother, if it is a burdensome act, then why not call it that? It is a burdensome act. This is a burdensome act. So these burdensome acts have been done. Oh, Zakat is given with some difficulty. That too has been given. So everything has been done, all these acts of hardship have been done, so what is left out? When all these acts have been done, it is also necessary to receive its reward. It is this very body of ours that has done it. So when the body fasted, the body prayed prayers, the body did all the work, performed Hajj too, performed Tawaf too, went forward to strike the jamar, when it has endured all these hardships, it is also necessary for the body to receive a reward. And that reward too will begin from the grave. When you are starting the punishment, the reward too will begin from the grave. For this reason, the Prophet states at this level that `al-mawt raihanat al-mu'min` (death is the fragrance of the believer), that for the believer, it is a cause of pleasure. It is paradise, it is a cause of pleasure, and he will tour the gardens of paradise. So what is meant by touring paradise? First of all, he will observe this, that the resident who has departed from his abode, he is in the spirit and fragrance of Allah. The body will realize this first. And this body, which is made of our six residues, as I have described to you, what will happen to these six residues after our body decomposes? Nature will protect it. These are the residues of a believer; they are not the... mixtures of others that they should be burned in fire or thrown somewhere in water, or something done to them. These are the noble residues of a believer. They are not meant to go here and there. Angels are appointed over them. Nature will take this along, and justice for it will be done at the hands of the Qa'im. Just as all the haykals are to be judged at the hands of the Qa'im, which I will explain to you tomorrow, and the last lesson will be tomorrow. So in the same way, I am explaining to you what action takes place after that justice is done. It is that the haykal will be completely integrated and will progress from the tenth purgatory. But for the body, this will happen, that all the bodies of the believers that have been tempered in fire, from Adam until now, the first opportunity is this, and the first matter is that the ummah of Adam should be given the chance because they are very ancient. After that, the ummah of Noah, of... of Abraham, of Moses, of Jesus, all these ummahs of the prophets should come, one after another. But what happens is, after that, the Prophet... the ummah of the Master of both worlds will come. Undoubtedly. But what has happened is that we, those who have come, our fate is somewhat awakened, and the real matter is that we have come in the era of the Qa'im. The era of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, a thousand [years] has ended, and after that, the era of the Qa'im has begun; we have come in that. And those who are to come, they are to come in the dregs. And those who come at this time, they come as greater sinners. And if we call ourselves greater sinners, our children are even greater sinners. You can call them innocent, [unclear], you can name them the moon and the sun, whatever you like, but they are greater sinners. From the perspective of realities, they are greater sinners. And what can be done? If you mix a solution and shake it, then if you hold the glass, dregs will settle at the bottom. So this is the dregs. This is an era of dregs; at this time, people are being born, emerging from behind the veil. Don't even ask about their conditions. Those who are good are also entangled with much evil. Those who are evil are very evil indeed. So we who have come, we have been brought at such a time when our environment is extremely bad. The environment is so bad that there's the radio, here the television, here things from all over the world, here magazines, here newspapers, here... sometimes we read one thing, sometimes another, our mind gets disturbed, gets scattered. Although, 'a thing of beauty is a joy forever.' A beautiful thing is a good thing forever, Keats had said. But in reality, what is it that... our condition is this, that a single saying of a da'i weighs upon one's entire life. A single saying is very heavy. But we... where do we have the time to think? Look at the struggle of our lives. Look at our condition. Where do we get the time to think? So anyway, in such a struggle, our condition has become quite strange. So nature, obviously, after making us go through this condition, should also give us a reward accordingly. When we are enduring so many hardships, and... sometimes you are being called a Rafizi, sometimes you are being called a Munkir, sometimes you are being told something, 'They have no religion, they are neither Sunni nor Shia, what religion do they follow, God knows.' You, two days before... these people are among those who celebrate Eid two days early. What kind of taunts you have been hearing. Yes, you will keep hearing them and will continue to hear them. So, what you have had to hear, to lessen its intensity, the Lord of the Worlds will make you manifest first. That era of unveiling (daur-e kashf) that will begin after the... that... decision of the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, after justice and equity, who are the first ones to manifest? We will be. We will be the first to manifest. But how will we manifest? Here... in this very place, or on the land of Kuwait like this, or with such restrictions and laws? No, no, sir. These legal restrictions will not remain. These visa troubles will not remain. And such... such matters... the iqama, that is a strange thing, what kind of iqama it is, Allah knows. So these troubles, these things, for God's sake, will not remain. Go where you want, go when you want. And the Hazir Imam is present. They have been called Hazir Imam, Hazir Imam, Hazir Imam. Meaning, the sun has risen, in its light everything is illuminated. Now, in this floodlight, look at everything, nothing is hidden. This is not the darkness of night where every... every harmful animal is coming out of its hole and biting you, and thieves and robbers are also looting you. These are not such things. Now the era has changed, the era of light has come. It is unveiling (kashf), kashf means the light of day. The era is of the day. The Imam is present. Now you don't need to, brother, go and ask him, go and ask them. Come on, now the Imam himself is present, you can ask him. What is the question now? So the drum of the Imam is beating, and he himself, the imamate is... is ongoing. And what kind of era will that be? Just you... keep thinking about your troubles, and keep removing those troubles. You will get the concept of what the era of unveiling will be. The condition of the era of unveiling is such that what more can I explain in detail. Some du'at have written on this, don't even ask. Allahu Akbar. What they have described. I only told you one small thing, and they... they only said this much, that the human being, the psychological faculties he possesses, the intellectual faculties he possesses, the spiritual faculties of the heart he possesses, he will begin to utilize those faculties completely. Look, today science, our sciences that have progressed, these are intellectual sciences ('ulum-e 'aqliyah). In these intellectual sciences, the highest knowledge is science. And because of the advancements of science, how much benefit we are getting. Now, when the progress of science reaches this state, then in the era of unveiling, there will be no obstacle at all, so what progress will it make. And who will be the ones to benefit from these advancements? We will be. Okay, you will say, 'Brother, let's go, you have travel... transport, this and that... you are going to go sitting in a rocket, you are going to go into space.' Okay, everything is done. But what will you do, sir, in your house there are bedbugs, there are fleas, there are mosquitoes. What troubles there are, the human's... what is the state of diseases? This epidemic has spread. Oh, what epidemic is it, sir? While reading here... this has happened, this calamity has happened, don't go to that place, please show a health certificate that you... are not afflicted and have come. So now, what are all these things? They are not there at all. There is no mosquito, no bedbug, no flea, no fly. That's it. Now who would not like to live on such a land? No mosquito, no bedbug, no flea. Why? Why are all these here now? It is because you are in a state of retribution (qisas), of inclination (mailan), of approbation (istihsan). Now your... what are you doing day and night? You are paying your approbation, you are paying your retribution, you are paying your inclination. You... in the process of paying, you are heedlessly, imperceptibly, paying everything. Everything is being paid by you. So diseases are also coming, why? Because your body is not filtered, your body is not clean, and it has taken on a lot of accounts. It is taking all the accounts from you. Fever, chills are happening, that is happening, this is happening, a cold is happening, you are enduring all things. Why? Brother, it is because you have to do everything so that you... for this reason the Prophet had said, from this... angle, at this place, that for you, this is salvation from sins. Sins are shed through fever etc., and sins are washed away by diseases. So if they said this, this was the meaning of it. So when our very body has come clean and pure, when you have been thoroughly washed and have entered the era of unveiling, then what is the need for these diseases? So the situation became neither disease nor illness. Now if a disease is happening, then for what? For passing away. At the time of passing away, a disease came and everyone got the news that so-and-so has fallen ill. So they said, 'Sir, let's offer condolences from now. Because now the disease has come, so he is about to depart.' So you arrive and condolences are being offered. If you want that some picture of the era of unveiling should settle in your mind, and you want to see the era of unveiling in this very world, if your heart desires, 'Brother, show us the era of unveiling in this very world,' then I can show you that that era of unveiling is the Hazrat-e Imami. Today, where our Imam, peace and blessings be upon him, is, and you know, he is in the Great Sahara. He is in the Great Sahara, and the name of the place is Jabarsa. The insiders call it Jabarsa, and the outsiders call it Jabalsa. This... but no one can reach there. A fly is appointed there that, if it bites, a person dies. So look, all these are the crafts of nature. Otherwise, ten thousand angels are appointed, the air and sea forces of Allah are all present. Then, 'whom Allah protects, who can taste them,' it is like that. Who can interfere there? But in that Hazrat-e Imami, where countless believers are present, but they are present, so you look at it with great longing, 'If only our deeds were also so good that we could also reach there.' Yes, you don't reach there based on your deeds being good or bad. You are inferior, they are superior, it is not like that. Rather, in some cases, they are inferior to you there. Many people there are inferior to you. The real matter is that a sweeper, a cleaner, can enter the king's palace, but a prime minister is not granted permission to go. So don't understand from this that if you did not reach Hazrat-e Imami there, you have become very weak. But if you have filtered your body, then just as you have become worthy of entering the era of unveiling, in the same way, you have become able to enter Hazrat-e Imami. So, some people were told, those whom our du'at, our manasik pointed to, they certainly went to Hazrat-e Imami. As was said for Maulana Fazal Ali Sahab, as was said about Yasin Sahab who was the qadim of Bombay. What did he say? 'He will not come into this world,' Baba had said. So it is absolutely certain that he went. Now he has no connection with this world here. Sometimes this kind of thing happens; it is not always like that, that groups after groups are going, it is not like that. But it definitely happens. So these... these are the blessings of unveiling, these are the mercies, from which many blessings we will enjoy. You see, there are such pleasures, such fruits; if you get them from somewhere... they come, you eat them; if they don't, then nothing. But there, the situation is that everything is present everywhere. It is not that mangoes are only in India, it is not like that. It is happening in the whole world. Everything is happening everywhere, so everyone is getting everything. So there will be no shortage of anything anywhere. And the greatest thing of all, the greatest thing of all is that everyone will be a believer. Not a single disbeliever will be there. As they say in Urdu, for a cough, there's nothing to apply. Like that, there will be nothing. Not even one, sir. If it's not there, it's not there. He said, 'Where will this be now?' Those who are in stones and minerals, in mines, in mountains, in rivers, after all, what are they? They are all from there who will come, they will all go. And we will just... come. Who will be on the veil of manifestation? Who will be on the scene of witnessing? We will be. We will be there, and it will be our era. Because this era of unveiling... when we have endured hardships, now we will also take its reward. So anyway, this is the era of unveiling, in which the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, will send our noble residues in such a way; this is his justice, this is his equity. I will explain it to you tomorrow. But I am telling you that this will be the action upon it, and we will see the era of unveiling. And these... these things our... we will get all the blessings, and our soul which is released, it will acquire pleasures in this way and will benefit from the sciences and arts and all things. Progress will continue in this way. Now remains the matter of punishment; this was about reward. The state of reward is for the believers. Now, the state of punishment, and I had explained the state of punishment, how the state of punishment is. I hope you have kept it in mind. And those who fear punishment will surely keep this in mind. Why wouldn't they? Even if it is anyone's punishment, punishment is punishment, it is something to be feared. The punishment begins from the grave, and I had said it will begin from death. And how will it begin from death? The sensory soul gets trapped in the physical soul. This is the greatest punishment. And they, with the vegetative soul, and those who have not accepted the da'wah, they have been buried with the sensory soul itself. This is the greatest punishment, the punishment of the grave. Now what will Munkir and Nakir ask? This sensory soul, this vegetative soul itself will question them. Now they are buried with this itself. And even the believer is not free from the vegetative soul. If, say, he has such good deeds, then he is freed. If not, then he is imprisoned with it for at least three days. The negligent believer or the believer with shortcomings, for him to be... to be freed, it will take him three days. And for three days, that too if he has chosen, if he has eaten the food of ziyarat, food is very important. Don't think that just by having the food it is so. This common idea that is going around, 'Brother, it is better to give a scholarship instead.' These are all wrong things. All these thoughts... remove this short-sightedness. I am telling you the inner matter. That it is a special thing that you are leaving behind. And along with it, reciting the Fatiha, and reciting Yasin Sharif, reciting the noble Qur'an, will be a cause of betterment for them, and they will be freed. When they are freed, it is obvious that now they will progress. But I was talking about punishment... I was talking about giving punishment to those who deserve punishment. I have told the reward to those who deserve reward. I told you how they will be included in the haykal. I told you this reward, the spiritual one. I also told you their recompense, their prize. That in the era of unveiling, how your situation will be and how you will be in comfort... in the gardens of paradise. Both these things. But how will the disbeliever get punishment, how will the disbeliever get punished, all this has to be told to you. So I was telling you, and I have already told you, that whatever happens to the disbeliever, meaning those who are not Sulaymani, all of them, according to their respective ranks, from where will their punishments begin? They will begin from the grave itself. After the grave, the second stage that comes, which stage is that? That second stage I explained to you, in detail, is the darakat (lower levels). In the darakat there is raqs, raks, naks, waks, 'aks, and daks. These are the seven lower levels. The first lower level is that of the human form, which is of the Abyssinians. The second, third, fourth, fifth lower levels are all of animals. Which is the second lower level? It is of the monkey and the bear. After that is of predators, meaning beasts of prey. After that is of the insects of the earth, and at the very end is of birds, and after birds is of vegetation, and after vegetation, the seventh lower level is of minerals. After traversing these darakat, where will he be taken? To the peripheries (atraf). Polar... he will be taken to the poles. The north and south poles, and at the poles, they will be given punishment. There, they will be... big... meaning, they will be joined. They will be given punishment after being joined, and they will be punished there in the form of huge animals, and they cannot even move from their places. They are in such a condition. From the snowfall... and all... they are given punishment in the form of such animals. And this punishment is only given to those who are sentenced to death. Meaning, the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, for whom he will decree that the punishment of Saqar, this... the punishment of hell is necessary for them, they will be given the punishment of the peripheries. Otherwise, they will not get the punishment of the peripheries. And for whom the Qa'im will say, 'No, they have received the punishment of the darakat, that's enough,' they will be turned back. Because everything is in the hands of the judge, and the Qa'im, he is the God of the time, the Lord of the time. And whatever he is saying, that decision is the final decision, a divine decision, a decision of judgment. And he will make this decision that now, with the darakat, it is over, so now what will happen? Now they will ascend on a good path. Vege... in minerals, what... now they will become gold, they will become jewels. And then they will come into vegetation, they will become good things, they will become edible things, they will become vegetables. And after that, when they come into animals, they will become such animals that will be permissible (mohallil). Under your knife, they... they will be slaughtered, and after that, you will eat, and sperm will be formed, and then the temperament will become balanced, and the mill of nature will turn, and with that, they will manifest as human beings. So anyway, they will come again like a blank piece of paper, they will come in a straight... way, like a plate, and the matter of inscribing upon it is that the da'wah of the du'at will be presented to them. If they accept, good. If they don't accept, then as their case will be, so will be their punishment. So anyway, I... I was telling you that those people for whom the Qa'im says, 'Brother, for them is the punishment of Saqar.' Those who opposed the prophets, who opposed the Imams, who opposed the Messengers. Will they be let go just like that? No, they will not be let go. So they will be caught... I will explain all the details of that tomorrow. But right now I am explaining that somehow, the entire army of God will catch them and will take them and put them where? In hell. What are the entrances to hell, how they will be taken, all those details are for later. But I am saying that they will have to reach hell. After enduring the punishment of the peripheries, when will they have to reach hell? When the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, manifests and commands that they should now be punished. When they are given the punishment, not until then. When the matter of giving them punishment comes, and when they are taken into Saqar, then, God forbid, God forbid, God's refuge, that... that punishment for which Allah Ta'ala has said 'a severe punishment' (`'azabun shadid`), `zaqum wa 'azabun alima` (the tree of Zaqqum and a painful punishment). Oh, such are the foods that get stuck in the throat. What a severe punishment it is, O Lord. What we call... mental teasing. This is the most severe punishment of the Lord of the Worlds, which will be in Saqar. And I told you regarding Saqar, how is that Saqar made? It is like a pot, a pot that has been placed upside down. Its mouth is at the bottom and its base is at the top. So it is closed from the top, open from the bottom. And it has 70 valleys. It is very large, such a large part, although we have the dimensions. But the point is that it is so large, so vast, that entire cities can fit in it. Those who have to endure the punishment are also many. Entire cities can fit, entire mountains can fit. A lot can fit inside. And how is it made? It is made from the components of sulfur. It is all... from gunpowder, from lime, from alum, from potash, it is made from such things that are explosive and bursting. From such things, all of it... is made. Meaning, the potter and the clay of the pot are one and the same. As the soul, so the angels. If you burn there, if you live there, it will be in such a way, just the kind of environment you wanted, that is the environment. `tamutuna 'ala ma ta'ishun.` (You die upon what you live). Your death will be upon what your life is. So as you lived your life, so will be your death. Now you have gotten a place just like that. Now you live in that place. Now in that state, what will be the condition? Now listen carefully. That they, God forbid, God forbid, there they will be given such a severe punishment that as soon as they enter, when... as soon as they enter, right upon entering, Allah Ta'ala will... a normal human being, the way a human is, has one head, two hands, two feet, the way a human is, He will not keep them in that state. He will immediately make him abnormal. And he will have three heads, ten hands each, understood, some different... strange feet, in some such strange way he will come into that state. The situation is that he is writhing in this way. Some images must be coming to your mind. The idols of temples must be coming to your mind. Yes. So now... what is the real matter? Now these three heads and four hands, why are all these things coming? The real matter is that when they are beaten there, and after being beaten repeatedly when they come back there, then after coming, because even then they do not want to be corrected, they go and whisper in someone's ear. `yuhi ba'duhum li-ba'din zukhruf al-qawl ghurura.` (They inspire to one another decorative speech in delusion). They go and inspire in the ear, meaning they speak. And what do they say? 'Brother, make an idol of us.' 'Brother, what kind should I make?' He says, 'The reclining Buddha is done, let's have a standing Buddha.' Brother, standing is done, let's... let's have a sitting Buddha, let's have a lying Shiva, give us four hands, give us ten hands, put a snake around our neck, and put a lotus flower in our hand. There you go. Take the lotus flower too, put the snake around your neck too. Whatever you said, do it. They all come from there and say this, and they keep doing it. And these idols keep being made. They are made of gold, they are made of everything, they are even made of cow dung. And they are made of everything, they are also made of sweets, sometimes when they get hungry, they eat them too. They are made of everything... they make everything. Now, if all these are being made, how are they being made? These are all the forms from there. And our elders said a great saying, a very interesting one, and what did they say? That if you want to see their forms, in one place, you want to see everything in one glance, that if one tours paradise, one should also peek into hell. May God not take us there, but brother, what are they like? So they said, 'If you really want to see the tour of hell and you are so fond of it, then go see Ellora-Ajanta.' What an excellent art gallery it is. What an excellent art... you are sitting there, thinking and thinking, amazed. What are you thinking? So he said, 'Just look.' So now, what is there in all this art? This is all the art from there. This is all the art from there, and all this is... the craftsmanship from there. They suggest all this from there, and they do all this. Otherwise, who are the ones doing it? They say, 'It's inspiration.' What things came that set a wave in motion. On stones, such things... have set a wave in motion, don't even ask. So now who are the ones setting this in motion? They are the same ones. They came and whispered, they said, 'Look, I am Lakshmi, I am... whatever god or goddess I am, I am the owner. My words should be worshipped accordingly.' Now in Diwali, other worship is also happening, so they are also being worshipped. So all these things are from there. They go there... after going there, this becomes their condition. Now look at the condition that... the condition is that each picture is newly terrifying, that someone has one eye, someone has two eyes. You make a Cyclops with one eye, there they have already become Cyclops. And the condition is that... they start to feel terrified looking at each other. And in a state of terror, what happens? They are already... suffering, and they have gone and gotten stuck. And along with being stuck, just as someone is troubled by heat or cold or some other thing, they are already... all... all conditions are troubling them. So, 'war has come, war has come,' what do they do? They start fighting with each other. And when they start fighting, the situation is that they grab each other and break someone's head, break someone's hand, break someone's foot. And here they break, here he... he dies, here he is alive. Here he dies, here he is alive. Here he dies, here he becomes alive. `la yamutuna fiha wa-la yahya.` (They will neither die therein nor live). The Qur'an says, 'Oh, hell is that in which they will neither die nor live.' Meaning, here they died, here they became alive. `la yamutuna fiha wa-la yahya.` (They will neither die therein nor live). They neither die nor live. Here they die, here they are alive. This is their punishment, that they keep tasting the punishment of death at all times. So they are killing each other, scratching, shedding blood, beating, drinking. And the condition is very bad. And the condition of some, which the Majestic Qur'an has described, keep reading the details in the Majestic Qur'an. In it, it is said, `subbuhu` (pour over him), they will be made to drink such a vile thing that a person can't even... how will he take the name? They will be made to drink such blood and other things. And they, hot... going there... this has no meaning. The meaning of fire there is that the light of the sun shines there at night. At night, the sun's light, its rays come so powerfully that because of them, they are set ablaze. And they burn to such an extent that their bodies... the burning, the smell of burning skin begins. This happens from the sunlight. And in the daytime, they start to burn from the light of the moon. Did you see? In the daytime from the light of the moon, at night from the light of the sun, they are afflicted, and this heat is so intense that in it, God forbid, God forbid, in a very severe punishment, their life is, they have to endure it. These were some different kinds of punishments, and after the situation, there are different valleys. Obviously, according to the fragrances, they have different valleys. And its last valley, whose name, God forbid, God forbid, it is forbidden to even take its name, such... such a bad valley it is, whose name is Tabut. And it is the worst valley, and it... there, such people will be punished who opposed the prophets, who opposed the Commander of the Faithful 'Ali, who opposed Imam Husayn, who opposed such... such elders, they will be taken there. They are, except as Allah wills, only a few people who are understood, known and understood. They... may Allah Ta'ala save us all from this punishment of hell, and may He give us salvation from it for the sake of the Imams, for the sake of the pure Ahl al-Bayt. Anyway, they will have to suffer all these punishments, and they will have to endure the punishment. Why? Until Khalidin (eternity). Khalidin, they will remain forever and ever, and that... what does remaining forever mean? It means that they will have to complete the duration of a grand epoch. Until a grand epoch, they will have to endure this punishment, and when they have endured this entire punishment, then from there... but let me tell you one thing, it will become more interesting. And that thing is that one will go into this hell, but who will be its... standard-bearer? Who will be made to enter hell first? That is Shaytan, whose name is Harith bin Murra. Harith bin Murra, who came at the time of Adam, was the son of Murra, Harith, he will be the first to be made to enter hell. And this... what is the real matter? That he is constantly going, constantly being beaten, constantly taking a beating, but he does not leave his devilry. He does not leave his devilry, and they say that he is constantly going and constantly doing devilry and is constantly reaching his place... [unclear]. So this is Harith bin Murra, whose... whose devil's progeny is who? The one who will sit in his place and who is his offspring. Just as the offspring of a good person is who? Those who follow his goodness and are called his offspring. Similarly in evil, those who follow in his footsteps, all of them are his... his offspring, his progeny, the progeny of Shaytan. So the progeny of Shaytan will continue in this way, and continually, their... will continue, and the divine punishment will continually surround them. And until the last breath, meaning until a grand epoch, they... 360,000 times 360,000, meaning a period of 400,000 years, and one epoch (kaur) of 400,000 such periods. Calculate it this way, calculate it that way, it is necessary for them to complete the duration of a grand epoch, and when divine things are imposed upon them, punishment is imposed, then no one can save them from the punishment. Now, after coming out of this punishment, obviously, the Lord of the Worlds will quickly bring them. So they will first be minerals, then vegetation, then animals, and after animals they will come in the form of humans, and the da'wah will be presented to them again. If, in a state of free will, they have done their work correctly, then good. If they did not do the work, then they will go again. So anyway, the one who makes these decisions... whose job will it be? It will be the job of the Hazrat-e Qa'im, peace be upon his mention, that when the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, makes his decisions. Now, regarding the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, what I have explained, you must have understood that... I will mention him tomorrow, how his session will be held and the court will assemble, and all this justice and equity will happen. But what needs to be told is that the weeks of our Imams that have been happening, seven weeks have passed, I said the first week was of the mutammim, the second was of the khulafa, the third... so this... of the a'imma, in this way the weeks I told of the mutammim, so there were weeks of seven each. So if there are seven weeks, then seven times seven is forty-nine. So our Imam today is the 48th Imam. And the Imam who will come after him, who will he be? He will be the 49th Imam, so this means that it ended with the 49th Imam. But what is the real matter? That this is the end, the conclusion. But the 50th and 51st, the count of these two is separate from them. What that means is the Hazrat-e Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, and the one who comes before him, the Mahdi, peace and blessings be upon him. The Mahdi who will come before him, about whom it is all famous that he... the promised Messiah who has come, who will come in the shadow of Jesus, so-and-so will come, what they are saying, in reality, he is the Mahdi who is to come before the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him. So the one who is to come before the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, is the Mahdi of the end of time, and he will be on the front of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. And the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, will come on the front of 'Ali. So just as I am telling you today, that if you go to know, in the era of the Prophet, look at the time of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib, whose era is the era of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib? The era of the Prophet's grandfather. Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib's two sons, Maulana Abu Talib, Maulana 'Abdullah. Abu Talib, the father of 'Ali, and 'Abdullah, the father of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. Now, just as the picture was set here, the picture is here in the same way. Our Imam today is the greatest Imam, the highest Imam, such that no Imam comes in comparison to him, except for the Imam of the first week, leave Imam Hasan, Imam Husayn etc., leave them. After leaving them, all the Imams who have passed, greater than all of them is our Imam today, who is opposite the grandfather of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. But you know his name, it is Maulana Muhammad bin 'Ali, salawatullah 'alayh, and he is on the front of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib. Now you will have two sons, one son will be opposite Maulana Abu Talib, the other son will be opposite 'Abdullah. The son of 'Abdullah, in reality, will be... who will he be? The Mahdi of the end of time. And the son of Abu Talib will be the Riser of the Resurrection. Now what is it? Since it is the end of time, for whom are we waiting? We are not waiting for the Resurrection, but rather we are waiting for the Mahdi. We are waiting for the Mahdi, and what does the wait for the Mahdi indicate? The Qur'an says, `inna as-sa'ata aatiyatun baghtatan` (Indeed, the Hour is coming suddenly). That... `ayna mursaha` (where is its mooring?). You do not know where the Resurrection will be moored, and you do not know that the Hour, the Resurrection that is to come, it is to come suddenly. So the matter that is sudden is all that of Maulana Mahdi-ullah, salawatullah 'alayh. His coming will be sudden. And the coming of the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, that is a known and understood time, hour, everything, the day, the date, everything is fixed. Nothing is hidden. You will ask, 'Brother, is there any difference between the two?' God willing, I will explain it to you tomorrow, otherwise there will be no topic left to speak on tomorrow. So I am leaving this, that between the Qa'im and the Mahdi, how much... what is the distance, and how will the manifestation of the Mahdi happen, and what work will you do at that time, and how will the manifestation of the Qa'im happen, how will he establish justice. But even before that, I have concluded this matter, that those who are given... punishment, how will they suffer the punishment, and those who are given reward, how will they receive the reward. `wa akhiru da'wana an al-hamdu lillahi rabb al-'alamin wa-s-salatu wa-s-salamu 'ala rasulihi-l-karim...` (And the end of our supplication is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, and peace and blessings be upon His noble Messenger...).

<!-- AUG:hazrat-zia lecture 29 -->

Alhamdulillah, for this matter, thanks are due to Allah that we have at least reached *Qiyamah*.

Regarding *Qiyamah*, I was explaining to you that this is such an affair from Allah that has existed in every era and at every time, and there is no soul (*dhi nafs*) that can deny it.

The matter is, as Allah Ta'ala has said in the Quran Majid, `man amana billahi wal-yawmil-akhir wal-mala'ikati wal-kitabi wan-nabiyyin` (he who believes in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Book and the prophets). Look, the conditions for bringing *iman* (faith) have been threaded by Allah Ta'ala into a single verse. He said: "Bring faith in Allah," and along with it, He says, "in the Last Day" (*yawm al-akhirat*). And after that, in the angels (*mala'ikah*), in the books (*kutub*), and in the prophets (*anbiya*), He has set the conditions for bringing faith. So, faith must be brought in all five things, in which the second condition, after Allah, is faith in the Last Day. So, the Day of the Hereafter, meaning the Day of *Qiyamah*, and in Quranic terminology, what has Allah Ta'ala described *Qiyamah* as? In countless verses, in many different places, Allah Ta'ala has mentioned *Qiyamah*, and in several chapters (*suro*), entire chapters have been described concerning *Qiyamah*. The Day of Recompense and Punishment (*roz-e jaza o saza*), the words with which Allah Ta'ala has described it—what are they? It is called *yawm ad-damdamah* (the Day of Overwhelming Calamity). It is called *batshatul kubra* (the great seizing). Elsewhere, it is called *yawm al-qiyamah* (the Day of Resurrection). Elsewhere, it is called *yawm al-hisab* (the Day of Reckoning). Elsewhere, it is called *sa'ah* (the Hour), meaning that there is a time, an hour that is coming. `As-sa'atu atiyatun` (the Hour is coming). So, it is known that *Qiyamah* is an inevitable affair (*labudi amr*) from Allah, and it is a day of recompense and punishment that is coming, and it cannot be averted.

You see, in every era, every nation, every community (*jama'at*), every group (*jirge*), every individual—there is no one who has not held the belief that they must be saved from recompense and punishment (*jaza o saza*), or that they will not have to give recompense and punishment. You see that a student has to go through an exam. Every person, within their own sphere of action, has to go through an exam. So then, it is obvious that this life itself cannot be an exception. He too will certainly have to give an exam, and he will have to give an account of the good and bad of this life, of piety and vice.

This is another matter. `Innal-hasanati yudhhibnas-sayyi'at` (Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds). That our good deeds wash away many of our wrongdoings. But this does not mean that your good deeds will be counted and your bad deeds will be left aside. No, good deeds are in their own place, and bad deeds are in their own place. That too will be counted, and this too will be counted. The meaning of *Munkar* and *Nakir* is just this, and both are going to be counted. It is another thing that the mercies of Allah Ta'ala, along with our good deeds, will remove our misdeeds.

So, to have faith in the Day of *Qiyamah* with different beliefs, with some additions and subtractions, with differences of opinion, with some additions and subtractions in understanding, all nations, all religions, and all the people of the world, every school of thought has considered that *Qiyamah* is coming, and a day of recompense and punishment will occur. Regarding this. And you see that they, whether they are Hindus, Buddhists, Jews, or Christians, all have believed that indeed that day is coming. Someone called it *parlok* (the other world), someone called it the Last Day, someone else said that this is Doomsday. But the confession of the day of *Qiyamah* has been present in every nation, in every group, in every school of thought. So it is known that no one can deny this, and everyone is waiting for it. And its best examples are before you, that a *Qiyamah* has just passed recently. A *Qiyamah* passed recently, and you see what a dread it was. A thought would come to mind, and a dread would set in. Then again everyone is quiet, thinking nothing will happen. But it certainly happens that a dread sets in.

So, when Allah Ta'ala has said that it is a day of dread, and called it *faza' al-akbar* (the greatest terror), it means that there will be such a severe seizing, it will be a day of such a severe seizing that people will cry out. So, this is an inevitable affair (*labudi amr*), and it is a day coming from God that is related to recompense and punishment. Now, the question remains, when is this day coming? How is it coming? What is going to happen on this day? Who are the ones who will carry it out? Who are the ones who will establish *Qiyamah*? And in what way does *Qiyamah* take place? The answers to all these things, now we will see them in a sequence. First of all, you see that this Quran Majid that is in our hands, it contains the original truths of all things, from which we derive the essence. `Wa la ratbin wa la yabisin illa fi kitabin mubin` (and no moist or dry thing but that it is in a clear record). There is no wet or dry thing that is not in the Clear Book. So, regarding *Qiyamah*, all the details are present in their entirety. But who is there to see those details? Who is there to understand those details?

Today, those who play with words, who are they? The literalist Muslims (*zahir-parast Musalman*). Muslims who are only literalists, who play with words, who look at words. They have become so enamored with the words that they are counting *alif*, counting *be*, counting *se*, counting *te*, to the extent that charts are being made that so many hundred thousand *alifs* have come, so many hundred thousand *bes* have come, this has happened so many times, and *hamza* has come so many times. Brother, with these hundred thousands and two hundred thousands and three hundred thousands, what will happen in the end? What do you want to do? By counting *alif* and counting *be*, what do you want to do? They say these are mute letters, so if this verse comes, don't interpret it allegorically (*ta'wil*). Whatever its meaning is, take that same meaning. Brother, `ya laytani kuntu turaba` (Oh, I wish I were dust!). On that day, the disbeliever will say, "I wish I were dust." Now, interpret its meaning as literally dust. Now, this means the disbeliever on the day of *Qiyamah* will say, "I wish I were dust." Now, the meanings that are given in the commentaries and translations, if you read there, it is written that "I wish I were dust." Brother, there should be some meaning, some point to it. What is the meaning of wishing to be dust? If it were that the disbeliever would say, "By God, today I have got this day of *Qiyamah*, I wish I were a believer (*momin*)." So the meaning of *turab* is *momin*. Because they had such enmity with Abu Turab, they turned their face away from *turab* itself. This was the enmity with Abu Turab. Did you understand? So they cleared the matter of *turab* itself, so that Abu Turab would not even be mentioned. So, this is the kind of aversion that caused this to happen.

Anyway, I was telling you that what do literalist Muslims think about *Qiyamah*, what do they see? We will proceed a little from there, then we will know what it is. After saltwater, there is the pleasure of freshwater. So, the state of saltwater is necessary. That sip, you will have to drink it a little. And what is that state? That first of all, those Muslims who describe it and paint such a picture that another *Qiyamah* befalls *Qiyamah* itself. The situation is such that even one who is not dying will die.

Their first claim is that Hazrat Israfil, who is the chief of the angels (*sayyid al-mala'ikah*)—one is Jibra'il, one is Mika'il, and one is Janab-e Israfil—Israfil will come with his horn (*pungi*). And that horn, now Janab-e Israfil, the horn of the chief of the angels, is said to be one in the east and one in the west. One horn is here, the other is there. And it will be blown, so now imagine what kind of horn that is and what kind of angel is blowing it. Anyway, now Janab-e Israfil will blow the horn (*sur*), and as soon as the horn is blown, what will happen? All the people will rise from their graves, dusting off their shrouds (*kafan*). The raising from the grave (*ba's-i qabr*), that is, being resurrected from the graves, is that they will rise dusting off their shrouds. Look, this was the matter, because there they had to rise dusting off their shrouds, so what did they do? They took great care while burying. Because now they have to rise. Ultimately, they have to rise on the day of resurrection (*hashr*), so they took great care and placed slabs (*kadiyan*) beforehand. They said, "No, build a grave and lay him to rest comfortably inside." And let there be no such thing that the shroud gets even a little bit dirty. These are clear words. The words are clear that I am saying to you: the shroud should not get dirty. Please, lay him in such a way that the shroud does not get dirty, because if he rises there in the resurrection (*hashr*), what a matter of disgrace it will be, coming before Allah with a dirty shroud. So how can the shroud get dirty? Now the situation is that the dirt that is being given, one person is taking that dirt in his hand. Brother, what is this? So he says, "No sir, I will collect all the clumps of dirt and whatever there is and place them near the head of the occupant of the grave. So that you can keep counting that I have collected the dirt from all over." So that you do not put dirt on the shroud. So this is the precaution.

And when the wailing started, now you see that you had only tied the groom's headdress, now other people started decorating it. How did that house start getting decorated? That grave started getting decorated, and in such a way that now, if the poor deceased is in this state, and he has to remain in the grave forever, then if he ever feels hungry, what will happen? Just look, you just see the idea. So now some sweet pudding (*phirni*) was also placed there. They said, "Brother, in this darkness, how will the poor soul manage?" So a lamp was also lit. So how many such people are there, such classes, such schools of thought, even today, that you see they light a lamp. They place sweet pudding. Just look at the grave, look at burying the dead, and look at them placing pudding inside. What will they do? So, originally, when all these things were there, that's why they said that they will rise dusting off their shrouds. They will rise dusting off their shrouds, that's fine, sir. What will happen after that? They said, "After that, in the scales of deeds (*mizan-e amal*), on the balance, the deeds will be weighed." Now, for the deeds of all communities, of the entire nation (*ummat*), to be weighed, you see, the fruit of a whole lifetime, and a balance to weigh it, its pans must be in the east and west. Such large pans are needed after all, to weigh all the deeds, a big balance is needed. And when they sit, brother, who will hold the balance? Allah will hold it. Whatever there is, it is Allah, and in the pans of the balance, the deeds are being weighed. Fine, they were weighed. And after that, now the third stage is the bridge of *Pulsirat*. This is the stage of *Qiyamah*. The *Pulsirat*, the bridge of *Pulsirat* is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair. This is so common that it is on everyone's tongue. I think everyone must know it. Sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair is the path, the *Pulsirat*, and one has to cross the *Pulsirat*. Now, the situation is that if the path is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair, then I think we should practice balancing our whole lives so that we can cross it well on the day of *Qiyamah*. Now look at the situation, and the amazing thing is that I will say only this much, I will add only this much to it, that one should learn balancing, but balancing while sitting on this animal, on goats, if one learns that too, it would be even better. This is because, in these commentaries, Muslims write that we, the goats that we are slaughtering on the occasion of Eid, these very goats will be useful to us for riding on the *Pulsirat*. Now you see, on the *Pulsirat*, and then a ride, and the ride is of goats, and they are riding on the goats, and crossing, and the path is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair. And if the foot ever slips, then it's this way, or that way. That is, if one goes this way, it is hell (*dozakh*), if one gets through, it is paradise (*jannat*). So now, this is the belief of Muslims, this is the idea of Muslims. And after that, they have taken it to the extreme with *khatam-hum misk* (their seal will be of musk), which is worth hearing. They said that, brother, this will happen, but along with it, the sun will come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths (*sava neze*). Brother, how many inches is a spear-length, at least tell us that. Is it a yard, a meter, God knows what it is. And only Allah knows best what kind of spear-length this is of theirs. The sun is going to come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, and after coming down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, what will the situation be? Even now, when the sun shines and glows, you see what our condition becomes in May and June. We are in a bad state from the heat, and what will be our state when it comes down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, only Allah knows best.

So, this is the creed of the Muslims. The people of truth (*Ahl-e Haqq*), the people of faith (*Ahl-e Iman*), the people of the esoteric (*Ahl-e Batin*), those who take from the door of Ali, and who benefit from you, and who take grace from the Imams, they can never go astray. They have explained that look, the blowing of the horn of Israfil (*sur-e Israfil*) is absolutely a reality. But what does it mean? The horn of Israfil, its blowing, the breath of the spirit (*nafkh-e ruh*), that is its essential meaning. To blow. That is, the coming of Allah's revelation (*wahi*), the receiving of divine support (*ta'idat*), this is the meaning of the blowing of the horn of Israfil. That is, the Lord of the Worlds, the Tenth Intellect (*'ashir-e mudabbir*), and the Intellects after it, all of them will give support to the *Qa'im* (`alayhis-salatu was-salam`). They will give aid. This is the blowing of the horn of Israfil.

Alright. Now, what is being resurrected from the graves (*qabron se ma'bus hona*)? Being resurrected from the graves is our subtle bodies (*rihiyat*), our body's waste matter (*fuzalat*). I have already told you in detail, and you have come to know how our subtle bodies, how our waste matter develops and how it progresses. These developments keep happening, and this has been described as being resurrected from the graves. Rising from the graves. This is the matter, isn't it? Your subtle essence is going, you are going. This is being resurrected. And as for being weighed in the scales (*mizan*), that is the scale of the intellect (*mizan-e 'aql*). That it will be weighed in the scale of the intellect. That is, when the Imam `alayhis-salatu was-salam` gives you a place in his spiritual body (*nasut*), when he gives a place in his divine reality (*lahut*), he will give you those places of which you are worthy. Allah is like a body. If you are worthy of becoming the nose, then become the nose. If you are worthy of becoming the eye, then become the eye. And if you want to become a nail and a hair, then become a hair. So, whoever has deeds of a certain kind will get a place of that kind. And after that, now this has happened. Now the matter of the *Pulsirat*. What in the end will we understand the *Pulsirat* to be? The *Pulsirat* is this life of ours. This life of ours is itself the *Pulsirat*. It is such a crossroads, don't ask. At any moment, we can stray. At any moment, we can dare to commit a sin. At any moment, we can go from here to there. We can be on a good creed, and we can go to a bad creed. So, this is the *Pulsirat*. From this *Pulsirat*, we have to walk straight and upright. And since we have to walk straight, that's why you have to recite daily, and in every *namaz* you have to recite *Alhamd*, and in every *Alhamd* you have to recite this verse: `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim` (guide us to the straight path). O Allah, keep us on the straight path. O Allah, straight... brother, you are on the straight path, why are you reciting it again? At any moment, we can stray. At any moment, we can dare to commit a sin. At any moment, we can go from here to there. We can be on a good creed, and we can go to a bad creed. So, this is the *Pulsirat*. From this *Pulsirat*, we have to walk straight and upright. And since we have to walk, and walk straight, that's why you have to recite daily, and in every *namaz* you have to recite *Alhamd*, and in every *Alhamd* you have to recite this verse: `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim` (guide us to the straight path). O Allah, keep us on the straight path. O Allah, straight... brother, you are on the straight path, why are you reciting it again? No, sir. This life is very difficult. At every moment, we do not know what temptation comes and what happens, and what we get caught in. That's why one has to say `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim`. So it is known that this is the matter. And as for the sun coming down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, within this there is only this much truth: that the sun's heat must increase, and that too at only one moment. And that will be by the command of Janab-e Qa'im, who is the Lord of the Age (*Rabb-e Waqt*), who is everything of his time. When he makes his appearance (*zuhur*), by his command, this sun will increase its heat, and at a specific moment, which I will mention to you. So it is known that these are the kinds of matters.

Now you see, regarding *Qiyamah*, what we think is that *Qiyamah* will happen and *Qiyamah* is coming. Indeed, we think so. But you see that *Qiyamah*, you, do you not do your accounting every day? Do you not do a monthly accounting? Do you not do a yearly accounting? So *Qiyamah* is also of several kinds. There is the *Qiyamah* of the day, the *Qiyamah* of the night, the *Qiyamah* of the week, the *Qiyamah* of the month, the *Qiyamah* of the year. *Qiyamah* is also of different kinds. That is why the Prophet said, `man mata faqad qamat qiyamatuhu` (whoever dies, his resurrection has taken place). Whichever person passes away, his *Qiyamah* has taken place. Did you see? As soon as the person died, his *Qiyamah* took place. The Prophet says, `man mata faqad qamat qiyamatuhu` (whoever dies, his resurrection has taken place), his *Qiyamah* took place. So does this mean that *Qiyamah* has happened, you will understand that all the *Qa'ims* who are to come, their *Qiyamah* has happened? No. Brother, it is a matter of understanding that his *Qiyamah* took place, now his accounting has begun. This *Qiyamah* has happened. And the second is the *Qiyamah* of the cycle of concealment (*dawr-e sitr*), the *Qiyamah* of the cycle of manifestation (*dawr-e kashf*). This is a minor *Qiyamah*. It is of 7,000 years, or 47,000 years, 50,000 years. What will these *Qiyamahs* be in that grand count? They will be like a dot, these *Qiyamahs*. Let's talk about the *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr*, of the *Kawr*, and of the *Mawr*. The *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr* is a *Qiyamah*. The *Qiyamah* of the *Kawr* is one. The *Qiyamah* of the *Mawr* is one. How does the *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr* happen? First of all, know this, that the *Qiyamah* that is coming now, what kind of *Qiyamah* is it? I told you in "The Past Duration of the World," from the saying of Mawlana Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, you told the past duration, how did you tell it? That one *Mawr-e A'zam* has passed. We are in the second *Mawr*, and in that second *Mawr* too, 399 *kawrs* have passed. We are in the 400th *kawr*, in its first *dawr*, at the end of the *dawr-e sitr*. So it is known that this first *dawr*, the 400th, is ending. So we are not ending the *sitr*, but we are ending the *dawr* as well. So it is known that our *Qiyamah* is not the *Qiyamah* of the *sitr*, but it is also the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*. So how does the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr* happen? In the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*, this happens: that this entire world, nothing at all will change. Nothing will be overturned. There will be no change in even a single thing. Only this much will happen, that the direction (*simt*) will change. The direction will change, east will become west, west will become east, north will become south. Now you will say, "Brother, this is also a very big thing." Indeed, it is a big thing. But what does it mean? What does north becoming south mean? It means that what is dry land will become sea, and what is sea will become dry land. The place where there is water will now have dryness, mountains will come, and where there are mountains and dryness, there water will come. This change is going to happen, and this change happens where? At the *dawr*. Now, let's come to the *kawr*. For the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*, Allah Ta'ala Himself says, `idhash-shamsu kuwwirat, wa idhan-nujumun kadarat` (When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness], and when the stars fall, losing their luster). `idhash-shamsu kuwwirat`, when the sun becomes dark. Read the Quran. When the sun becomes dark, when the stars (*nujum*), these stars begin to fall. So it seems that the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr* is a great *Qiyamah*. And this breaking of the celestial bodies is no small matter. And this destruction in the universe, how will it be? It will be a destruction within the entire cosmos. And this will happen in the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. And after the destruction, how will it be? Again, in the same way, as I said, the world will be created, the twenty-eight will be created, and these plants, minerals, and animals will be born, the sky and the earth will meet—all these things that I have described to you, all those things will happen. Just as it has happened, so it will happen. `Ma kana sa-yakunu wa ma takhtash-shamsi bi-jadid` (What has been will be, and there is nothing new under the sun). Nothing under this sun is new. What happened, will happen. Just as it happened, it will be repeated in the same way. Just as they say, "History repeats itself." It is the same thing. So all things will always be repeated. So this is the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. Alright, what happens in the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*? In the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, this happens: that not just your universe will be destroyed, but the universes will be destroyed. Did you see? You don't have one universe, you have universes. He is the Allah of the worlds (*'alamin*). `Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin` (Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds). He is the Lord of the worlds. So all the universes are going to be destroyed. And which day is that? That day will be the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*. In the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, there is complete destruction. And I told you that he is the *Sultan*. `Fa-bi-ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?). `La tanfudhuna illa bi-sultan, fa-bi-ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (You will not pass except by authority. Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?). O humans and jinn! If you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority. Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny? O humans and jinn, can you exit from these regions of the heavens and the earth? Then he says that no, no, you cannot exit. You will have to exit because of the *Sultan*. So that *Sahib-e Mawr* who will come, he will take all the *sahiban-e akwar* within his embrace. He is the one individual from where, after progressing, ascending to the spiritual world will happen at one time. And when will that progress happen? When the *Sahib-e Mawr* comes. We will have to remain in the waiting place until the *Sahib-e Mawr* comes. But, if a person, you understand, is living a sick life, he will say, "Brother, for God's sake, O Lord, if you give me death, it would be better. What is there to gain from this life? What is to be gained from this crawling life?" If I got four days, but they were in health, that would have been better. So in the same way, Allah wants from you that whatever you do to purify yourself here, do it for a thousand years at a time, but do it with excellence and pass and get out. It's not that you get stuck in the worldly whirlpool, somewhere in thorns, somewhere in this, sometimes in dust, sometimes in fire, sometimes in air, here and there. You should not be left behind, and you should remain steadfast in your spiritual progress. And by progressing, you should go to the realm of purity (*safa*), and remain in the state of purity, that is much better. So it is known that this is a matter of these progressions. So, in the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, this is what happens: that there is a complete destruction, and those *sahiban-e mawr*, they take all the souls of the cycles from here. I have explained this to you in great detail.

So you have seen the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*, the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. And the *Qiyamah* that is coming now is the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*. The *Qiyamah* of the *dawr* is coming, and it's not that these celestial bodies will break, the sun will come down, or the moon will break, or such and such will happen, or you will see chaotic situations. No such turmoil is going to happen in this world, as has been said. Nor is the sun going to come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths and scorch you. Nothing of the sort is going to happen.

However, you are attached to the Imams, and the Imams are your guardians (*kafil*). We are holding on to the hem of the Imams, and they are the ones who will take care of us. We have prostrated at the door of the knowledge of the Prophet (*bab-e 'ilm-e nabi*). We have bowed there, and they are our guardians, and they are the ones who will take care of us. And without Ali, not even a leaf can move. Not a single particle can move except by the permission of Allah. Why? Without the authority (*wilayat*) of Ali and without the authority of the *Ahl al-Bayt*, nothing is going to happen. So it is known that we are attached to their hem, and indeed, that will happen. Now, from this chain of Imamate, that same Janab-e Husayn, that same Hasan, that same Ali, that same Fatima az-Zahra, their descendants are continuing, the lineage of their beloved ones is continuing. Now you see, Imam Zayn al-'Abidin is coming, after Imam 'Ali Zayn al-'Abidin, Muhammad al-Baqir is coming, Ja'far as-Sadiq is coming, Janab-e Isma'il is coming, after that Mawlana Muhammad bin Isma'il is coming. This chain continued, Mawlana Mu'izz came, they... Tayyib came, and the chain continuing, continuing, our present Imam, Mawlana Muhammad [unclear] Ali, may Allah's blessings be upon him, may thousands of blessings and peace be upon you from Allah. Your blessed self, who is in the station of Mawlana 'Abd al-Muttalib, as I told you, your rank is the greatest, because you have the status of the grandfather of the *Qa'im*, and what can be said of your exalted rank. What a wondrous rank you have, for which the tongue is inadequate to describe. I swear by God, the tongue is inadequate to describe your exalted rank. Now, your two sons, and they will be in whose station? In the station of Janab-e Abu Talib, Janab-e Ali... and Janab-e 'Abdullah. And their two sons will be in whose station? One will be in opposition to the Prophet, Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and one will be in opposition to the Commander of the Faithful, Ali. The one who comes in opposition to the Prophet is the *Hujjat-e Qa'im* (Proof of the Qa'im). And the one who comes in opposition to Ali is the *Qa'im* himself. But it happens that after every Imam, until now you have understood and this is the system of the *da'wah*, that his son is the *Hujjat*. So here too, the sons of the *Qa'im* are the *Hujjat*. And the one who comes before them, who is he? He is the *Hujjat-e Ula* (First Proof), he is the *Hujjat-e Thaniyah* (Second Proof). Who is this *Hujjat-e Ula*? He is the first proof, who will appear with the name *Mahdi*, who is in the station of the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. And by God, his rank is very high. With whom should I compare his loftiness? Allah Himself has made him the most lofty, so now there is no need for anyone to compare his loftiness. He is very lofty, the person of Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him. When he makes his appearance (*zuhur*), for that, the Quran has mentioned. Now, for us, *Qiyamah* is that we had not understood *Qiyamah*. Now we started reading the Quran, and you started seeing that `innas-sa'ata atiyatun baghtatan` (the Hour is coming suddenly). That *Qiyamah* will come suddenly. How have the elders of our past said this, that the day of *Qiyamah* is appointed, the time is appointed, the day is appointed, and the minute and second are appointed. How will this be?

So, in the end, how will it be? Then Allah Ta'ala says it will come suddenly, so what kind of thing is this? The matter is that everything that exists has two levels. One is this surface, and the other is that surface. The first surface is this, the second surface is this. Or this is the first surface, this is the second surface. So the first surface of *Qiyamah*, from where the duration begins, and that period which begins from it, is the *zuhur* of Janab-e Mahdi. And the *zuhur* of the *Qa'im* is the second surface. And the first *zuhur*, which is the *zuhur* of Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him, regarding that *zuhur*, Allah Ta'ala has said that it will be sudden (*baghtatan*), that *Qiyamah* will come suddenly. It will come so suddenly that dread will spread, and people will not understand what to do and what not to do.

A very revered brother of mine gave a very good example, that when such a *Qiyamah* was raging and the stars were aligning in such a way, everyone said, "Brother, what should we do? Should we do this, should we do that?" So he said a very good thing, that at that time a wise man said that the best thing is for us to do our own work. Do our own work. So it is known that this is the correct thing. So what is the right work to do? It is that we must always keep our return to Allah and return to Him. Whatever *namaz* and other things we have to perform, we have to perform them. These are the duties of our station, which are upon us. Until this yoke is removed from our necks, this yoke will remain. So I was telling you about Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him, who is in the station of the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. His *zuhur* is sudden, and it can happen at any time, it can happen at this very moment. It will happen, and it will be sudden. And if it happens suddenly, in what way will it happen? That is, what is *zuhur* called? Brother, what does it mean to become apparent? What does it mean to become apparent? Does it mean he is hidden? Is he hidden in some cave, like the twelfth Imam is hidden in a cave? He is not hidden like that. Brother, your Imam is hidden like that, why doesn't he come out? I asked, why doesn't he come out? He said, "You... why don't you ask this question: if ice can stay in a thermos, why can't our Imam stay in a cave?" Look what a great answer. After all, he was a Shia scholar, so the answer... After all, if ice can stay in a thermos, then our Imam... he can't stay in a cave? And when God put the companions of the cave to sleep, then what was wrong with keeping the Imam in the cave? So I just said this, that brother, I have understood, it's a very good thing, it's very good. You keep him in such a thermos. But my point is that when your... this Imam, who is 'Askari, Allah knows best, whoever he may be, but now this... the one who is to come as the *Qa'im al-Qiyamah*, you have said that he is the greatest guide, he is the greatest one, he is the one who will establish *Qiyamah*. So why this whole commotion? Why did the matter stop at the twelfth? Them... and he does not die, and the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`'s self is not greater than him? So why didn't Allah give the Prophet the life of Noah, make it so long that he himself could appear? After all, why is your twelfth Imam stuck there? So anyway, what answer will they give? What answer will they give to this? Anyway. So what I mean to say was that the one who is going to appear before the *Qa'im al-Qiyamah*, he is the *Mahdi-billah*, may blessings be upon him. Whose name is the name of the Prophet, whose father's name is the name of the Prophet's father, and about whom the Prophet had said, that personality, that one who is the God of his time, who is the Subduer (*Qahhar*), the Compeller (*Jabbar*) of his time, is coming. Coming as a *Jabbar*. Now look, sometimes there is a *jamali* (beautiful) state, sometimes a *jalali* (majestic) state is manifested. From Allah's side. You have seen the thunderclaps, have you seen the clouds thunder, have you seen the great commotion and storm of rain? So one says, "O *Jabbar*, O *Qahhar*." And if good sustenance starts to come, then "O *Razzaq* (Provider)." And if sometimes you like something, you say, "O *Jamil* (Beautiful)." O Beautiful, O *Jamil*, or say whatever, "O *Ra'uf* (Compassionate)," "O *Rahim* (Merciful)." But the words *Jabbar* and *Qahhar* do come out, that when one sees that the wrath of Allah is thundering, there is coercion (*jabr*) and there is wrath (*qahr*). So seeing his *qahr* and *jabr*... So now is the time for the *Jabbar* and *Qahhar* to come. And the *Mahdi* is coming as that *Jabbar* and *Qahhar*. And as soon as he appears in this world... what does *zuhur* mean? I have just clarified to you. *Zuhur* does not mean this, rather, he is also present. To be recognized (*pachhanvan*). That is *zuhur*. He said, "I am the *Mahdi*." That's it, understand that now the *zuhur* of the *Mahdi* has happened. And that too, he will say it from such a place from where wrath comes, from Cairo (*Qahirah*). This wrath will come from Cairo. And it will be such a wrath, don't ask. Allah had named it *Qahirah* beforehand. And it will be such a wrath, don't ask. The Day of *Damdamah*, the Day of *Faza' al-Akbar*. And this *Faza' al-Akbar* has been described for the *zuhur* of the first *Mahdi*. Now, the world of dread. That is, as soon as the *zuhur* happens... now you will say that if he takes his sword and comes out, today there are atom bombs and the whole world's... bombs have come out. The whole world's weapons have been made. Now where do you flash your sword? God forbid, God forbid. It will be a strange state. Brother, this is the personality who is coming, who is the representative of Allah, who is coming as the God of the age. Now, the one in whose grasp is godhood and lordship, who has authority over the winds, who can make it rain whenever he wishes, who can destroy the trees, who can bring destruction in a minute, in a second. That personality is coming. He will command that the force of gravity should end. Now you see, as soon as the force of gravity ends here... I am giving an example, only Allah knows best what he is going to do. As soon as the force of gravity ends here, it's over. As soon as one thing ends, everything is over. Your entire science has been reduced to ashes. It's gone. If this air pressure ends, where is your science? Where is your science? And if the water, instead of flowing downstream, starts flowing upstream a little, what will be the situation? Where will your science be? If the nature of God changes... `lan tajida li-sunnatillahi tabdila` (You will not find in the way of Allah any change). Now, when the one who brings change brings change, what will the situation be? Now the situation will be that now they have been caught, and they have been seized, and even great nations which you see, such nations whose influence was paramount, and who are doing power balancing, but all will be left behind. All will be left behind and will be left crying out. They will be left crying out. And no one will have any say. And they will have only one voice. They will ask, "Brother, what do you want after all?" He will say, "I want only one thing. And that is, that God's wali (friend) kept coming to you, prophets kept coming into the world, imams kept coming, giving guidance, the chain of our *du'at* continued, you kept receiving guidance, but you did not take guidance. Did you try to read God's book? You were others, the Muslims themselves did not read God's book correctly. Brother, it was written in it that `innad-dina 'indallahil-islam` (the religion with Allah is Islam). With Allah, the religion is Islam. How did you understand this Islam?" He said, "Sir, we left Islam because we didn't understand what Islam is. What is Islam?" It's a true thing. Islam... they didn't show it. The Muslims presented Islam in such a way, don't ask. I gave you an example yesterday. Their shari'ah has been reduced to doing wudu and tying their hands. So now, this... so they showed Islam in such a bad way, presented it in such a scene, that he could not understand. So he will say that `innad-dina 'indallahil-islam`. From today, the religion is Islam, and besides Islam, no other drum will be beaten. Be careful, no one dares to take any name other than Islam. `Qulu la ilaha illallah`. Now there is no question of `tuflihu`. That was the Prophet, who was compassionate and merciful, he was the mercy to the worlds, who had said, "Say `tuflihu`, O people, and you will prosper. Just take the name of Allah, that `la ilaha illallah`." Now, this is the *Qahhar*, this is the *Jabbar*. Now the matter is of the sword. Now the matter is of the mouth, now the matter is of wrath, now the matter is of coercion. You will have to accept. There is no way out other than accepting. And this is that you accept Islam. `La ilaha illallah`. Until now you hadn't recited it, it hadn't gone down your throat. You had recited it many times, you had turned the prayer beads, but it hadn't entered your heart. Now you will have to recite `la ilaha illallah` correctly. Now you... So, they will be made to recite `la ilaha illallah`, and everyone will be made a Muslim. There will be no person who will not become a Muslim. But you know that if a small community is sitting, then only God knows the state of each one's heart. The one who explains explains, but only God knows the state of the heart, how the heart accepts, or doesn't accept, what is in whose heart, what is not happening in whose heart, in whose heart it is a yes, it is happening. A world of things. So this is the state of our hearts, that the heart is called what turns. In a moment, a *tola*, in a moment, a *masha*. It turns so quickly, don't ask. It turns so quickly, don't ask. Just now a sister was telling me that how can this be the last lesson? At least add one more lesson. That is, with one lesson, another ten lessons are added. The point is that if it turns, it turns like this. So the heart turns.

So, it was said that in this way...

Janab-e Mahdi `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, he... *Qahhar*, *Jabbar* came, and they said that now in no way... you have to... Islam... So it is known that everyone accepted Islam outwardly. But did they accept it from the heart? There will be many, but they did not accept it from the heart. Brother, nothing... the sword is flashing. Now the wrath has come. Let's... now so much pressure is being applied, so much is being applied, they are people who use force, it's better to just give the *salwa* tax. Give it, and this is the last chance, how long will we be disgraced? Now the disgrace is unbearable, so *Qiyamah* has happened. *Qiyamah* has happened, it's better to just give it, and if our name is also added, that's good. At least it will be in a sealed envelope. Give it. So it is known that in the same way, they thought in their hearts. They thought in their hearts, what is it, this is wrath, this is coercion they have done. It's better that we submit like this. For now, there is a little matter, it will pass. This is also a temporary period, it will pass. And after that, our days will come again. And for now, what Islam they are talking about, we have to accept that Islam. So they accepted Islam. The time will come when the churches will be closed, the temples will be closed. All doors will be closed. Now only the door of Haydar is open. The divine religion, the door of Islam. Now Ali's influence will prevail. Ali is lofty, and nothing is loftier than him. Ali is lofty. And now his influence will prevail. Now no one's name will work. Now there is one Lion of God's name, and it is on everyone's tongue.
