And they are being purified by taking the name of the *Ahl al-Bayt*. So now the situation is that everyone, outwardly, will accept a lot, but inwardly, they will keep their grudge in their hearts, and with their hearts hidden, with a constricted heart, at some point, may the time come quickly, may the time come quickly, so that we can again throw off this noose and go to our own religions. Whether they are Sikhs, or Hindus, or so-and-so, everyone has become a Muslim. And the whole world is shining with Islam. All the temples are closed. And the bells are also silent. And these... the records are also silent. You... you don't feel the pain, just come to India and see. Especially Baroda. And don't ask about the pain that is felt. Alhamdulillah, a lot... a lot of pain is felt. So anyway, now all these bells are ringing, these are records. Because of them, all their festivals keep going on. And their gods neither sleep nor let them sleep, so they wake us up too. So this is... after death, they will torment, but in life, they torment like this. Anyway, they torment, that is their job, they keep tormenting. Now Hazrat Mahdi `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will what will they do? This is... they beat the drum, as the *Qahhar* and *Jabbar*, they brought them to the religion of Islam. Having brought them to Islam, they said that the religion with Allah is Islam, the religion is Islam with Allah. Accept Islam, there is no other way. Fine, they accepted. It went on. Now the religion went on, Islam went on, Janab-e Mahdi is established in his place, and this is going on. Time will pass. Now you will say, "Brother, how many years are going to pass, what is it?" This time... I cannot tell you this time. This is asking for the time in such a way as if you are asking for the train's timetable. That at what time it will arrive, on which platform it will arrive. So, let there be some mystery. So, some things are not to be known. So anyway, a time will come which is appointed. And that time is appointed. Look, this time is not appointed. But the time of Janab-e Qa'im is appointed. And that is such a time that, don't ask. Fine, I will count the days for you, it's a good thing, it's not a big deal, it's the occasion of Eid al-Adha. The occasion of Eid al-Adha. It is the day of Eid. The *zuhur* is there. And with the *zuhur*, there is the *zuhur* of Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. And what can be said. That one whose slaves are Ali, whose slavery even all the Imams feel honored in, that personality is coming. Janab-e Qa'im. The establisher of *Qiyamah* (*Qa'im al-Qiyamah*), the master of *damdamah* (*sahib-e damdamah*), the master of *faza' al-akbar* (*sahib-e faza' al-akbar*) is coming. And what can be said of his procession, his royalty, his kingdom, his sovereignty. Where is he coming from? He is coming from Ma'arif. Look, Allah Ta'ala has already named that place Ma'arif. Ma'arif means signs. Brother, from where the signs of Allah are going to rise, that place exists even today. And from that same village, from that same settlement in Yemen, who is coming? Hazrat Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. And here, Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`'s *zuhur* took place. And what does *zuhur* mean? The one who will announce it will be Janab-e Mahdi himself. That who is the *Qa'im*, what is the *Qa'im*? A day is coming, a din is coming, the master of the din is coming, and he is your master. In whose heart I am going. And Janab-e Mahdi will himself set out on a journey. And after traveling, he will directly reach where? In Ma'arif, which is the region of Yemen. And Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, what can be said of his majesty? With what pomp and show, what can be said? Brother, the one with whom all the elements of nature are with folded hands, what do you ask about his royalty? What do you ask about his royalty? And here the situation is that at whose signs the sun, moon, and stars rise and set, at whose signs they become low and high, they are the ones who are coming in his entourage. So what will be the state of his royalty? What will be the loftiness of his exaltedness? He is the *Qa'im*. The state of *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` is that the procession is coming out. And with pomp and circumstance. But the state of Janab-e Qa'im is that Janab-e Qa'im commands, "Be careful. With me there will be only 313 men." Did you see? Only 313 men. You will think that there will be a large crowd, that is, at least a gathering of three or four hundred thousand. Not three or four hundred thousand, not a hundred, there are 313 people. 313, the same 313 who, when the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, the mercy to the worlds, went to Badr, there were 313, those same 313 are needed. 313 individuals will be with you. And your procession came out, and Janab-e Mahdi is with you. And you, coming out from there, from Ma'arif, and to the people, you will say at that time that "I... O people, I will address you, I will speak to you." And your procession will go directly to where? To the Baytullah al-Haram. The same center of God, the same house of God. `Inna awwala baytin wudi'a lin-nasi lalladhi bi-bakkata mubarakan wa hudan lil-'alamin` (Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Bakkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds). He reached there. After reaching there, he performed the same prostration. Why? It is his place of prostration too. After all, from where did the great Kayumarth come? Janab-e Qa'im is where? Janab-e Kayumarth, the great one, came from here. That is his place of prostration. He prostrated in that Baytullah. He performed the circumambulation (*tawaf*). After performing the *tawaf*, he kissed the Hajar al-Aswad. And after kissing the Hajar al-Aswad, he came to the pulpit (*mimbar*). After coming to the pulpit, this voice will resonate: `li-manil-mulkul-yawm, lillahil-wahidil-qahhar` (To whom belongs the dominion this day? To Allah, the One, the Subjugator). Whose day is it today? It is for the One, the Subduer. It is for that Lord of the Worlds who is the One, the Subduer. The day is for him. So he is telling, "Who am I? I am the One, the Subduer. The Lord of the Age." And along with that he will recite: `wa ashraqatil-ardu bi-nuri Rabbiha` (and the earth will shine with the light of its Lord). At this time, the earth has been filled with the light of Allah. And along with that, now what do you say? Those 313 individuals, with them you will proceed. And from this Mecca, you will directly go to Medina. To Madinah, to the Holy Prophet, you will go to his presence. And after reaching there, you will visit the Messenger of Allah. You will visit the Messenger of Allah. And you will uproot the graves on both sides and they will be crucified there. And from there, you will go directly to where the caliphs are. They are the ones who claimed the right. They sat in the place of right, they usurped the right of Ali. They will be brought to justice. And from there, coming out directly, where will your direction be? You will say, "Now to Mina." To Mina, to Mina, to the desire (*muna*). Brother, that for which the desire was made, today is the day to fulfill that desire. Today we will fulfill our desire. And they will reach Mina. As soon as they reach Mina, this is the plain of resurrection (*maidan-e hashr*). This is the plain of Karbala, this is the plain of resurrection, this is the plain of *Qiyamah*. Now what can be said of this plain of *Qiyamah*. Just look at the recognition of Mina. Look at that land. Oh. Now what is the situation? The situation is that whoever the people are, Adam's enemies, whether it is Pharaoh, or Haman, or Qarun, whether it is that Nimrod, whether it is anyone, Ghud, Suwa', Ya'uq, or whether it is Sahrebuta, whoever it may be. All those accursed ones, whatever age and at whatever moment they died, that thing is recorded with providence. That if he died at 65, then 65 years. If he died at 70, then 70 years. If someone went at an older age, then that age. Whatever his age was, that age has been noted. Now what will happen? According to that age, they have to be born in this world, and in that way, they have to reach that age. So now it is obvious that if you call a few years, a few years of *Qiyamah*, if it is a matter of 70-80 years of age, then these people should be born. And they have been born. How many have been born? Yazid has also come, Shimr has also come, Qarun... only Allah knows best. But they have to be born. Whether it is in Syria or Iraq. Now, neither the parents know that Yazid has come, nor does Yazid know that he has come as Yazid. Neither the parents have a chance to be happy, nor does the child have a chance to be happy that in whose house I have come. Did you see? The arrangement of providence. Now he has come. Everyone has been born. After being born, the situation is that when you herd a flock, when you herd goats, you see the shepherd, quietly, you see what the situation is. What does he do? To herd the goats, he takes one goat ahead, so that all the goats follow behind. And if they don't, then he goads them with a stick. He prods them with a stick, he hits them in such a way that in no way do they... they walk in step with the flock.

Now what will happen? The situation will be that these accursed ones, whose ancestors were opponents of the saints, who opposed the imams, who opposed the prophets, who opposed the pious, who opposed the *du'at*, they are all coming. And they don't know who they themselves are. Who they are, where they are going, from where they were born. No one knows. They don't know anything. They are coming, all of them are being dragged, dragged along. Providence is bringing them, and they are coming. In a completely unconscious way. In an unconscious and oblivious way they are coming, and how are they coming? They have to come to that plain of *Qiyamah*. And *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` in that field... and Hazrat *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` is standing leaning against a tree, and Janab-e Mahdi is with him, and those 313 individuals are standing in your ranks. There cannot be a number greater than that. That's all the people there are. We might say, "Brother, let us also reach your presence." That is for whom Allah has written, they reached. For whom Allah has not written, they did not reach. If a call for war is made, then you see how the situation is, what the situation is. Who is ready to go to war? Anyway, those 313 individuals are the individuals whom Janab-e Qa'im has kept with him. And in front of Hazrat Qa'im, they are coming. Slowly, slowly, being dragged, they are coming. And as they come, when all the people gather, providence has already made the arrangement. All will slowly, slowly gather, and that day will be the day of Ashura. As soon as the day of Ashura comes, all of them will be gathered. All of them will be gathered. Pharaoh will also come, and Yazid will also come, Shimr will also come, this one will also come, that one will also come, the caliphs will also come, so-and-so will also come, everyone will come. No one will be left out. Everyone has arrived at their place. Now, after arriving, providence will lift the veil. Providence will lift the veil from their eyes, and it will be shown who you yourself are. Now, as soon as they... first, there are two kinds of veils. One is the veil on Janab-e Qa'im. The second veil is on their eyes. First, the veil will be removed from Janab-e Qa'im. Or first, the veil will be removed from their eyes. So, it is that first their veil was removed, so they understood who I am. "Oh, I am so-and-so, I am so-and-so, I am 'Amr ibn al-'As, I am Marwan, I am so-and-so." And as soon as he saw, and along with that, he looked at Janab-e Qa'im, and when he saw Janab-e Qa'im, who was it? The caliphs are seeing Ali. Mu'awiyah is seeing Hasan. Yazid is seeing Husayn. Pharaoh is seeing Moses. Did you see? The mirror is one, whose image is being seen? This is the manifestation. This is called mirror-work. This is the mirror-work of providence. And that Nimrod who was there, he is seeing Abraham. And that Qabil who was there, he is seeing Habil. That Shaytan Harith al-Murrah who was there, he is seeing Adam. And Sahrebuta who was there, he is seeing Jesus. "Oh, I... Oh, I crucified him! Oh, I myself have come today." Sahrebuta trembled like this, and was terrified like this. Everyone is trembling and terrified in their state, because they have recognized themselves and they have recognized them. And there, the *Qa'im* is one being. And why are they being seen? Brother, the *Qa'im* is the temple (*haikal*). All the temples are gathered in him. He has become the great mirror by taking on the forms of everyone. Everyone's form is being seen in that mirror. And all are seeing their own form. "Oh, oh, they have come. Husayn has come. Oh, Ali has come. Oh, the Prophet has come." Abu Lahab and his wife are seeing the Prophet. And Umratul Khaybariyyah, that woman of Khaybar, Zaynab, who had given poison to the noble Prophet, she is also seeing the Prophet. So anyway, all are seeing. All are seeing. And seeing, they are trembling and terrified, "O Allah, what *Qiyamah* has come." "Brother, we had opposed him." Because with full memory, they have been given it. That what was your memory and what opposition did you do. You opposed the saints. Brother, let's assume that who... what great thing is a prophet, who can extinguish the light of God? That candle which God Himself has lit, what can extinguish it? But they thought it was Husayn and killed him, they thought it was Ali and killed him, Ibn Muljam struck with the sword. They thought it was Janab-e Prophet. They whipped, they threw on the sand. Will they not be punished today? Today Husayn will also be punished, Karbala will also be punished, Uhud and Khaybar will also be punished. And punishment will be given for every place today. Today everyone is to be punished. The Day of Recompense and Punishment. The recompense is that they were joined in the temple of the *Qa'im*. This is the recompense they got, that you are in the highest paradise, you have reached God in the spiritual realm. And you, sitting in the window there, are watching paradise. You will say, "Brother, I wish we were also there." Brother, you will be there. Although you may have become a point, a dot, but you are watching from those chambers of paradise, from those gardens, you are watching, you are seeing. "Allah's mercy..." So what are those chambers of paradise? These are the windows. This is the scene from the temple, you are watching, you are seeing. This is the scene to see. This is the scenery. And after that, you will see whose day it is today, it is the day of *Qiyamah*. Today is the day of piety. Today is the day for sins to be destroyed and ruined. Today is the day for Shaytan to hide his face. Today is the day for Shaytan to be annihilated. And he will be annihilated. And what will happen? After that, Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will start turning towards each one. But where will he start from? You will think he will start from Adam. Or from Janab-e Jesus, or from... no. The matter will start from Ali. Because after the *Qa'im*, if there is a rank, it is of Ali. So it will be asked, in whose place did who sit? How did they sit? How did you sit? How did you sit in his place? Brother, in the place of the great Ali, in the place of the great news (*naba' al-'azim*), you came and sat. Didn't you understand? And the one who explained to you, did he not show you the Prophet even after his death? Did he not show you in the mosque of Quba? Did he not show you the scene in the Prophet's mosque? Then why didn't you understand? At that time also it was explained, afterwards also the proof was given, but... And today... Alright, I forgot to mention one thing to you. So that is, that along with this it will happen, that Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, when he intends to come to Mina, and to go to Madinah, before that, an announcement of his will be made. And what will that announcement be? And that announcement will be a very great announcement. And that announcement will be that, "O people, my beloved, my *Hujjat*, Janab-e Mahdi, made you Muslims by force and coercion. But I say that the true religion is indeed the religion of Islam. The true religion is Islam, and you have to remain on it. And this is the religion that will make you successful. In it is everything for you, the outcome, the hereafter, everything is there. But I remove my yoke of authority from you, and I remove the yoke, and go, whichever religion you want to be on, your religion is blessed for you. `Lakum dinukum waliya din` (To you be your religion, and to me my religion). But understand this, that the religion is the religion of Islam." As soon as this yoke is removed by Janab-e Qa'im, the bells started ringing, the churches also started, the temples also started. And everything started running in its own place. As soon as it started here, the *Qa'im* said, "Be careful, don't move now. Be careful, who dares to move. Now the proof is complete. I have completed the proof against you. I have shown you the religion, and after forcing you, I... and after that, now you have gone back to it again. Now the proof is complete, now you will be punished." In this way, they will be seized. And in this way, now you go to the plain of *Qiyamah*, and there they will be asked, "How did you oppose Moses, O Pharaoh? How did you oppose Jesus, O Sahrebuta?" All these things will be questioned, and everyone is being questioned, and every person is trembling and terrified and understands that this is Jesus who has come, this is Moses who has come, this is Adam who has come, this is Ali who has come. Every person is seeing his own Imam. Every person is seeing his own Imam. Even our 49 Imams who passed, in the time of every Imam, whoever was the unfortunate one, he is seeing his own Imam of the time. Why? Janab-e Qa'im is the mirror. They are seeing, everyone's manifestation is happening. And they are seeing and trembling and terrified, and in this very state they will be, in this very state of astonishment, that Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will signal to the earth, to the earth, "Earth, be careful, let no one move." These are my prisoners. The feet will get stuck. No one's foot will... brother, our feet get stuck in the mud. Brother, this is the *Qa'im*. The *Qa'im* will make them stand still. The feet will not be able to move from the ground. Everyone's feet are stuck there. After that, the order will be given, "Now it is done. Now you, 313 individuals," he will say to them, "Yes, now it is your time. That now you slaughter them. Kill them. In the same way, kill the big ones, slaughter them like camels. Those who are smaller than them, slaughter them like cows, twisting their necks and throwing them down. And those who are like goats, lay them down and slaughter them." And the situation here will be that there will be blood and blood. That land which has always been red, that land where thousands of camels have always been slaughtered, on that same land, these will be slaughtered. And they will be slaughtered, and everyone will be cut down, everyone will be killed. And all of them will be... done. When it is done, at that time we will offer praise, and we will thank Allah Ta'ala. Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will be in a state of *namaz*. And at that time, those 313 individuals will also perform *namaz* with you. And after performing, at that time you will signal, to the sun. "Sun, now it is your job." As soon as the sun is signaled, the sun will start showing its intensity. And with the intensity of the sun, what will happen? Now you see that the heat of the heat will increase. As the heat increases here, the order will be given to the demons (*kudatain*). *Ras* and *Zanab*. They will be given the order, "Yes, *Ras* and *Zanab*." Open the doors. And release all those prisoners who are imprisoned. Now you see, who are those prisoners? You must remember, I hope you haven't forgotten. Those *kudatain*, *Ras* and *Zanab*. *Ras* and *Zanab* are their evil souls. Vile forms, which after dying, after their exit, remained in the graveyard for forty days, then as I said, they remained in the latrine and other such places. They remained in thorny trees, in barren fields. They remained in the fields, and then in the latrine. And after coming out from there, they sometimes took rides, and after coming out, the demons caught them and imprisoned them in their... prison. So now these imprisoned ones, who are *Ras* and *Zanab*, as soon as the doors are opened from there, all of them were released. And after being released, when they fall, their form has also been described, that they will fall in the form of a camel's neck. And with this falling, they will come, so every form that is coming, it will come upon its own body. The one whose body it is, `tahdhib khud apne khanzar se khudkashi karegi` (civilization will commit suicide with its own dagger), yes. This will be the matter. To die by one's own self, to burn in one's own fire. Their own form will annihilate them. That it was that same fire, that was their form, that was the vile form, that was their creed, that was the wrong creed. That same creed fell upon them. And with the falling, they caught fire. And with the catching of fire, what will happen? Every particle is burning. All the hostile ones, whose bodies were created, they are all burning. And after burning, when they become ash, the wind will be commanded, "Wind, now go." And as soon as the gust of wind starts blowing, the wind will, just as a sweeper sweeps to one corner, in the same way, the wind will sweep. That is what it is doing, and how is the sweeping happening? It is continuously gathering it in one place, and gathering this ash, it is bringing it and in the Atlantic Ocean, there is a door of that, of Jahannam. Jahannam has four doors. Of which three doors are on land. One door is in the water. The door that is in the water, its name is Barhut. Perhaps this is the Bermuda Triangle, or that place which is mentioned. And the others are, one is Hadramawt. That Hadramawt which is here is *Hadhir Mawt* (death is present). Yes, death is present, please come. *Hadhir Mawt* is that Hadramawt. And after that is Sa'iq. God forbid, from Sa'iq. After Sa'iq is Dayr. These... these are three places. And out of these three, two places are volcanoes. You will think that Japan's volcano is the biggest, so it will be there. No. There is no need for that, that is just a subordinate. A very small volcano, but it is there. So anyway, its location and places are there, the names I am saying are also there. But these three places are on land, one place is in the Atlantic Ocean. This will all be... Janab-e Qa'im will signal that enter through the path of Barhut. All this ash, the entire wind, gathering it, will sweep it away, and into the sea, through the path of Barhut, they will go to Jahannam. And when they go to Jahannam, now, the scene after going to Jahannam, I have already described it yesterday. That what their condition will be after going to Jahannam, that they will be brought back to their original state. And as soon as they come to their original state, they have three necks, three forms, eight, ten hands each. Look, they have become gods. And the situation is that they are clawing at each other, eating, tearing, and hitting. These will be their habits, these will be their traits, and in this way they will spend their time there. So this is the divine punishment. Rather, the situation will be that when they enter, those who are already present will say, "O Allah, from where have you sent this new army? We were already in torment. From where has this new army come?" "From where has this calamity been created?" "From where has more... more been sent upon us?" And what is the state of Jahannam? Jahannam cries out, the Quran says, `hal min mazid?` (Is there any more?). `Hal min mazid?` "Brother, my stomach is not getting full. The matter is worth considering. My stomach is not getting full, O Lord. You have put so much fuel, what is this fuel? This is just one day's supply for me. My stomach is not getting full from this. `Hal min mazid?` Is there anything more for my food? I need more. My stomach has not been filled with this." So the Muslims say that upon `hal min mazid`, what will happen? Look, a little... pick up the books. Just see the joke. That they say that Allah will, when Jahannam starts crying out, `hal min mazid, hal min mazid`, "Send some more, send some more, I am hungry," then Allah will put his foot in. Meaning, the matter was such that... that it is something strange, that if Allah speaks, it's over. Allah will put his foot in, then Jahannam will be quiet. Now Allah has put his foot in. So is Allah going to get his foot massaged? God forbid. What is the meaning, I don't understand. Anyway, which thing that comes to their understanding, will you understand? Anyway. This is an exemplary moment. It is a very exemplary moment. May Allah Ta'ala give us a lesson, that they will have to go through such harsh conditions, and the punishment of Allah Ta'ala is very painful, very severe. And Allah Ta'ala says, `dhu quwwatin matin` (Possessor of power, the Firm). Allah Ta'ala is very powerful. Severe in punishment. And `ghadha'an dha ghussatin wa 'adhaban alima` (and a food that chokes and a painful punishment). Brother, he will give them such food there in Jahannam that will get stuck in the throat, and it will be a very severe punishment from Allah. May the Lord of the Worlds, for the sake of the Ahl al-Bayt, grant us salvation from all these things. May the Lord keep us away from these tests. May he keep us on the straight path. May he keep us attached to the hem of the Imams. And above all, our Mawla, our master, our Da'i of the time, our father, Mawlana Sayyidna Sharfi, may Allah prolong his life and grant him health, may he make us his devotees. This entire... all the knowledge, whatever has opened my tongue before you, without his command, without his support, not even a leaf can move. Believe me, that these are his views, these are his blessings, these are his graces, that whatever I could present before you. But remember it, understand it, and make it a principle of your life. And this... this... I will consider it my fruit only when you make it beneficial for yourself. And for the betterment of religion and the betterment of the hereafter. `Wa akhiru da'wana anil-hamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulihi Sayyidina Muhammadin wa Ahl-e Baytihit-tayyibinat-tahirin, wa sallama 'alayhim ajma'in.`
